units.id: mission:Wanderers: Pre-Colony|With the Eye fully opened, Wanderer ships have begun flooding into this region of space. This desolate planet seems to be of particular interest to them, with drones rapidly surveying in all directions, and a small outpost beginning to form.|22|0
units.english: With the Eye fully opened, Wanderer ships have begun flooding into this region of space. This desolate planet seems to be of particular interest to them, with drones rapidly surveying in all directions, and a small outpost beginning to form.
units.italian: Con l'Occhio completamente aperto, le navi dei Wanderers hanno cominciato a riversarsi in questa regione di spazio. Questo pianeta desolato sembra interessarli in modo particolare: i droni fanno rilevamenti rapidi in ogni direzione e un piccolo avamposto comincia a prendere forma.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Pre-Colony|	As you land on the outskirts of this settlement, one of the workers comes up to you as you leave your ship. "[Greetings, welcome], it is [delightful, pleasing] to see you have come to show your interest in our exploration. Unfortunately, there exists much [hazard, risk] on a world we know so little about. This will be our staging ground to [explore, catalog] this new region, but it will take some time to be assured of the [safety, security] of our outpost. I suggest you take time to [orient, locate] yourself in these systems while we set up before returning to help. Of course you are welcome when we have [determined, established] safety, there will be many ships needed to help heal the many ruined planets here."|23|0
units.english: As you land on the outskirts of this settlement, one of the workers comes up to you as you leave your ship. "[Greetings, welcome], it is [delightful, pleasing] to see you have come to show your interest in our exploration. Unfortunately, there exists much [hazard, risk] on a world we know so little about. This will be our staging ground to [explore, catalog] this new region, but it will take some time to be assured of the [safety, security] of our outpost. I suggest you take time to [orient, locate] yourself in these systems while we set up before returning to help. Of course you are welcome when we have [determined, established] safety, there will be many ships needed to help heal the many ruined planets here."
units.italian: Mentre atterri ai margini di questo insediamento, uno degli operai ti viene incontro appena scendi dalla nave. "[Salute, benvenuto], è [delizioso, piacevole] vedere che sei venuto a mostrarci il tuo interesse per la nostra esplorazione. Purtroppo su un mondo che conosciamo così poco ci sono molti [pericoli, rischi]. Questo sarà il nostro campo base per [esplorare, catalogare] questa nuova regione, ma ci vorrà un po' per avere la certezza della [sicurezza, incolumità] del nostro avamposto. Ti suggerisco di prenderti il tempo di [orientarti, ambientarti] in questi sistemi mentre noi ci sistemiamo, e di tornare poi ad aiutarci. Naturalmente sarai il benvenuto quando avremo [stabilito, determinato] la sicurezza: serviranno molte navi per aiutare a guarire i molti pianeti in rovina che ci sono qui."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Surveying 1|name|28|0
units.english: Wanderer Surveying
units.italian: Rilevamento Wanderer

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Surveying 1|description|29|0
units.english: The Wanderers asked you to survey several of the nearby planets in Korath space, and to bring the data back to them on <planet> when you are done.
units.italian: I Wanderers ti hanno chiesto di rilevare diversi pianeti vicini nello spazio Korath e di riportare loro i dati su <planet> quando hai finito.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Surveying 1|blocked|42|0
units.english: The Wanderers have another mission for you, but you will need <capacity> for their scientific equipment.
units.italian: I Wanderers hanno un'altra missione per te, ma ti serve <capacity> per il loro equipaggiamento scientifico.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Surveying 1|log|44|0
units.english: The "Eye" wormhole has opened in Wanderer space, but the territory on the other side of the wormhole is Korath space, ravaged by their civil war and still infested with autonomous war machines. Nonetheless, the Wanderers are excited to once again begin their work of healing and repairing damaged worlds.
units.italian: Il cunicolo che chiamano "l'Occhio" si è aperto nello spazio dei Wanderers, ma il territorio dall'altra parte è spazio Korath, devastato dalla loro guerra civile e ancora infestato da macchine da guerra autonome. Ciononostante i Wanderers sono entusiasti di ricominciare il loro lavoro di guarigione e riparazione dei mondi danneggiati.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Surveying 1|log|45|0
units.english: Tele'ek became part of the expeditionary force that was formed to explore the territory beyond the Eye once it opened.
units.italian: Tele'ek è entrato a far parte della forza di spedizione formata per esplorare il territorio oltre l'Occhio una volta che si fosse aperto.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Surveying 1|The Wanderers have begun building a base here, with freighters landing every few minutes to bring more supplies or people. They have a fair number of weapons and warships to keep the Korath automata at bay, but the majority of the supplies look like scientific tools or possibly equipment for terraforming planets.|47|0
units.english: The Wanderers have begun building a base here, with freighters landing every few minutes to bring more supplies or people. They have a fair number of weapons and warships to keep the Korath automata at bay, but the majority of the supplies look like scientific tools or possibly equipment for terraforming planets.
units.italian: I Wanderers hanno cominciato a costruire una base qui, con mercantili che atterrano ogni pochi minuti per portare altre provviste o altre persone. Hanno un buon numero di armi e navi da guerra per tenere a bada gli automi Korath, ma la maggior parte dei rifornimenti sembra strumentazione scientifica o forse attrezzatura per il terraformaggio dei pianeti.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Surveying 1|	Soon after you land, you are ushered in to a meeting with several of the senior Wanderer leaders. You recognize the military commander Sobari Tele'ek, but the others are strangers to you. And oddly, in addition to the adults there is a Wanderer child in the meeting, barely more than a meter tall, with iridescent black plumage like a starling.|48|0
units.english: Soon after you land, you are ushered in to a meeting with several of the senior Wanderer leaders. You recognize the military commander Sobari Tele'ek, but the others are strangers to you. And oddly, in addition to the adults there is a Wanderer child in the meeting, barely more than a meter tall, with iridescent black plumage like a starling.
units.italian: Poco dopo l'atterraggio vieni condotto a un incontro con diversi dei capi più anziani dei Wanderers. Riconosci il comandante militare Sobari Tele'ek, ma gli altri ti sono estranei. E, cosa strana, oltre agli adulti c'è un cucciolo Wanderer, alto a malapena un metro, con un piumaggio nero iridescente come quello di uno storno.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Surveying 1|	When she sees you the child says, "Greetings, Captain." Surprisingly, she speaks in your own language. It's heartening that the Wanderers are teaching your language to their children; perhaps in a few years you'll no longer need the translation device to talk with them.|49|0
units.english: When she sees you the child says, "Greetings, Captain." Surprisingly, she speaks in your own language. It's heartening that the Wanderers are teaching your language to their children; perhaps in a few years you'll no longer need the translation device to talk with them.
units.italian: Quando ti vede, il cucciolo dice: "Salute, Capitano." Con tua sorpresa, parla nella tua lingua. È incoraggiante che i Wanderers insegnino la tua lingua ai loro piccoli: forse fra qualche anno non ti servirà più il dispositivo di traduzione per parlare con loro.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Surveying 1|	Tele'ek asks you, "Have you explored this new [territory, responsibility] that the Eye has brought us to?"|50|0
units.english: Tele'ek asks you, "Have you explored this new [territory, responsibility] that the Eye has brought us to?"
units.italian: Tele'ek ti chiede: "Hai esplorato questo nuovo [territorio, incarico] in cui l'Occhio ci ha condotto?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Surveying 1|	"Yes, it looks like the worlds here are in great need of your care."|52|0
units.english: "Yes, it looks like the worlds here are in great need of your care."
units.italian: "Sì, sembra che i mondi qui abbiano molto bisogno delle vostre cure."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Surveying 1|	"I've run into hostile robotic drones here. You may have been safer back where you came from."|54|0
units.english: "I've run into hostile robotic drones here. You may have been safer back where you came from."
units.italian: "Ho incontrato droni robotici ostili. Forse stavate più al sicuro da dove venite."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Surveying 1|	"No, I have not had time to explore yet."|56|0
units.english: "No, I have not had time to explore yet."
units.italian: "No, non ho ancora avuto il tempo di esplorare."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Surveying 1|	"Indeed," says one of the other Wanderers. "It is very [exciting, stimulating]."|60|0
units.english: "Indeed," says one of the other Wanderers. "It is very [exciting, stimulating]."
units.italian: "Davvero," dice uno degli altri Wanderers. "È molto [emozionante, stimolante]."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Surveying 1|	"Perhaps," says Tele'ek, "but we have not yet found a way to [communicate, reason] with them. Perhaps their attacks on us are merely a misunderstanding."|64|0
units.english: "Perhaps," says Tele'ek, "but we have not yet found a way to [communicate, reason] with them. Perhaps their attacks on us are merely a misunderstanding."
units.italian: "Forse," dice Tele'ek, "ma non abbiamo ancora trovato un modo per [comunicare, ragionare] con loro. Forse i loro attacchi sono solo un malinteso."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Surveying 1|	A different Wanderer speaks up and says, "This new territory is full of [promise, possibility], but we are few in number still and have not dared to [explore, survey] too widely. Human, you have [special, exotic] means of travel and can perhaps explore more [safely? circumspectly?] than we can. Will you visit some worlds for us and help us to [measure, discern] what must be done to heal them?"|68|0
units.english: A different Wanderer speaks up and says, "This new territory is full of [promise, possibility], but we are few in number still and have not dared to [explore, survey] too widely. Human, you have [special, exotic] means of travel and can perhaps explore more [safely? circumspectly?] than we can. Will you visit some worlds for us and help us to [measure, discern] what must be done to heal them?"
units.italian: Un altro Wanderer prende la parola e dice: "Questo nuovo territorio è pieno di [promesse, possibilità], ma siamo ancora pochi e non abbiamo osato [esplorare, rilevare] troppo in largo. Umano, tu hai mezzi di viaggio [speciali, esotici] e forse puoi esplorare in modo più [sicuro? accorto?] di noi. Visiterai alcuni mondi per noi e ci aiuterai a [valutare, capire] che cosa va fatto per guarirli?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Surveying 1|	"Sure, I'd be glad to."|70|0
units.english: "Sure, I'd be glad to."
units.italian: "Certo, ne sarò felice."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Surveying 1|	"Are you sure you aren't in danger here from the Korath drones?"|72|0
units.english: "Are you sure you aren't in danger here from the Korath drones?"
units.italian: "Sei sicuro di non essere in pericolo qui con i droni Korath?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Surveying 1|	"Don't worry," says Tele'ek. "[Resisting, fighting] the Unfettered Hai forced us to develop stronger warships. We are well [equipped, prepared] for this new threat."|74|0
units.english: "Don't worry," says Tele'ek. "[Resisting, fighting] the Unfettered Hai forced us to develop stronger warships. We are well [equipped, prepared] for this new threat."
units.italian: "Non preoccuparti," dice Tele'ek. "[Resistere, Combattere] contro gli Hai Slegati ci ha costretti a sviluppare navi da guerra più robuste. Siamo ben [equipaggiati, preparati] per questa nuova minaccia."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Surveying 1|	The Wanderers load a large amount of scientific equipment onto your ship and explain how to use it. They also indicate several planets that their long-range sensors have detected that they would like you to investigate further.|77|0
units.english: The Wanderers load a large amount of scientific equipment onto your ship and explain how to use it. They also indicate several planets that their long-range sensors have detected that they would like you to investigate further.
units.italian: I Wanderers caricano sulla tua nave una grande quantità di equipaggiamento scientifico e ti spiegano come usarlo. Ti indicano anche diversi pianeti che i loro sensori a lungo raggio hanno rilevato e che vorrebbero farti esaminare più a fondo.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Surveying 2|name|86|0
units.english: Wanderer Surveying
units.italian: Rilevamento Wanderer

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Surveying 2|description|87|0
units.english: The Wanderers have asked you to survey some more worlds, which are deep in the territory of the Kor Mereti drones, and to bring the measurements back to them on <planet>.
units.italian: I Wanderers ti hanno chiesto di rilevare altri mondi, in profondità nel territorio dei droni Kor Mereti, e di riportare loro le misurazioni su <planet>.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Surveying 2|blocked|97|0
units.english: The Wanderers have another mission for you, but you will need <capacity> for their scientific equipment.
units.italian: I Wanderers hanno un'altra missione per te, ma ti serve <capacity> per il loro equipaggiamento scientifico.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Surveying 2|log|99|0
units.english: Iriket is a Wanderer specializing in terraforming, who has been selected to survey the worlds beyond the Eye and to make plans for how each one can be made to flourish once more. She is far more interested in the terraforming work than in dealing with the threat of the Korath war machines.
units.italian: Iriket è una Wanderer specializzata in terraformaggio, scelta per rilevare i mondi oltre l'Occhio e per pianificare come ciascuno possa tornare a fiorire. Il suo interesse per il lavoro di terraformaggio è molto maggiore di quello per la minaccia delle macchine da guerra Korath.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Surveying 2|When you land, a Wanderer named Tema'a Iriket meets you, and identifies herself as the head of the terraforming team. She is excited to see your data on the nearby planets. "For each of these worlds," she says, "we must decide what [treatment, strategy] will best enable it to flourish once more. Even if a world is near to the [territory, domain] of the [dangerous, hostile] robots, we may be able to begin its [healing, transformation] from a distance."|101|0
units.english: When you land, a Wanderer named Tema'a Iriket meets you, and identifies herself as the head of the terraforming team. She is excited to see your data on the nearby planets. "For each of these worlds," she says, "we must decide what [treatment, strategy] will best enable it to flourish once more. Even if a world is near to the [territory, domain] of the [dangerous, hostile] robots, we may be able to begin its [healing, transformation] from a distance."
units.italian: All'atterraggio ti viene incontro una Wanderer di nome Tema'a Iriket, che si presenta come capo della squadra di terraformaggio. È entusiasta dei tuoi dati sui pianeti vicini. "Per ciascuno di questi mondi," dice, "dobbiamo decidere quale [trattamento, strategia] gli permetterà meglio di rifiorire. Anche se un mondo è vicino al [territorio, dominio] dei robot [pericolosi, ostili], potremmo riuscire a iniziare la sua [guarigione, trasformazione] a distanza."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Surveying 2|	"I'm surprised your species is so eager to start terraforming. I'd think the threat of the Korath automata would be your first priority."|103|0
units.english: "I'm surprised your species is so eager to start terraforming. I'd think the threat of the Korath automata would be your first priority."
units.italian: "Mi sorprende che la vostra specie sia così impaziente di cominciare il terraformaggio. Avrei pensato che la minaccia degli automi Korath fosse la vostra priorità."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Surveying 2|	"Is there any way I can help with the terraforming efforts?"|105|0
units.english: "Is there any way I can help with the terraforming efforts?"
units.italian: "C'è un modo in cui posso aiutare con il terraformaggio?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Surveying 2|	She says, "[Healing, renewing] worlds is something we love doing. Fighting is not something we love. So unless the robots become more [aggressive, threatening] we prefer not to seek out conflict. And in the meantime, it would be [intriguing, exciting] to make measurements on the planets they control. Could you do that for us?"|109|0
units.english: She says, "[Healing, renewing] worlds is something we love doing. Fighting is not something we love. So unless the robots become more [aggressive, threatening] we prefer not to seek out conflict. And in the meantime, it would be [intriguing, exciting] to make measurements on the planets they control. Could you do that for us?"
units.italian: Dice: "[Guarire, Rigenerare] i mondi è qualcosa che amiamo fare. Combattere non è qualcosa che amiamo. Quindi, a meno che i robot non diventino più [aggressivi, minacciosi], preferiamo non cercare il conflitto. Nel frattempo, sarebbe [interessante, emozionante] fare misurazioni sui pianeti che controllano. Potresti farlo per noi?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Surveying 2|	"I am [pleased, delighted] that you asked," she says. "What we would find most [useful, interesting] right now would be [climate? ecosystem?] measurements from the planets orbiting these stars." On a local star map, she points out several star systems.|113|0
units.english: "I am [pleased, delighted] that you asked," she says. "What we would find most [useful, interesting] right now would be [climate? ecosystem?] measurements from the planets orbiting these stars." On a local star map, she points out several star systems.
units.italian: "Sono [contenta, lieta] che tu l'abbia chiesto," dice. "Quello che ci sarebbe più [utile, interessante] adesso sarebbero misurazioni del [clima? ecosistema?] dei pianeti in orbita intorno a queste stelle." Su una mappa stellare locale ti indica diversi sistemi.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Surveying 2|	"Those are deep in Kor Mereti territory," you tell her.|114|0
units.english: "Those are deep in Kor Mereti territory," you tell her.
units.italian: "Quelli sono in profondità nel territorio Kor Mereti," le dici.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Surveying 2|	"Yes," she says, "which is why I am [hoping, presuming] to ask you to make the measurements."|115|0
units.english: "Yes," she says, "which is why I am [hoping, presuming] to ask you to make the measurements."
units.italian: "Sì," dice, "ed è per questo che [speravo, immaginavo] di poterti chiedere di fare le misurazioni."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Surveying 2|	"Sure, I would be glad to do that."|119|0
units.english: "Sure, I would be glad to do that."
units.italian: "Certo, lo farò volentieri."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Surveying 2|	"That sounds awfully dangerous."|120|0
units.english: "That sounds awfully dangerous."
units.italian: "Sembra terribilmente pericoloso."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Surveying 2|	"Excellent," she says. "I will collect the data from you when you are done."|123|0
units.english: "Excellent," she says. "I will collect the data from you when you are done."
units.italian: "Eccellente," dice. "Raccoglierò io i dati da te quando avrai finito."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Surveying 2|	"I have complete [trust, faith] in your abilities," she says, and then she walks away before you can protest further.|127|0
units.english: "I have complete [trust, faith] in your abilities," she says, and then she walks away before you can protest further.
units.italian: "Ho piena [fiducia, fede] nelle tue capacità," dice, e poi si allontana prima che tu possa protestare ancora.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Surveying 2|	When you report to the Wanderer leaders, they have several other requests for you. A cosmologist named Erukt Isi'ithi is interested in scanner data on three supernova remnants near Korath space. And Sobari Tele'ek wants you to collect more data on the automata. "If we knew how they function," he says, "we might be able to [make peace with, befriend] them. Perhaps you could [board, salvage] a disabled drone of each [faction?] and bring us whichever [parts, components] control its [decision-making, intelligence]."|130|0
units.english: When you report to the Wanderer leaders, they have several other requests for you. A cosmologist named Erukt Isi'ithi is interested in scanner data on three supernova remnants near Korath space. And Sobari Tele'ek wants you to collect more data on the automata. "If we knew how they function," he says, "we might be able to [make peace with, befriend] them. Perhaps you could [board, salvage] a disabled drone of each [faction?] and bring us whichever [parts, components] control its [decision-making, intelligence]."
units.italian: Quando ti presenti ai capi dei Wanderers, hanno diverse altre richieste per te. Una cosmologa di nome Erukt Isi'ithi è interessata ai dati degli scanner su tre resti di supernova vicino allo spazio Korath. E Sobari Tele'ek vuole che tu raccolga altri dati sugli automi. "Se sapessimo come funzionano," dice, "potremmo forse [fare la pace con, diventare amici di] loro. Forse potresti [abbordare, recuperare] un drone neutralizzato di ciascuna [fazione?] e portarci i [pezzi, componenti] che ne controllano il [processo decisionale, intelligenza]."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Surveying 2|	"Sure, I would be glad to do that."|132|0
units.english: "Sure, I would be glad to do that."
units.italian: "Certo, lo farò volentieri."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Surveying 2|	"The drones are powerful. I'm not sure I can disable one."|134|0
units.english: "The drones are powerful. I'm not sure I can disable one."
units.italian: "I droni sono potenti. Non sono sicuro di riuscire a neutralizzarne uno."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Surveying 2|	"They seem to do a good job of disabling each other when they meet," he says. "Or you could [upgrade to, purchase] one of our [necessary? lamentable?] warships."|136|0
units.english: "They seem to do a good job of disabling each other when they meet," he says. "Or you could [upgrade to, purchase] one of our [necessary? lamentable?] warships."
units.italian: "Sembrano bravi a neutralizzarsi a vicenda quando si incontrano," dice. "Oppure potresti [passare a, acquistare] una delle nostre [necessarie? lamentabili?] navi da guerra."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Surveying 2|	You leave the meeting with a long list of tasks to perform for the Wanderers. You hope they appreciate all the assistance you are giving them.|138|0
units.english: You leave the meeting with a long list of tasks to perform for the Wanderers. You hope they appreciate all the assistance you are giving them.
units.italian: Lasci l'incontro con una lunga lista di compiti da svolgere per i Wanderers. Speri che apprezzino tutto l'aiuto che dai loro.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Surveying 2|You present your planetary measurements to Tema'a Iriket, the terraforming director. She is very excited about the data. "So many worlds," she says, "each with their own [personality? idiosyncrasies?]. We will learn more about each one, and discover how we can [partner, collaborate] with them to help them [recover, be reborn]."|145|0
units.english: You present your planetary measurements to Tema'a Iriket, the terraforming director. She is very excited about the data. "So many worlds," she says, "each with their own [personality? idiosyncrasies?]. We will learn more about each one, and discover how we can [partner, collaborate] with them to help them [recover, be reborn]."
units.italian: Presenti le tue misurazioni planetarie a Tema'a Iriket, la direttrice del terraformaggio. È molto entusiasta dei dati. "Tanti mondi," dice, "ognuno con la propria [personalità? idiosincrasia?]. Impareremo di più su ciascuno e scopriremo come [collaborare, fare squadra] con loro per aiutarli a [riprendersi, rinascere]."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Surveying 2|	She tells you that for now, they do not need any more scanning data, but she will let you know if new needs arise in the future.|146|0
units.english: She tells you that for now, they do not need any more scanning data, but she will let you know if new needs arise in the future.
units.italian: Ti dice che per ora non hanno bisogno di altri dati di scansione, ma ti farà sapere se in futuro nasceranno nuove necessità.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Nova Remnants|name|152|0
units.english: Nova Remnants
units.italian: Resti di supernova

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Nova Remnants|description|153|0
units.english: A Wanderer cosmologist named Erukt Isi'ithi asked you to visit several nearby stars that seem to be supernova remnants, and to make measurements on them.
units.italian: Una cosmologa Wanderer di nome Erukt Isi'ithi ti ha chiesto di visitare diverse stelle vicine che sembrano resti di supernova e di fare delle misurazioni.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Nova Remnants|log|172|0
units.english: Archons are partly biological, partly technological, and partly something that human language has no words for. They are extremely powerful. The Archons are somehow affiliated with the Drak, yet separate from them.
units.italian: Gli Archon sono in parte biologici, in parte tecnologici e in parte qualcosa per cui la lingua umana non ha parole. Sono estremamente potenti. Gli Archon sono in qualche modo legati ai Drak, eppure distinti da loro.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Nova Remnants|You contact the cosmologist Erukt Isi'ithi and give him a copy of your ship's scans of the supernova remnants. To you, the scanner results are inscrutable, but clearly to him they tell a story, and not one he is happy with: his body shakes violently and the pupils of his eyes shrink to pinpoints as he looks at the data.|174|0
units.english: You contact the cosmologist Erukt Isi'ithi and give him a copy of your ship's scans of the supernova remnants. To you, the scanner results are inscrutable, but clearly to him they tell a story, and not one he is happy with: his body shakes violently and the pupils of his eyes shrink to pinpoints as he looks at the data.
units.italian: Contatti la cosmologa Erukt Isi'ithi e gli dai una copia delle scansioni della tua nave sui resti di supernova. Per te i risultati degli scanner sono incomprensibili, ma per lui raccontano chiaramente una storia, e non una storia che gli piaccia: il corpo gli trema violentemente e le pupille gli si restringono a spillo mentre guarda i dati.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Nova Remnants|	"These stars died an [untimely, unnatural] death," he says. "I wonder what the role of these Archon [beings, entities] was. Is the [destabilization, destruction] of these stars a crime the Korath committed, for which the Archons punished them? Or did the Korath commit some other crime, and the Archons [ripped, tore] these stars apart as punishment?"|175|0
units.english: "These stars died an [untimely, unnatural] death," he says. "I wonder what the role of these Archon [beings, entities] was. Is the [destabilization, destruction] of these stars a crime the Korath committed, for which the Archons punished them? Or did the Korath commit some other crime, and the Archons [ripped, tore] these stars apart as punishment?"
units.italian: "Queste stelle sono morte di una morte [prematura, innaturale]," dice. "Mi chiedo quale sia stato il ruolo di questi [esseri, entità] Archon. La [destabilizzazione, distruzione] di queste stelle è un crimine commesso dai Korath, per il quale gli Archon li hanno puniti? O i Korath hanno commesso qualche altro crimine, e gli Archon hanno [strappato, fatto a pezzi] queste stelle come punizione?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Nova Remnants|	"Which do you think is more likely?"|177|0
units.english: "Which do you think is more likely?"
units.italian: "Quale delle due cose pensi sia più probabile?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Nova Remnants|	"Has your species encountered the Archons before?"|178|0
units.english: "Has your species encountered the Archons before?"
units.italian: "La tua specie ha mai incontrato gli Archon prima d'ora?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Nova Remnants|	He says, "One of the Archons [visited, appeared at] this world when we first settled here. It promised terrible [retribution, punishment] if we harmed either [faction? remnant?] of Korath survivors, and warned us of the [hostile, uncontrolled] robot drones. I have no doubt that they could [destroy, rend open] a star; they are beings [not entirely contained within this universe? extending into hidden dimensions?]. But the Archon who [spoke, communicated, interacted] with us did not seem [malicious, violent]."|180|0
units.english: He says, "One of the Archons [visited, appeared at] this world when we first settled here. It promised terrible [retribution, punishment] if we harmed either [faction? remnant?] of Korath survivors, and warned us of the [hostile, uncontrolled] robot drones. I have no doubt that they could [destroy, rend open] a star; they are beings [not entirely contained within this universe? extending into hidden dimensions?]. But the Archon who [spoke, communicated, interacted] with us did not seem [malicious, violent]."
units.italian: Dice: "Uno degli Archon [ha visitato, si è presentato su] questo mondo quando ci siamo stabiliti qui per la prima volta. Ha promesso una terribile [punizione, rappresaglia] se avessimo fatto del male a una delle due [fazioni? vestigia?] di sopravvissuti Korath, e ci ha messo in guardia dai droni robotici [ostili, incontrollati]. Non ho dubbi che potrebbero [distruggere, squarciare] una stella: sono esseri [non del tutto contenuti in questo universo? che si estendono in dimensioni nascoste?]. Ma l'Archon che ha [parlato, comunicato, interagito] con noi non sembrava [malvagio, violento]."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Nova Remnants|	"So, the Archons are living creatures? Not some sort of ship?"|182|0
units.english: "So, the Archons are living creatures? Not some sort of ship?"
units.italian: "Quindi gli Archon sono creature viventi? Non una specie di nave?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Nova Remnants|	"The Quarg say that the Drak are interested in keeping peace in the galaxy."|183|0
units.english: "The Quarg say that the Drak are interested in keeping peace in the galaxy."
units.italian: "I Quarg dicono che i Drak sono interessati a mantenere la pace nella galassia."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Nova Remnants|	He says, "They are partly [living, biological], partly [constructed, technological], and partly..." Whatever the third part is, the words for it are so far removed from human language that your translation device doesn't even attempt a guess at how to express them.|186|0
units.english: He says, "They are partly [living, biological], partly [constructed, technological], and partly..." Whatever the third part is, the words for it are so far removed from human language that your translation device doesn't even attempt a guess at how to express them.
units.italian: Dice: "Sono in parte [viventi, biologici], in parte [costruiti, tecnologici], e in parte..." Qualunque sia la terza parte, le parole per dirla sono così lontane dalla lingua umana che il tuo dispositivo di traduzione non tenta nemmeno di indovinare come esprimerle.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Nova Remnants|	You tell him, "The Quarg are a peaceful species, and they say the Drak are peacemakers as well. So perhaps we should not be too worried about their intentions."|187|0
units.english: You tell him, "The Quarg are a peaceful species, and they say the Drak are peacemakers as well. So perhaps we should not be too worried about their intentions."
units.italian: Gli dici: "I Quarg sono una specie pacifica, e dicono che anche i Drak sono pacificatori. Quindi forse non dovremmo preoccuparci troppo delle loro intenzioni."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Nova Remnants|	He says, "Even if that is so, [enforcing, maintaining] peace must sometimes require the use of [force, violence]. Also, have the Quarg [explained, revealed] to you who the Drak are? Are the Archons the Drak? Or were they [constructed? created? birthed?] by the Drak? The Archons do not appear to be a [naturally evolved species?]."|190|0
units.english: He says, "Even if that is so, [enforcing, maintaining] peace must sometimes require the use of [force, violence]. Also, have the Quarg [explained, revealed] to you who the Drak are? Are the Archons the Drak? Or were they [constructed? created? birthed?] by the Drak? The Archons do not appear to be a [naturally evolved species?]."
units.italian: Dice: "Anche se fosse così, [imporre, mantenere] la pace a volte richiede l'uso della [forza, violenza]. Inoltre, i Quarg ti hanno [spiegato, rivelato] chi sono i Drak? Gli Archon sono i Drak? Oppure sono stati [costruiti? creati? generati?] dai Drak? Gli Archon non sembrano una [specie evoluta naturalmente?]."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Nova Remnants|	He sits silently for a minute, then says, "The Archon that spoke with us said, 'I am an Archon.' It did not say, 'I am a Drak.' Have you ever [spoken, communed] with an Archon? Did it [call, name] itself a Drak?"|191|0
units.english: He sits silently for a minute, then says, "The Archon that spoke with us said, 'I am an Archon.' It did not say, 'I am a Drak.' Have you ever [spoken, communed] with an Archon? Did it [call, name] itself a Drak?"
units.italian: Resta seduto in silenzio per un minuto, poi dice: "L'Archon che ha parlato con noi ha detto: 'Io sono un Archon'. Non ha detto: 'Io sono un Drak'. Hai mai [parlato, comunicato] con un Archon? Si è [definito, chiamato] un Drak?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Nova Remnants|	"I don't think so."|193|0
units.english: "I don't think so."
units.italian: "Non credo proprio."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Nova Remnants|	"I think it did."|194|0
units.english: "I think it did."
units.italian: "Credo di sì."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Nova Remnants|	"I don't remember."|195|0
units.english: "I don't remember."
units.italian: "Non ricordo."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Nova Remnants|	"Interesting," he says. He promises to share any further information he obtains with you, and you thank him for his time.|197|0
units.english: "Interesting," he says. He promises to share any further information he obtains with you, and you thank him for his time.
units.italian: "Interessante," dice. Promette di condividere con te ogni altra informazione che otterrà, e lo ringrazi per il tempo che ti ha dedicato.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mereti Controller|name|203|0
units.english: Kor Mereti Controller
units.italian: Il controllore Kor Mereti

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mereti Controller|description|204|0
units.english: Board one of the Kor Mereti drones, find whatever component is controlling its actions, and bring that component back to the Wanderers on <planet>.
units.italian: Abborda uno dei droni Kor Mereti, trova il componente che ne controlla le azioni e riportalo ai Wanderers su <planet>.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mereti Controller|dialog|209|0
units.english: You have returned to <planet>, but you don't yet have a the component that is controlling the Kor Mereti drones. Depart and attempt to board one of the drones to plunder one.
units.italian: Sei tornato su <planet>, ma non hai ancora il componente che controlla i droni Kor Mereti. Riparti e prova ad abbordare uno dei droni per recuperarne uno.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mereti Controller|log|211|0
units.english: Discovered that the "Kor Mereti" drone ships are controlled by some sort of collective and decentralized artificial intelligence, with no obvious weaknesses.
units.italian: Hai scoperto che le navi drone "Kor Mereti" sono controllate da una specie di intelligenza artificiale collettiva e decentralizzata, senza punti deboli evidenti.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mereti Controller|You hand off the Reasoning Node that you recovered from a Kor Mereti drone to a team of Wanderer scientists. A few hours later they report back to you. "This is a very [robust, redundant] design," says the lead scientist. "Each of these nodes has enough [processing power? intelligence?] to control one of the drones, but they are also [linked, interconnected] via a hyperspace network. So, all the drones [communicate, confer] with each other and are capable of making [strategic decisions?] as a collective."|215|0
units.english: You hand off the Reasoning Node that you recovered from a Kor Mereti drone to a team of Wanderer scientists. A few hours later they report back to you. "This is a very [robust, redundant] design," says the lead scientist. "Each of these nodes has enough [processing power? intelligence?] to control one of the drones, but they are also [linked, interconnected] via a hyperspace network. So, all the drones [communicate, confer] with each other and are capable of making [strategic decisions?] as a collective."
units.italian: Consegni il Nodo di Ragionamento che hai recuperato da un drone Kor Mereti a una squadra di scienziati Wanderer. Dopo qualche ora ti riferiscono. "È un progetto molto [robusto, ridondante]," dice lo scienziato capo. "Ognuno di questi nodi ha [potenza di calcolo? intelligenza?] sufficiente a controllare uno dei droni, ma sono anche [collegati, interconnessi] tramite una rete iperspaziale. Quindi tutti i droni [comunicano, si consultano] fra loro e sono capaci di prendere [decisioni strategiche?] come collettivo."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mereti Controller|	"So no one is commanding the drones?"|217|0
units.english: "So no one is commanding the drones?"
units.italian: "Quindi nessuno comanda i droni?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mereti Controller|	"But without their communications network, they would lose much of their intelligence?"|218|0
units.english: "But without their communications network, they would lose much of their intelligence?"
units.italian: "Ma senza la loro rete di comunicazioni perderebbero gran parte della loro intelligenza?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mereti Controller|	"It appears not," he says. "Given the number of drones and the [complexity, sophistication] of their [computing equipment?], the collective is as intelligent as any [artificial mind?] that my own species has ever constructed."|220|0
units.english: "It appears not," he says. "Given the number of drones and the [complexity, sophistication] of their [computing equipment?], the collective is as intelligent as any [artificial mind?] that my own species has ever constructed."
units.italian: "Pare di no," dice. "Dato il numero di droni e la [complessità, sofisticazione] delle loro [apparecchiature di calcolo?], il collettivo è intelligente quanto qualsiasi [mente artificiale?] che la mia specie abbia mai costruito."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mereti Controller|	"Yes," he says, "but the network is very [redundant? decentralized?]. It could quickly adapt to any but the most [severe, catastrophic] interruption. It is a [beautiful? elegant?] design, similar to a [living system?]."|223|0
units.english: "Yes," he says, "but the network is very [redundant? decentralized?]. It could quickly adapt to any but the most [severe, catastrophic] interruption. It is a [beautiful? elegant?] design, similar to a [living system?]."
units.italian: "Sì," dice, "ma la rete è molto [ridondante? decentralizzata?]. Si adatterebbe rapidamente a qualsiasi interruzione, tranne alle più [gravi, catastrofiche]. È un progetto [bello? elegante?], simile a un [sistema vivente?]."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mereti Controller|	He tells you that the scientists will continue to examine the Reasoning Node and see if they can identify any weaknesses to exploit, but he does not sound hopeful. Which is too bad, because the Kor Mereti are a much more immediate threat to the Wanderers than the Kor Sestor.|225|0
units.english: He tells you that the scientists will continue to examine the Reasoning Node and see if they can identify any weaknesses to exploit, but he does not sound hopeful. Which is too bad, because the Kor Mereti are a much more immediate threat to the Wanderers than the Kor Sestor.
units.italian: Ti dice che gli scienziati continueranno a esaminare il Nodo di Ragionamento e a vedere se riescono a individuare punti deboli da sfruttare, ma non sembra ottimista. Il che è un peccato, perché i Kor Mereti sono una minaccia molto più immediata per i Wanderers dei Kor Sestor.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Controller|name|231|0
units.english: Kor Sestor Controller
units.italian: Il controllore Kor Sestor

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Controller|description|232|0
units.english: Board one of the Kor Sestor drones, find whatever component is controlling its actions, and bring that component back to the Wanderers on <planet>.
units.italian: Abborda uno dei droni Kor Sestor, trova il componente che ne controlla le azioni e riportalo ai Wanderers su <planet>.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Controller|dialog|237|0
units.english: You have returned to <planet>, but you don't yet have a the component that is controlling the Kor Sestor drones. Depart and attempt to board one of the drones to plunder one.
units.italian: Sei tornato su <planet>, ma non hai ancora il componente che controlla i droni Kor Sestor. Riparti e prova ad abbordare uno dei droni per recuperarne uno.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Controller|log|239|0
units.english: The "Kor Sestor" drones turn out to all be controlled remotely, presumably by either an artificial intelligence or by Korath leaders in hiding on one of their worlds. If the control center could be found, it would be possible to gain control of the entire Kor Sestor fleet.
units.italian: I droni "Kor Sestor" risultano tutti controllati a distanza, presumibilmente da un'intelligenza artificiale o da capi Korath nascosti su uno dei loro mondi. Se si trovasse il centro di controllo, sarebbe possibile prendere il comando dell'intera flotta Kor Sestor.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Controller|A team of Wanderer scientists examines the Control Transceiver that you salvaged from a Kor Sestor drone. "It is a remote control," they tell you. "Very little [computing power? autonomy?]. The ship receives [commands, directives] from some other source and sends back information on its own [status, observations]."|243|0
units.english: A team of Wanderer scientists examines the Control Transceiver that you salvaged from a Kor Sestor drone. "It is a remote control," they tell you. "Very little [computing power? autonomy?]. The ship receives [commands, directives] from some other source and sends back information on its own [status, observations]."
units.italian: Una squadra di scienziati Wanderer esamina il Ricetrasmettitore di Controllo che hai recuperato da un drone Kor Sestor. "È un telecomando," ti dicono. "Molto poca [potenza di calcolo? autonomia?]. La nave riceve [ordini, direttive] da qualche altra fonte e rimanda informazioni sul proprio [stato, osservazioni]."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Controller|	"Is there any way we could track the source of the commands?"|245|0
units.english: "Is there any way we could track the source of the commands?"
units.italian: "C'è un modo per risalire alla fonte degli ordini?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Controller|	"Could we disrupt their communications somehow? Render them helpless?"|246|0
units.english: "Could we disrupt their communications somehow? Render them helpless?"
units.italian: "Potremmo interrompere le loro comunicazioni in qualche modo? Renderli inermi?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Controller|	"No," says the scientist, "it uses an [entangled particle?]. Untraceable, impossible to [interrupt, interfere with], and it could [operate, communicate] over any distance. But if we could locate the [control center?], we would be able to [take over, hijack] all the drones simultaneously."|247|0
units.english: "No," says the scientist, "it uses an [entangled particle?]. Untraceable, impossible to [interrupt, interfere with], and it could [operate, communicate] over any distance. But if we could locate the [control center?], we would be able to [take over, hijack] all the drones simultaneously."
units.italian: "No," dice lo scienziato, "usa una [particella entangled?]. Impossibile da rintracciare, impossibile da [interrompere, disturbare], e può [funzionare, comunicare] a qualsiasi distanza. Ma se riuscissimo a localizzare il [centro di controllo?], potremmo [prendere il comando, dirottare] tutti i droni contemporaneamente."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Controller|	"What would the control center look like?" you ask.|248|0
units.english: "What would the control center look like?" you ask.
units.italian: "Che aspetto avrebbe il centro di controllo?" chiedi.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Controller|	"It could be anything," says the scientist. "Maybe a massive computer. Maybe an artificial mind. Maybe an underground [bunker, habitation] where aging [war captains, generals] hide out in order to direct their [pointless, futile] war. But whatever it is, it is a single [point, focus] of vulnerability, which we may use to our advantage."|249|0
units.english: "It could be anything," says the scientist. "Maybe a massive computer. Maybe an artificial mind. Maybe an underground [bunker, habitation] where aging [war captains, generals] hide out in order to direct their [pointless, futile] war. But whatever it is, it is a single [point, focus] of vulnerability, which we may use to our advantage."
units.italian: "Potrebbe essere qualsiasi cosa," dice lo scienziato. "Forse un enorme computer. Forse una mente artificiale. Forse un [bunker, insediamento] sotterraneo dove vecchi [capitani di guerra, generali] si nascondono per dirigere la loro [inutile, vana] guerra. Ma qualunque cosa sia, è un unico [punto, fulcro] di vulnerabilità, che potremmo sfruttare a nostro vantaggio."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: First Mereti Attack|name|267|0
units.english: Defend <planet>
units.italian: Difendi <planet>

units.id: mission:Wanderers: First Mereti Attack|description|268|0
units.english: The Wanderer base on <planet> is under attack by Kor Mereti drones. Help the Wanderers to drive them off, then return to the planet.
units.italian: La base dei Wanderers su <planet> è sotto attacco dei droni Kor Mereti. Aiuta i Wanderers a respingerli, poi torna sul pianeta.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: First Mereti Attack|While you are still walking back to your ship from your latest meeting, alarm sirens begin to sound, and you see many Wanderers leaping into the air and flying quickly toward the spaceport, where ships are quickly beginning to take off. (Interestingly, a Wanderer alarm siren sounds more like a quacking duck than like the shrieking or droning sounds commonly used as alarms by humans.) It would appear that the base is under attack.|278|0
units.english: While you are still walking back to your ship from your latest meeting, alarm sirens begin to sound, and you see many Wanderers leaping into the air and flying quickly toward the spaceport, where ships are quickly beginning to take off. (Interestingly, a Wanderer alarm siren sounds more like a quacking duck than like the shrieking or droning sounds commonly used as alarms by humans.) It would appear that the base is under attack.
units.italian: Mentre stai ancora tornando alla tua nave dall'ultimo incontro, cominciano a suonare le sirene d'allarme, e vedi molti Wanderers saltare in aria e volare in fretta verso lo spazioporto, dove le navi cominciano a decollare in fretta. (Curiosamente, la sirena d'allarme dei Wanderers somiglia più al verso di un'anatra che agli stridii o ai ronzii che gli umani usano di solito come allarme.) Sembra che la base sia sotto attacco.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: First Mereti Attack|	You return as quickly as possible to your ship and prepare to join the other defenders...|279|0
units.english: You return as quickly as possible to your ship and prepare to join the other defenders...
units.italian: Torni il più in fretta possibile alla tua nave e ti prepari a unirti agli altri difensori...

units.id: mission:Wanderers: First Mereti Attack|dialog|282|0
units.english: There are still Kor Mereti drones circling overhead. You should help the Wanderers to drive them off.
units.italian: Ci sono ancora droni Kor Mereti che girano là sopra. Dovresti aiutare i Wanderers a respingerli.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: First Mereti Attack|dialog|296|0
units.english: As the last of the Kor Mereti raiding party is destroyed, you receive a message from Sobari Tele'ek. "Please join us at the [base, settlement] as soon as you are able to," he says. "We will need to [agree, decide] on a strategy to deal with these [robots, drones] in case their attacks grow worse."
units.italian: Mentre l'ultimo gruppo di razziatori Kor Mereti viene distrutto, ricevi un messaggio da Sobari Tele'ek. "Unisciti a noi alla [base, sede] appena puoi," dice. "Dovremo [concordare, decidere] una strategia per affrontare questi [robot, droni], nel caso i loro attacchi peggiorino."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Rek To Kor Efret|name|327|0
units.english: Bring Rek to <planet>
units.italian: Porta Rek su <planet>

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Rek To Kor Efret|description|328|0
units.english: Bring Rek, who has survived the Molt and taken on a new form, to try to communicate with the Kor Efret on <destination>.
units.italian: Porta Rek, che è sopravvissuta alla Muta e ha assunto una nuova forma, a tentare di comunicare con i Kor Efret su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Rek To Kor Efret|blocked|333|0
units.english: You will need room for a passenger in order to take on the next Wanderer mission.
units.italian: Ti serve spazio per un passeggero per accettare la prossima missione dei Wanderers.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Rek To Kor Efret|log|337|0
units.english: Iktat Rek has survived the Molt, but in a completely new form. Rek is now female, and is only the size of a Wanderer child, and has chosen the name "Ektasi Rek" for herself, meaning something like "communicator" or "bridge-builder."
units.italian: Iktat Rek è sopravvissuta alla Muta, ma in una forma completamente nuova. Rek ora è femmina, è alta quanto un cucciolo Wanderer e ha scelto per sé il nome "Ektasi Rek", che significa qualcosa come "comunicatrice" o "costruttrice di ponti".

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Rek To Kor Efret|log|338|0
units.english: Rek underwent the Molt, a mysterious process in which the body of a Wanderer who is exposed to novel stimuli transforms into a completely new species while still maintaining that individual's memories and personality. The new Rek is a female and goes by the name "Ektasi Rek."
units.italian: Rek ha subito la Muta, un processo misterioso in cui il corpo di un Wanderer esposto a stimoli nuovi si trasforma in una specie completamente nuova, mantenendo però i ricordi e la personalità di quell'individuo. La nuova Rek è femmina e si fa chiamare "Ektasi Rek".

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Rek To Kor Efret|log|339|0
units.english: Ektasi Rek is the first Wanderer in millennia to undergo the Molt, changing into a completely different species with new capabilities. As more Wanderers go through the Molt, the Wanderers as a whole will have to decide which of these mutations represents the best way for their species to survive and flourish in Korath space.
units.italian: Ektasi Rek è la prima Wanderer in millenni a subire la Muta, trasformandosi in una specie del tutto diversa con nuove capacità. Man mano che altri Wanderers attraverseranno la Muta, i Wanderers nel loro insieme dovranno decidere quale di queste mutazioni rappresenti il modo migliore perché la loro specie sopravviva e fiorisca nello spazio Korath.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Rek To Kor Efret|When you enter the meeting room, Sobari Tele'ek is in a heated argument with the Wanderer child who was here earlier, the one who speaks your language. The child is saying, "The Eye has sent us not to a place of [empty, abandoned] worlds but to a place of [living beings?]. To complete our [calling, work] here we must collaborate with those beings, just as we would collaborate with the [ecosystem? personality?] of a planet we sought to repair."|341|0
units.english: When you enter the meeting room, Sobari Tele'ek is in a heated argument with the Wanderer child who was here earlier, the one who speaks your language. The child is saying, "The Eye has sent us not to a place of [empty, abandoned] worlds but to a place of [living beings?]. To complete our [calling, work] here we must collaborate with those beings, just as we would collaborate with the [ecosystem? personality?] of a planet we sought to repair."
units.italian: Quando entri nella sala della riunione, Sobari Tele'ek sta discutendo animatamente con il cucciolo Wanderer che era qui prima, quello che parla la tua lingua. Il cucciolo sta dicendo: "L'Occhio non ci ha condotti in un luogo di mondi [vuoti, abbandonati], ma in un luogo di [esseri viventi?]. Per completare qui la nostra [vocazione, opera] dobbiamo collaborare con quegli esseri, come collaboreremmo con [l'ecosistema? la personalità?] di un pianeta che volessimo riparare."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Rek To Kor Efret|	"What do you [propose, intend], Firstborn?" asks Tele'ek.|342|0
units.english: "What do you [propose, intend], Firstborn?" asks Tele'ek.
units.italian: "Che cosa [proponi, intendi fare], Primogenita?" chiede Tele'ek.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Rek To Kor Efret|	"I would visit the [remaining, surviving] Korath," she says. "I would learn their [language? viewpoint? history?]. I would offer them our [companionship, assistance]."|343|0
units.english: "I would visit the [remaining, surviving] Korath," she says. "I would learn their [language? viewpoint? history?]. I would offer them our [companionship, assistance]."
units.italian: "Vorrei far visita ai Korath [superstiti, rimasti]," dice. "Vorrei imparare la loro [lingua? visione? storia?]. Vorrei offrire loro la nostra [compagnia, assistenza]."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Rek To Kor Efret|	"No," says Tele'ek. "How could I [endanger, gamble with] your life? You are too [precious, unique] to be sent on such a [mission, assignment]."|344|0
units.english: "No," says Tele'ek. "How could I [endanger, gamble with] your life? You are too [precious, unique] to be sent on such a [mission, assignment]."
units.italian: "No," dice Tele'ek. "Come potrei [mettere in pericolo, rischiare] la tua vita? Sei troppo [preziosa, unica] perché ti si mandi in una [missione, impresa] simile."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Rek To Kor Efret|	"You cannot command me," she says.|345|0
units.english: "You cannot command me," she says.
units.italian: "Non puoi darmi ordini," dice lei.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Rek To Kor Efret|	"Until you are [fully formed? complete?] I can," he says.|346|0
units.english: "Until you are [fully formed? complete?] I can," he says.
units.italian: "Finché non sarai [pienamente formata? completa?] posso," dice lui.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Rek To Kor Efret|	(Interrupt the argument to report on the Kor Mereti attack.)|348|0
units.english: (Interrupt the argument to report on the Kor Mereti attack.)
units.italian: (Interrompi la discussione per riferire dell'attacco Kor Mereti.)

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Rek To Kor Efret|	(Let them continue talking.)|349|0
units.english: (Let them continue talking.)
units.italian: (Lascia che continuino a parlare.)

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Rek To Kor Efret|	You interrupt to begin describing how the Kor Mereti attack was driven off, but as you are talking the Wanderer child leaps off her seat and hops over to perch near the head of the table. "I name myself," she says, quietly.|352|0
units.english: You interrupt to begin describing how the Kor Mereti attack was driven off, but as you are talking the Wanderer child leaps off her seat and hops over to perch near the head of the table. "I name myself," she says, quietly.
units.italian: Intervieni per cominciare a descrivere come è stato respinto l'attacco Kor Mereti, ma mentre parli il cucciolo Wanderer salta giù dal suo posto e saltella fino a posarsi vicino alla testa del tavolo. "Io nomino me stessa," dice, piano.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Rek To Kor Efret|	The Wanderer child draws herself up to her full height (which, admittedly, is still not terribly impressive), and says quietly, "I name myself."|356|0
units.english: The Wanderer child draws herself up to her full height (which, admittedly, is still not terribly impressive), and says quietly, "I name myself."
units.italian: Il cucciolo Wanderer si alza in tutta la sua altezza (che, va detto, resta comunque non certo imponente) e dice piano: "Io nomino me stessa."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Rek To Kor Efret|	Instantly all other conversation in the room stops. Based on what Iktat Rek told you, a Wanderer child becomes an adult in the moment when she chooses a role-name for herself. "I name myself [communicator, ambassador, bridge-builder]," she says. "Captain <last> will take me to [live with, join] the peaceful Korath."|359|0
units.english: Instantly all other conversation in the room stops. Based on what Iktat Rek told you, a Wanderer child becomes an adult in the moment when she chooses a role-name for herself. "I name myself [communicator, ambassador, bridge-builder]," she says. "Captain <last> will take me to [live with, join] the peaceful Korath."
units.italian: Improvvisamente ogni altra conversazione nella stanza si ferma. Da quello che ti aveva raccontato Iktat Rek, un cucciolo Wanderer diventa adulto nel momento in cui sceglie per sé un nome di ruolo. "Io nomino me stessa [comunicatrice, ambasciatrice, costruttrice di ponti]," dice. "Il Capitano <last> mi porterà a [vivere con, unirmi a] i Korath pacifici."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Rek To Kor Efret|	To your surprise, Tele'ek agrees to let her go after giving her one last warning to be careful. She walks and flutter-hops at your heels as you return to your ship; apparently she has no need of any luggage.|360|0
units.english: To your surprise, Tele'ek agrees to let her go after giving her one last warning to be careful. She walks and flutter-hops at your heels as you return to your ship; apparently she has no need of any luggage.
units.italian: Con tua sorpresa, Tele'ek accetta di lasciarla andare dopo averle dato un ultimo avvertimento a stare attenta. Lei cammina e saltella alle tue calcagna mentre torni alla nave; a quanto pare non ha bisogno di bagagli.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Rek To Kor Efret|	"I'm glad to be transporting you. What should I call you?"|362|0
units.english: "I'm glad to be transporting you. What should I call you?"
units.italian: "Sono contento di trasportarti. Come devo chiamarti?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Rek To Kor Efret|	"I'm surprised your father gave you permission to do this."|363|0
units.english: "I'm surprised your father gave you permission to do this."
units.italian: "Mi sorprende che tuo padre ti abbia dato il permesso di farlo."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Rek To Kor Efret|	She cocks her head quizzically at you. "You do not know who I am?" she says. Now that you are out of the meeting, she is once more speaking to you in your own language.|366|0
units.english: She cocks her head quizzically at you. "You do not know who I am?" she says. Now that you are out of the meeting, she is once more speaking to you in your own language.
units.italian: Inclina la testa di lato, perplessa. "Non sai chi sono?" dice. Ora che siete fuori dalla riunione, torna a parlarti nella tua lingua.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Rek To Kor Efret|	"No, I don't," you say.|367|0
units.english: "No, I don't," you say.
units.italian: "No, non lo so," dici.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Rek To Kor Efret|	She looks confused. "Tele'ek is not my father," she says. "I am my own father." Now that you are out of the meeting, she is once more speaking to you in your own language.|371|0
units.english: She looks confused. "Tele'ek is not my father," she says. "I am my own father." Now that you are out of the meeting, she is once more speaking to you in your own language.
units.italian: Sembra confusa. "Tele'ek non è mio padre," dice. "Sono mio padre io stessa." Ora che siete fuori dalla riunione, torna a parlarti nella tua lingua.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Rek To Kor Efret|	"What do you mean?" you ask.|372|0
units.english: "What do you mean?" you ask.
units.italian: "Che cosa vuoi dire?" chiedi.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Rek To Kor Efret|	"After all our work together, you do not recognize me?" she asks. "I am Ektasi Rek i' Rek." It takes you a moment to realize that she is not claiming to be Rek's daughter. She is claiming to be "Rek, who came from Rek." She is Rek himself. Or apparently, now, herself. Alien biology is full of surprises.|375|0
units.english: "After all our work together, you do not recognize me?" she asks. "I am Ektasi Rek i' Rek." It takes you a moment to realize that she is not claiming to be Rek's daughter. She is claiming to be "Rek, who came from Rek." She is Rek himself. Or apparently, now, herself. Alien biology is full of surprises.
units.italian: "Dopo tutto il lavoro fatto insieme, non mi riconosci?" chiede. "Sono Ektasi Rek i' Rek." Ti serve un momento per capire che non sta dicendo di essere la figlia di Rek. Sta dicendo di essere "Rek, che è venuta da Rek". È Rek stesso. O apparentemente, ora, se stessa. La biologia aliena è piena di sorprese.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Rek To Kor Efret|	"Rek! You survived the Molt! Why did no one tell me?"|377|0
units.english: "Rek! You survived the Molt! Why did no one tell me?"
units.italian: "Rek! Sei sopravvissuta alla Muta! Perché nessuno me l'ha detto?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Rek To Kor Efret|	"Wait, you're female now?"|378|0
units.english: "Wait, you're female now?"
units.italian: "Aspetta, ora sei femmina?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Rek To Kor Efret|	She says, "Things got a bit chaotic when the Eye opened." You're not sure if that's the full truth, or if Rek was just enjoying playing a trick on you and waiting to see how long you would take to catch on.|381|0
units.english: She says, "Things got a bit chaotic when the Eye opened." You're not sure if that's the full truth, or if Rek was just enjoying playing a trick on you and waiting to see how long you would take to catch on.
units.italian: Dice: "Le cose si sono un po' confuse quando l'Occhio si è aperto." Non sei sicuro che sia tutta la verità, o se Rek si stesse solo divertendo a farti uno scherzo e ad aspettare quanto ci avresti messo a capirlo.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Rek To Kor Efret|	She laughs. "I'm not even technically the same species that I was before. A change in gender is minor compared to that." It's hard to read Wanderer facial expressions, but she seems to be thoroughly enjoying how confused you are.|385|0
units.english: She laughs. "I'm not even technically the same species that I was before. A change in gender is minor compared to that." It's hard to read Wanderer facial expressions, but she seems to be thoroughly enjoying how confused you are.
units.italian: Ride. "Tecnicamente non sono nemmeno più la stessa specie di prima. Un cambio di sesso è poca cosa al confronto." È difficile leggere le espressioni dei Wanderers, ma sembra divertirsi moltissimo nel vederti confuso.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Rek To Kor Efret|	Rek has no trouble finding the bunk rooms, and cheerfully settles in while you prepare for the journey to <planet>.|388|0
units.english: Rek has no trouble finding the bunk rooms, and cheerfully settles in while you prepare for the journey to <planet>.
units.italian: Rek non ha problemi a trovare le cabine, e si sistema allegramente mentre tu ti prepari al viaggio verso <planet>.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Rek To Kor Efret|dialog|391|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Rek hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it to arrive.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta che porta Rek non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Quarg Assistance 1|name|397|0
units.english: Quarg Assistance
units.italian: Assistenza dei Quarg

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Quarg Assistance 1|description|398|0
units.english: Ektasi Rek suggested that you should visit the Quarg and ask if they can help defend the Wanderers from Kor Mereti attacks.
units.italian: Ektasi Rek ti ha suggerito di andare dai Quarg e chiedere se possono aiutare a difendere i Wanderers dagli attacchi dei Kor Mereti.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Quarg Assistance 1|log|405|0
units.english: Rek's metamorphosis seems to have given her enhanced ability to understand other languages. She will be staying with the friendly Korath for a while in order to learn how to communicate with them.
units.italian: La metamorfosi di Rek sembra averle dato una capacità accresciuta di capire le altre lingue. Resterà per un po' con i Korath amichevoli per imparare a comunicare con loro.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Quarg Assistance 1|log|406|0
units.english: Rek's Molt has given her enhanced ability not only to understand alien speech, but to mimic the sound of it as well.
units.italian: La Muta ha dato a Rek la capacità non solo di capire il parlato alieno, ma anche di imitarne il suono.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Quarg Assistance 1|Soon after you and Ektasi Rek land in the Kor Efret spaceport, a small group of Korath gathers around you. No doubt they realize that Rek is one of the new aliens settling in their former territory. But when Rek begins trying to communicate with them, their desire to be understood overcomes whatever hostility they might be feeling.|408|0
units.english: Soon after you and Ektasi Rek land in the Kor Efret spaceport, a small group of Korath gathers around you. No doubt they realize that Rek is one of the new aliens settling in their former territory. But when Rek begins trying to communicate with them, their desire to be understood overcomes whatever hostility they might be feeling.
units.italian: Poco dopo che tu ed Ektasi Rek atterrate nello spazioporto dei Kor Efret, un piccolo gruppo di Korath si raduna intorno a voi. Senza dubbio capiscono che Rek è una delle nuove aliene che si stanno stabilendo nel loro ex territorio. Ma quando Rek comincia a cercare di comunicare con loro, il desiderio di essere capiti vince su qualsiasi ostilità possano provare.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Quarg Assistance 1|	Within a few minutes Rek is playing a sort of game with them where she points at different objects, trying to learn their names, and then uses those names in sentences: This is a table. Rek is on the table. Rek stands on the table. The table is under Rek. The color of the table is black. The color of the table is the same as the color of Rek.|409|0
units.english: Within a few minutes Rek is playing a sort of game with them where she points at different objects, trying to learn their names, and then uses those names in sentences: This is a table. Rek is on the table. Rek stands on the table. The table is under Rek. The color of the table is black. The color of the table is the same as the color of Rek.
units.italian: Nel giro di pochi minuti Rek sta facendo con loro una specie di gioco: indica oggetti diversi, cerca di impararne i nomi, e poi usa quei nomi in frasi: Questo è un tavolo. Rek è sul tavolo. Rek sta in piedi sul tavolo. Il tavolo è sotto Rek. Il colore del tavolo è nero. Il colore del tavolo è lo stesso colore di Rek.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Quarg Assistance 1|	The Korath wave their hands approvingly when Rek says something they agree with, and hiss when she makes a grammatical mistake. The new words and new parts of speech are coming too fast for you to catch more than the general gist of what is going on, but Rek is drinking it all in. She looks so happy and full of life that it's hard to believe that she is the same person you said goodbye to in the medical center months ago.|410|0
units.english: The Korath wave their hands approvingly when Rek says something they agree with, and hiss when she makes a grammatical mistake. The new words and new parts of speech are coming too fast for you to catch more than the general gist of what is going on, but Rek is drinking it all in. She looks so happy and full of life that it's hard to believe that she is the same person you said goodbye to in the medical center months ago.
units.italian: I Korath agitano le mani in segno di approvazione quando Rek dice qualcosa con cui sono d'accordo, e sibilano quando fa un errore di grammatica. Le parole nuove e le nuove parti del discorso arrivano troppo in fretta perché tu possa cogliere più del senso generale, ma Rek assorbe tutto. Sembra così felice e piena di vita che è difficile credere che sia la stessa persona da cui ti sei congedato nel centro medico mesi fa.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Quarg Assistance 1|	After about an hour Rek says something to the group of Korath, and then walks over to you.|411|0
units.english: After about an hour Rek says something to the group of Korath, and then walks over to you.
units.italian: Dopo circa un'ora Rek dice qualcosa al gruppo di Korath, poi si avvicina a te.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Quarg Assistance 1|	"You look like you're making amazing progress!"|413|0
units.english: "You look like you're making amazing progress!"
units.italian: "Sembra che tu stia facendo progressi incredibili!"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Quarg Assistance 1|	"What do you want me to do now?"|414|0
units.english: "What do you want me to do now?"
units.italian: "Che cosa vuoi che faccia adesso?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Quarg Assistance 1|	She seems very pleased with herself. "I think the Molt has given me the mental plasticity of a child again," she says. "This is almost as easy as breathing. But it will take me a while before I understand the subtleties of their language well enough to communicate anything of great importance." It's a bit disconcerting that her vocal organs are somehow able to so perfectly reproduce both the sibilant Korath language and your own human language, in addition to the glottal and percussive sounds of Wanderer speech. And the Hai language as well, for that matter.|417|0
units.english: She seems very pleased with herself. "I think the Molt has given me the mental plasticity of a child again," she says. "This is almost as easy as breathing. But it will take me a while before I understand the subtleties of their language well enough to communicate anything of great importance." It's a bit disconcerting that her vocal organs are somehow able to so perfectly reproduce both the sibilant Korath language and your own human language, in addition to the glottal and percussive sounds of Wanderer speech. And the Hai language as well, for that matter.
units.italian: Sembra molto soddisfatta di sé. "Credo che la Muta mi abbia ridato la plasticità mentale di un cucciolo," dice. "È quasi facile come respirare. Ma mi ci vorrà un po' prima di capire le sottigliezze della loro lingua abbastanza bene da comunicare qualcosa di davvero importante." È un po' inquietante che i suoi organi vocali riescano a riprodurre così perfettamente sia la lingua sibilante dei Korath sia la tua lingua umana, oltre ai suoni glottidali e percussivi del parlato dei Wanderers. E anche la lingua Hai, già che ci siamo.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Quarg Assistance 1|	"So," you ask, "what should I do while you're here learning the language?"|418|0
units.english: "So," you ask, "what should I do while you're here learning the language?"
units.italian: "Allora," chiedi, "che cosa devo fare mentre sei qui a imparare la lingua?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Quarg Assistance 1|	She says, "I'm worried about the Kor Mereti making another attack on my people. Do you think the Quarg would be willing to help protect us?"|421|0
units.english: She says, "I'm worried about the Kor Mereti making another attack on my people. Do you think the Quarg would be willing to help protect us?"
units.italian: Dice: "Mi preoccupa che i Kor Mereti sferrino un altro attacco alla mia gente. Credi che i Quarg sarebbero disposti ad aiutarci a proteggerci?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Quarg Assistance 1|	You agree that it's worth a try. She suggests that you visit the Quarg ringworld and try to find someone with the authority to send a defense fleet to guard the Wanderer settlement.|422|0
units.english: You agree that it's worth a try. She suggests that you visit the Quarg ringworld and try to find someone with the authority to send a defense fleet to guard the Wanderer settlement.
units.italian: Concordi che vale la pena provare. Ti suggerisce di visitare il mondo ad anello dei Quarg e cercare qualcuno con l'autorità per inviare una flotta di difesa a proteggere l'insediamento dei Wanderers.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Quarg Assistance 2|name|429|0
units.english: Quarg Assistance
units.italian: Assistenza dei Quarg

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Quarg Assistance 2|description|430|0
units.english: Escort a Quarg fleet that has agreed to help protect the Wanderers back to <destination>.
units.italian: Scorta fino a <destination> una flotta dei Quarg che ha accettato di aiutare a proteggere i Wanderers.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Quarg Assistance 2|log|437|0
units.english: The Quarg (or possibly, a faction within the Quarg, or even just a group of Quarg acting on their own) have agreed to send three of their warships to help defend the Wanderer settlement in Korath space. (Or maybe they are sending the ships because they view the Wanderers as invaders and want to keep an eye on them. It is not easy to determine their true intentions.)
units.italian: I Quarg (o forse una fazione interna ai Quarg, o addirittura solo un gruppo di Quarg che agisce per conto proprio) hanno accettato di inviare tre delle loro navi da guerra per aiutare a difendere l'insediamento dei Wanderers nello spazio Korath. (O forse mandano le navi perché considerano i Wanderers degli invasori e vogliono tenerli d'occhio. Non è facile capire le loro vere intenzioni.)

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Quarg Assistance 2|log|438|0
units.english: According to the Quarg, the Wanderers are not native to this galaxy, but were brought here from somewhere else (presumably by the Pug).
units.italian: Secondo i Quarg, i Wanderers non sono originari di questa galassia, ma sono stati portati qui da altrove (presumibilmente dai Pug).

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Quarg Assistance 2|The Quarg do not generally share any information on how their leadership hierarchy works, if such a hierarchy even exists, so your best bet to find help for the Wanderers is just to ask around until you find the right person. You flag down the first Quarg who passes you in the hallway. "So," it says, "us the Quarg the human sojourner has come to visit. Of assistance how may I be?"|440|0
units.english: The Quarg do not generally share any information on how their leadership hierarchy works, if such a hierarchy even exists, so your best bet to find help for the Wanderers is just to ask around until you find the right person. You flag down the first Quarg who passes you in the hallway. "So," it says, "us the Quarg the human sojourner has come to visit. Of assistance how may I be?"
units.italian: I Quarg in genere non condividono alcuna informazione su come funzioni la loro gerarchia di comando, se una gerarchia del genere esiste, quindi il modo migliore per trovare aiuto per i Wanderers è chiedere in giro finché non trovi la persona giusta. Fermi il primo Quarg che ti passa accanto nel corridoio. "Dunque," dice, "a noi Quarg l'umano viandante è venuto in visita. Di quale aiuto posso essere?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Quarg Assistance 2|	"Well," you say, "I'm here on behalf of a species that has recently settled on one of the abandoned Korath worlds. I'm hoping you can help protect them."|441|0
units.english: "Well," you say, "I'm here on behalf of a species that has recently settled on one of the abandoned Korath worlds. I'm hoping you can help protect them."
units.italian: "Beh," dici, "sono qui a nome di una specie che si è stabilita di recente su uno dei mondi Korath abbandonati. Spero che possiate aiutare a proteggerli."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Quarg Assistance 2|	It says, "Yes, aware are we that befriended have you the eternally drifting Wanderers, who are friends of the insufferable Pug. But wherefore aid them should we?"|442|0
units.english: It says, "Yes, aware are we that befriended have you the eternally drifting Wanderers, who are friends of the insufferable Pug. But wherefore aid them should we?"
units.italian: Dice: "Sì, consapevoli noi siamo che hai fatto amicizia con gli eternamente vaganti Wanderers, che sono amici degli insopportabili Pug. Ma perché aiutarli dovremmo?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Quarg Assistance 2|	"The Wanderers know how to repair planetary ecosystems. They could make the Korath worlds livable again."|444|0
units.english: "The Wanderers know how to repair planetary ecosystems. They could make the Korath worlds livable again."
units.italian: "I Wanderers sanno riparare gli ecosistemi planetari. Potrebbero rendere di nuovo abitabili i mondi Korath."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Quarg Assistance 2|	"The Wanderers may be able to help you deal with the hostile automata."|445|0
units.english: "The Wanderers may be able to help you deal with the hostile automata."
units.italian: "I Wanderers potrebbero aiutarvi a gestire gli automi ostili."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Quarg Assistance 2|	"Are they able also to make the Korathi worthy to inhabit those worlds again? Are they able to make wise enough the Korathi to not ruin their homes once more? Or do the abilities of these extragalactic interlopers not extend so far?"|448|0
units.english: "Are they able also to make the Korathi worthy to inhabit those worlds again? Are they able to make wise enough the Korathi to not ruin their homes once more? Or do the abilities of these extragalactic interlopers not extend so far?"
units.italian: "Sono in grado anche di rendere i Korath degni di abitare di nuovo quei mondi? Sono in grado di rendere i Korath abbastanza saggi da non rovinare ancora le loro case? O le capacità di questi intrusi extragalattici non arrivano così lontano?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Quarg Assistance 2|	"Are their vessels and arms mightier than ours?" asks the Quarg. "Have they a wisdom vaster than our own? Or are they more numerous than we? For we are trillions. What could these extragalactic interlopers achieve, that long before your emergence attempted have we not?"|452|0
