units.english: "Are their vessels and arms mightier than ours?" asks the Quarg. "Have they a wisdom vaster than our own? Or are they more numerous than we? For we are trillions. What could these extragalactic interlopers achieve, that long before your emergence attempted have we not?"
units.italian: "Le loro navi e le loro armi sono più potenti delle nostre?" chiede il Quarg. "Hanno una saggezza più vasta della nostra? O sono più numerosi di noi? Perché noi siamo trilioni. Che cosa potrebbero ottenere questi intrusi extragalattici che noi, molto prima che voi compariste, non abbiamo già tentato?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Quarg Assistance 2|	When you don't respond, the Quarg continues, "These Wanderers are not indigenous to our galaxy, and thus have not we an obligation to avert their extinction. The Korathi are our charge and our responsibility. So implore I you to tell me, why a good thing for the Korathi it is that their shattered territory these aliens invade."|455|0
units.english: When you don't respond, the Quarg continues, "These Wanderers are not indigenous to our galaxy, and thus have not we an obligation to avert their extinction. The Korathi are our charge and our responsibility. So implore I you to tell me, why a good thing for the Korathi it is that their shattered territory these aliens invade."
units.italian: Quando non rispondi, il Quarg continua: "Questi Wanderers non sono indigeni della nostra galassia, e quindi non abbiamo l'obbligo di scongiurarne l'estinzione. I Korath sono il nostro compito e la nostra responsabilità. Ti prego dunque di dirmi perché sia una buona cosa per i Korath che questi alieni invadano il loro territorio in frantumi."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Quarg Assistance 2|	"The Wanderers could help the Korath by teaching them to take care of their worlds better."|457|0
units.english: "The Wanderers could help the Korath by teaching them to take care of their worlds better."
units.italian: "I Wanderers potrebbero aiutare i Korath insegnando loro a prendersi meglio cura dei loro mondi."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Quarg Assistance 2|	"The Wanderers don't want to stay here forever; they will move on once the worlds are repaired."|458|0
units.english: "The Wanderers don't want to stay here forever; they will move on once the worlds are repaired."
units.italian: "I Wanderers non vogliono restare qui per sempre; andranno altrove una volta riparati i mondi."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Quarg Assistance 2|	The Quarg blinks slowly, with its strange eyelids moving from side to side rather than top to bottom. Then it says, "Grant you shall we three warships to with you travel back to the settlement of these friends of the loathsome Pug. They will help to keep the death-bringing robots at bay. And oversee will they the Wanderers, and judge if as benevolent as you say are they."|460|0
units.english: The Quarg blinks slowly, with its strange eyelids moving from side to side rather than top to bottom. Then it says, "Grant you shall we three warships to with you travel back to the settlement of these friends of the loathsome Pug. They will help to keep the death-bringing robots at bay. And oversee will they the Wanderers, and judge if as benevolent as you say are they."
units.italian: Il Quarg sbatte le palpebre lentamente, con le sue strane palpebre che si muovono di lato invece che dall'alto in basso. Poi dice: "Concedere noi vi dovremo tre navi da guerra che con voi torneranno all'insediamento di questi amici degli spregevoli Pug. Aiuteranno a tenere a bada i robot portatori di morte. E sorveglieranno i Wanderers, e giudicheranno se davvero benevoli come tu dici sono."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Quarg Assistance 2|	It is extremely strange that the first random Quarg you accosted in the hallway happened to be one with the authority to launch a fleet of warships, but it would be impolite to question such a generous, if extremely verbose offer. You thank the Quarg and return to your ship. Hopefully the Wanderers will be glad for the protection and will not object to having a Quarg fleet overhead scrutinizing their actions.|461|0
units.english: It is extremely strange that the first random Quarg you accosted in the hallway happened to be one with the authority to launch a fleet of warships, but it would be impolite to question such a generous, if extremely verbose offer. You thank the Quarg and return to your ship. Hopefully the Wanderers will be glad for the protection and will not object to having a Quarg fleet overhead scrutinizing their actions.
units.italian: È estremamente strano che il primo Quarg a caso che hai fermato nel corridoio sia proprio uno con l'autorità di inviare una flotta di navi da guerra, ma sarebbe scortese mettere in dubbio un'offerta così generosa, anche se estremamente verbosa. Ringrazi il Quarg e torni alla tua nave. Si spera che i Wanderers siano contenti della protezione e non si offendano per una flotta dei Quarg sopra la testa che scruta le loro azioni.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Quarg Assistance 2|dialog|464|0
units.english: You've reached <planet>, but you left one of the Quarg ships behind. Better depart and wait for it to arrive.
units.italian: Hai raggiunto <planet>, ma hai lasciato indietro una delle navi dei Quarg. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Pug Assistance 1|name|492|0
units.english: Pug Assistance
units.italian: Assistenza dei Pug

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Pug Assistance 1|description|493|0
units.english: The Wanderers are thankful for the protection of the Quarg, but hope that the Pug on <planet> will be willing to send warships to protect them as well.
units.italian: I Wanderers sono grati per la protezione dei Quarg, ma sperano che i Pug su <planet> siano disposti a inviare navi da guerra per proteggerli.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Pug Assistance 1|When you arrive at the Wanderer settlement with three Quarg warships in tow, you are met with a mix of gratitude and apprehension. The senior leaders insist on meeting with you immediately, and you explain how you delivered Rek to Kor Efret space and then visited the Quarg to ask for their assistance. Tele'ek asks you, "These Quarg, what are their [intentions, inclinations] toward us? And do they understand that we seek to [heal, renew] these worlds, not to steal them from the Korath?"|502|0
units.english: When you arrive at the Wanderer settlement with three Quarg warships in tow, you are met with a mix of gratitude and apprehension. The senior leaders insist on meeting with you immediately, and you explain how you delivered Rek to Kor Efret space and then visited the Quarg to ask for their assistance. Tele'ek asks you, "These Quarg, what are their [intentions, inclinations] toward us? And do they understand that we seek to [heal, renew] these worlds, not to steal them from the Korath?"
units.italian: Quando arrivi all'insediamento dei Wanderers con tre navi da guerra dei Quarg al seguito, vieni accolto con una mescolanza di gratitudine e apprensione. I capi più anziani insistono per incontrarti subito, e tu spieghi come hai portato Rek nello spazio Kor Efret e poi sei andato dai Quarg a chiedere aiuto. Tele'ek ti chiede: "Questi Quarg, quali sono le loro [intenzioni, inclinazioni] verso di noi? E capiscono che vogliamo [guarire, rigenerare] questi mondi, non rubarli ai Korath?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Pug Assistance 1|	"The Quarg avoid conflict unless absolutely necessary. If you show that you are peaceful, they will come to trust you."|504|0
units.english: "The Quarg avoid conflict unless absolutely necessary. If you show that you are peaceful, they will come to trust you."
units.italian: "I Quarg evitano il conflitto a meno che non sia assolutamente necessario. Se mostrate di essere pacifici, finiranno per fidarsi di voi."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Pug Assistance 1|	"I think the Quarg are worried that you are going to displace the surviving Korath."|506|0
units.english: "I think the Quarg are worried that you are going to displace the surviving Korath."
units.italian: "Credo che i Quarg temano che finirete per soppiantare i Korath superstiti."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Pug Assistance 1|	"The Quarg don't trust you because you're connected to the Pug. They also say you aren't native to this galaxy."|508|0
units.english: "The Quarg don't trust you because you're connected to the Pug. They also say you aren't native to this galaxy."
units.italian: "I Quarg non si fidano di voi perché siete legati ai Pug. Dicono anche che non siete originari di questa galassia."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Pug Assistance 1|	"Well," says Tele'ek, "if they really [desire, hope] for these worlds to be [fruitful, habitable] once more, the best thing we can do is prove our [value, virtue] by beginning our work. We are a [patient, deliberate] species too, and we understand that gaining the [trust, goodwill] of another may take time."|512|0
units.english: "Well," says Tele'ek, "if they really [desire, hope] for these worlds to be [fruitful, habitable] once more, the best thing we can do is prove our [value, virtue] by beginning our work. We are a [patient, deliberate] species too, and we understand that gaining the [trust, goodwill] of another may take time."
units.italian: "Beh," dice Tele'ek, "se davvero [desiderano, sperano] che questi mondi tornino [fertili, abitabili], la cosa migliore che possiamo fare è dimostrare il nostro [valore, merito] cominciando il nostro lavoro. Anche noi siamo una specie [paziente, riflessiva], e capiamo che conquistare la [fiducia, benevolenza] di un altro possa richiedere tempo."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Pug Assistance 1|	"I hope that Rek will be able to [allay, assuage] that fear," says Tele'ek. "Surely if we are able to [communicate, connect] with the Korath survivors, they will soon come to see that our intentions are [peaceful, honorable, benevolent]."|516|0
units.english: "I hope that Rek will be able to [allay, assuage] that fear," says Tele'ek. "Surely if we are able to [communicate, connect] with the Korath survivors, they will soon come to see that our intentions are [peaceful, honorable, benevolent]."
units.italian: "Spero che Rek riuscirà a [dissipare, placare] quel timore," dice Tele'ek. "Di certo, se riusciremo a [comunicare, entrare in contatto] con i Korath superstiti, si renderanno presto conto che le nostre intenzioni sono [pacifiche, onorevoli, benevole]."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Pug Assistance 1|	Tele'ek says, "That is a [reasonable, understandable] sentiment. But when they [learn, observe] that our goal is only to make these worlds [flourish, be fruitful] once more, I hope that we will [win, earn] their trust."|520|0
units.english: Tele'ek says, "That is a [reasonable, understandable] sentiment. But when they [learn, observe] that our goal is only to make these worlds [flourish, be fruitful] once more, I hope that we will [win, earn] their trust."
units.italian: Tele'ek dice: "È un sentimento [ragionevole, comprensibile]. Ma quando [apprenderanno, osserveranno] che il nostro scopo è solo far [rifiorire, fruttificare] di nuovo questi mondi, spero che [conquisteremo, guadagneremo] la loro fiducia."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Pug Assistance 1|	"And besides," says Iriket, the terraforming director, "we will only be in this [region of space, territory] for a short time, no more than ten or twenty thousand [years]. So I don't [see, understand] why they are so [concerned, defensive]."|523|0
units.english: "And besides," says Iriket, the terraforming director, "we will only be in this [region of space, territory] for a short time, no more than ten or twenty thousand [years]. So I don't [see, understand] why they are so [concerned, defensive]."
units.italian: "E inoltre," dice Iriket, la direttrice del terraformaggio, "resteremo in questa [regione di spazio, territorio] solo per poco, non più di diecimila o ventimila [anni]. Quindi non [vedo, capisco] perché siano così [preoccupati, sulla difensiva]."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Pug Assistance 1|	"Still," says Tele'ek, "Many among us wish that Rek had not [sent, instructed] you to visit the Quarg. The Keepers of the Eye kept the Hai [at bay, held back]. Surely they could also help us [defeat, remove] these hostile robots. Surely they sent us here for the [healing, reconstruction] of worlds and not to lose our lives fighting an [implacable, remorseless] foe."|524|0
units.english: "Still," says Tele'ek, "Many among us wish that Rek had not [sent, instructed] you to visit the Quarg. The Keepers of the Eye kept the Hai [at bay, held back]. Surely they could also help us [defeat, remove] these hostile robots. Surely they sent us here for the [healing, reconstruction] of worlds and not to lose our lives fighting an [implacable, remorseless] foe."
units.italian: "Eppure," dice Tele'ek, "molti fra noi avrebbero preferito che Rek non ti [avesse inviato, avesse ordinato] dai Quarg. I Custodi dell'Occhio hanno tenuto [a bada, indietro] gli Hai. Di certo potrebbero aiutarci anche a [sconfiggere, eliminare] questi robot ostili. Di certo ci hanno mandati qui per la [guarigione, ricostruzione] dei mondi, non per perdere la vita combattendo un nemico [implacabile, spietato]."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Pug Assistance 1|	"That might be worth a try. The Pug are full of surprises; they may have technology that would let them defeat the automata easily."|526|0
units.english: "That might be worth a try. The Pug are full of surprises; they may have technology that would let them defeat the automata easily."
units.italian: "Vale la pena provare. I Pug sono pieni di sorprese; potrebbero avere una tecnologia che permetterebbe loro di sconfiggere gli automi con facilità."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Pug Assistance 1|	"If getting caught in the crossfire between the two automaton factions is bad, wouldn't getting caught in the middle of a war between the Pug and the Quarg be even worse?"|528|0
units.english: "If getting caught in the crossfire between the two automaton factions is bad, wouldn't getting caught in the middle of a war between the Pug and the Quarg be even worse?"
units.italian: "Se finire nel fuoco incrociato delle due fazioni di automi è brutto, non sarebbe ancora peggio finire in mezzo a una guerra fra i Pug e i Quarg?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Pug Assistance 1|	"They both want what is [optimal, productive] for this region," says Tele'ek. "Perhaps fighting side by side against a common enemy would allow the Pug and the Quarg to [reconcile, make peace] with each other."|530|0
units.english: "They both want what is [optimal, productive] for this region," says Tele'ek. "Perhaps fighting side by side against a common enemy would allow the Pug and the Quarg to [reconcile, make peace] with each other."
units.italian: "Entrambi vogliono ciò che è [ottimale, produttivo] per questa regione," dice Tele'ek. "Forse combattere fianco a fianco contro un nemico comune permetterebbe ai Pug e ai Quarg di [riconciliarsi, fare la pace] fra loro."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Pug Assistance 1|	After some discussion, the other leaders agree that they are more comfortable going to the Pug for help than in solely trusting the goodwill of the Quarg. They ask you to travel back through the wormhole and visit the Pug world there, to see if they are willing to help.|533|0
units.english: After some discussion, the other leaders agree that they are more comfortable going to the Pug for help than in solely trusting the goodwill of the Quarg. They ask you to travel back through the wormhole and visit the Pug world there, to see if they are willing to help.
units.italian: Dopo qualche discussione, gli altri capi concordano che preferiscono andare dai Pug a chiedere aiuto piuttosto che fidarsi solo della benevolenza dei Quarg. Ti chiedono di tornare attraverso il cunicolo e di visitare il mondo dei Pug che c'è dall'altra parte, per vedere se sono disposti ad aiutare.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Pug Assistance 2|name|540|0
units.english: Return to <planet>
units.italian: Ritorna su <planet>

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Pug Assistance 2|description|541|0
units.english: Return to <planet> to tell the Wanderers there that the Pug refuse to send any ships through the Eye to help defend them.
units.italian: Torna su <planet> per dire ai Wanderers che i Pug rifiutano di mandare navi attraverso l'Occhio per aiutarli a difendersi.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Pug Assistance 2|log|547|0
units.english: Visited the Pug to see if they are willing to help the Wanderers fight the Korath automata. But the Pug and the Quarg do not get along with each other, and therefore the Pug are not willing to enter Korath space.
units.italian: Hai visitato i Pug per vedere se sono disposti ad aiutare i Wanderers a combattere gli automi Korath. Ma i Pug e i Quarg non vanno d'accordo, quindi i Pug non sono disposti a entrare nello spazio Korath.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Pug Assistance 2|log|548|0
units.english: For reasons that are not entirely clear, the Pug are hostile toward the Archons, yet also view them as being worthy of pity.
units.italian: Per ragioni non del tutto chiare, i Pug sono ostili verso gli Archon, ma li considerano anche degni di pietà.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Pug Assistance 2|log|549|0
units.english: The Pug say that their species is split up into separate groups or "teams" that each focus on interacting with a different sentient species. They view those other species as "projects" that they are working on.
units.italian: I Pug dicono che la loro specie è divisa in gruppi separati, o "squadre", ciascuna delle quali si occupa di interagire con una specie senziente diversa. Considerano quelle altre specie come "progetti" su cui stanno lavorando.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Pug Assistance 2|The moment you step off your ship you are surrounded by a group of armed Pug. "Perhaps we have not communicated clearly enough for the human's small brain to comprehend it," says one of them, "but we are uninterested in any further interactions with the human."|551|0
units.english: The moment you step off your ship you are surrounded by a group of armed Pug. "Perhaps we have not communicated clearly enough for the human's small brain to comprehend it," says one of them, "but we are uninterested in any further interactions with the human."
units.italian: Appena scendi dalla nave vieni circondato da un gruppo di Pug armati. "Forse non abbiamo comunicato con sufficiente chiarezza perché il piccolo cervello dell'umano lo capisse," dice uno di loro, "ma non siamo interessati a ulteriori interazioni con l'umano."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Pug Assistance 2|	"Actually, I'm here on behalf of the Wanderers."|553|0
units.english: "Actually, I'm here on behalf of the Wanderers."
units.italian: "In realtà sono qui a nome dei Wanderers."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Pug Assistance 2|	"Why are you so hostile toward me?"|555|0
units.english: "Why are you so hostile toward me?"
units.italian: "Perché siete così ostili nei miei confronti?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Pug Assistance 2|	"We are not hostile," says another, "but our project is Wanderers, not humans. You have your own Pug and may bother them as you wish, if they will permit it."|557|0
units.english: "We are not hostile," says another, "but our project is Wanderers, not humans. You have your own Pug and may bother them as you wish, if they will permit it."
units.italian: "Non siamo ostili," dice un altro, "ma il nostro progetto sono i Wanderers, non gli umani. Voi avete i vostri Pug e potete dar loro fastidio quanto volete, se ve lo permetteranno."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Pug Assistance 2|	"Well, it's actually the Wanderers that I'm here to talk with you about."|559|0
units.english: "Well, it's actually the Wanderers that I'm here to talk with you about."
units.italian: "Beh, in realtà sono qui per parlare con voi dei Wanderers."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Pug Assistance 2|	"You're saying that the group of Pug that attacked human space is a different faction?"|561|0
units.english: "You're saying that the group of Pug that attacked human space is a different faction?"
units.italian: "State dicendo che il gruppo di Pug che ha attaccato lo spazio umano è una fazione diversa?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Pug Assistance 2|	"Not a different faction," says one of the Pug, "just a different team, working on a different project. They are the ones whose job is to understand and deal with humans, not us. Thankfully."|563|0
units.english: "Not a different faction," says one of the Pug, "just a different team, working on a different project. They are the ones whose job is to understand and deal with humans, not us. Thankfully."
units.italian: "Non una fazione diversa," dice uno dei Pug, "solo una squadra diversa, che lavora a un progetto diverso. Sono quelli il cui compito è capire gli umani e trattare con loro, non noi. Per fortuna."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Pug Assistance 2|	"The Pug in human space have left now, so there's no way to 'bother' them anymore."|565|0
units.english: "The Pug in human space have left now, so there's no way to 'bother' them anymore."
units.italian: "I Pug nello spazio umano se ne sono andati, quindi non c'è più modo di 'dar loro fastidio'."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Pug Assistance 2|	"Of course they have," says one of the Pug, in a tone of voice that suggests that you're extremely foolish to think that the Pug are done meddling in human affairs.|567|0
units.english: "Of course they have," says one of the Pug, in a tone of voice that suggests that you're extremely foolish to think that the Pug are done meddling in human affairs.
units.italian: "Certo che se ne sono andati," dice uno dei Pug, con un tono che suggerisce che sei estremamente sciocco a credere che i Pug abbiano finito di intromettersi negli affari umani.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Pug Assistance 2|	You explain to the Pug that you are here on behalf of the Wanderers: that the region of space the Eye led them to is infested by dangerous robotic automata. They respond, "It is also infested with the pitiable Archons and their pet Quarg. With whom we are not exactly on speaking terms."|570|0
units.english: You explain to the Pug that you are here on behalf of the Wanderers: that the region of space the Eye led them to is infested by dangerous robotic automata. They respond, "It is also infested with the pitiable Archons and their pet Quarg. With whom we are not exactly on speaking terms."
units.italian: Spieghi ai Pug che sei lì a nome dei Wanderers: che la regione di spazio in cui l'Occhio li ha condotti è infestata da pericolosi automi robotici. Rispondono: "È infestata anche dai pietosi Archon e dai loro Quarg domestici. Con i quali non siamo esattamente in rapporti amichevoli."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Pug Assistance 2|	Another of the Pug adds, "To be slightly more precise, we are in fact on blowing-each-other-up terms with them."|571|0
units.english: Another of the Pug adds, "To be slightly more precise, we are in fact on blowing-each-other-up terms with them."
units.italian: Un altro dei Pug aggiunge: "Per essere un po' più precisi, in realtà siamo in rapporti di reciproco attentato dinamitardo."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Pug Assistance 2|	"Couldn't you make peace with them, if you wanted to?"|573|0
units.english: "Couldn't you make peace with them, if you wanted to?"
units.italian: "Non potreste fare la pace con loro, se voleste?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Pug Assistance 2|	"Why do the Archons hate you?"|575|0
units.english: "Why do the Archons hate you?"
units.italian: "Perché gli Archon vi odiano?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Pug Assistance 2|	"What do you know about the Archons?"|577|0
units.english: "What do you know about the Archons?"
units.italian: "Che cosa sapete degli Archon?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Pug Assistance 2|	"Honestly," says one of the Pug, "it's just not worth the effort."|581|0
units.english: "Honestly," says one of the Pug, "it's just not worth the effort."
units.italian: "Sinceramente," dice uno dei Pug, "non vale la pena dello sforzo."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Pug Assistance 2|	"The Archons have such a dour outlook on life," says another, "and talking with them is just too depressing."|582|0
units.english: "The Archons have such a dour outlook on life," says another, "and talking with them is just too depressing."
units.italian: "Gli Archon hanno una visione della vita così tetra," dice un altro, "e parlare con loro è semplicemente troppo deprimente."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Pug Assistance 2|	"We had a disagreement recently," says one of the Pug. "We were right. The Archons were wrong. They are still sulking."|586|0
units.english: "We had a disagreement recently," says one of the Pug. "We were right. The Archons were wrong. They are still sulking."
units.italian: "Di recente abbiamo avuto un disaccordo," dice uno dei Pug. "Avevamo ragione noi. Gli Archon avevano torto. Stanno ancora facendo i musoni."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Pug Assistance 2|	"We know that they were created to mediate peace and prevent extinction," says one of the Pug. "And we know that they failed. Have failed many times, in fact. And that makes them all mopey and depressing."|590|0
units.english: "We know that they were created to mediate peace and prevent extinction," says one of the Pug. "And we know that they failed. Have failed many times, in fact. And that makes them all mopey and depressing."
units.italian: "Sappiamo che sono stati creati per mediare la pace e prevenire l'estinzione," dice uno dei Pug. "E sappiamo che hanno fallito. Hanno fallito molte volte, in effetti. E questo li rende musoni e deprimenti."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Pug Assistance 2|	You talk with them for a while longer but are unable to gain any more information or to convince them to come to the aid of the Wanderers who are in Korath space. You'll have to report to Sobari Tele'ek that the Quarg fleet is the only outside aid they are likely to receive.|593|0
units.english: You talk with them for a while longer but are unable to gain any more information or to convince them to come to the aid of the Wanderers who are in Korath space. You'll have to report to Sobari Tele'ek that the Quarg fleet is the only outside aid they are likely to receive.
units.italian: Parli ancora un po' con loro, ma non riesci a ottenere altre informazioni né a convincerli a venire in aiuto dei Wanderers che sono nello spazio Korath. Dovrai riferire a Sobari Tele'ek che la flotta dei Quarg è l'unico aiuto esterno che probabilmente riceveranno.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mereti Observation|name|600|0
units.english: Mereti Observation
units.italian: Osservazione dei Mereti

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mereti Observation|description|601|0
units.english: Observe the Kor Mereti in Mesuket for long enough for the Wanderer equipment to collect data on their communications. Then return to <planet>.
units.italian: Osserva i Kor Mereti a Mesuket abbastanza a lungo perché l'equipaggiamento dei Wanderers raccolga dati sulle loro comunicazioni. Poi torna su <planet>.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mereti Observation|blocked|607|0
units.english: You will need <capacity> free to take on the next mission for the Wanderers.
units.italian: Ti serve <capacity> libera per accettare la prossima missione per i Wanderers.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mereti Observation|Sobari Tele'ek meets with you soon after you return, and you tell him that the Pug refuse to help defend the Wanderers in Korath space because of the presence of the Quarg and the Archons. "Then we must find our own [path, solution]," he says. "Come, I have a team of [scientists? engineers?] who wish to meet with you."|611|0
units.english: Sobari Tele'ek meets with you soon after you return, and you tell him that the Pug refuse to help defend the Wanderers in Korath space because of the presence of the Quarg and the Archons. "Then we must find our own [path, solution]," he says. "Come, I have a team of [scientists? engineers?] who wish to meet with you."
units.italian: Sobari Tele'ek ti incontra poco dopo il tuo ritorno, e tu gli dici che i Pug rifiutano di aiutare a difendere i Wanderers nello spazio Korath a causa della presenza dei Quarg e degli Archon. "Allora dobbiamo trovare una nostra [via, soluzione]," dice. "Vieni, ho una squadra di [scienziati? ingegneri?] che desidera incontrarti."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mereti Observation|	He leads you to a different facility where a team of Wanderers are gathered around a table with the disassembled components of the Reasoning Node spread out across it. The lead scientist introduces you to her team and then says, "We believe we have found a way to [intercept, listen in on] the [network traffic? communications?] of the automata that use these [devices, systems]. We need someone to travel to the star system where their [conflict, warfare] is fiercest and make a [recording, observation] of their communications. Can you perform this [task, quest]?"|612|0
units.english: He leads you to a different facility where a team of Wanderers are gathered around a table with the disassembled components of the Reasoning Node spread out across it. The lead scientist introduces you to her team and then says, "We believe we have found a way to [intercept, listen in on] the [network traffic? communications?] of the automata that use these [devices, systems]. We need someone to travel to the star system where their [conflict, warfare] is fiercest and make a [recording, observation] of their communications. Can you perform this [task, quest]?"
units.italian: Ti conduce in un'altra struttura, dove una squadra di Wanderers è riunita intorno a un tavolo su cui sono sparsi i componenti smontati del Nodo di Ragionamento. La scienziata capo ti presenta la sua squadra e poi dice: "Crediamo di aver trovato un modo per [intercettare, ascoltare] il [traffico di rete? le comunicazioni?] degli automi che usano questi [dispositivi, sistemi]. Ci serve qualcuno che vada nel sistema stellare dove il loro [conflitto, scontro] è più feroce e faccia una [registrazione, osservazione] delle loro comunicazioni. Puoi svolgere questo [compito, incarico]?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mereti Observation|	"Sure, I would be glad to do that."|614|0
units.english: "Sure, I would be glad to do that."
units.italian: "Certo, lo farò volentieri."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mereti Observation|	"That sounds very risky."|616|0
units.english: "That sounds very risky."
units.italian: "Sembra molto rischioso."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mereti Observation|	"Indeed," she says, "but you are very [skilled, lucky] in evading harm." Hesitantly, you agree to take on yet another dangerous mission on their behalf.|618|0
units.english: "Indeed," she says, "but you are very [skilled, lucky] in evading harm." Hesitantly, you agree to take on yet another dangerous mission on their behalf.
units.italian: "Davvero," dice, "ma sei molto [abile, fortunato] a schivare i danni." Con esitazione accetti di assumerti un'altra missione pericolosa per loro conto.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mereti Observation|	The scientists begin working to install the new equipment on your ship. As they do so, Tele'ek tells you, "We also hope to collect further [information, intelligence] on the combat capabilities and [tactics, decision making] of the drones. If their [network, communications] are not vulnerable, we must instead find a way to defeat them in battle." You agree to stay in the target system for long enough to observe some of the drones fighting each other.|621|0
units.english: The scientists begin working to install the new equipment on your ship. As they do so, Tele'ek tells you, "We also hope to collect further [information, intelligence] on the combat capabilities and [tactics, decision making] of the drones. If their [network, communications] are not vulnerable, we must instead find a way to defeat them in battle." You agree to stay in the target system for long enough to observe some of the drones fighting each other.
units.italian: Gli scienziati cominciano a installare il nuovo equipaggiamento sulla tua nave. Mentre lo fanno, Tele'ek ti dice: "Speriamo anche di raccogliere altre [informazioni, notizie] sulle capacità di combattimento e sulle [tattiche, scelte] dei droni. Se la loro [rete, comunicazione] non è vulnerabile, dovremo trovare un modo per sconfiggerli in battaglia." Accetti di restare nel sistema bersaglio abbastanza a lungo da osservare alcuni droni che si combattono fra loro.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mereti Observation|dialog|624|0
units.english: You enter the target system and begin recording the communications of the Kor Mereti drones. It may take a while to collect all the data that the Wanderers need, but they have set up their equipment to notify you when it is done collecting.
units.italian: Entri nel sistema bersaglio e cominci a registrare le comunicazioni dei droni Kor Mereti. Potrebbe volerci un po' per raccogliere tutti i dati che servono ai Wanderers, ma hanno impostato il loro equipaggiamento per avvisarti quando avrà finito di raccoglierli.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mereti Observation|dialog|649|0
units.english: The Wanderer recording device chirps at you to let you know that it has collected enough data. Time to return to <planet>.
units.italian: Il dispositivo di registrazione dei Wanderers emette un cinguettio per farti sapere che ha raccolto dati a sufficienza. È tempo di tornare su <planet>.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mereti Observation|dialog|651|0
units.english: You've returned to <planet>, but you don't have enough data for the Wanderers. Return to Mesuket and wait until the device notifies you that it has enough data.
units.italian: Sei tornato su <planet>, ma non hai abbastanza dati per i Wanderers. Torna a Mesuket e aspetta che il dispositivo ti avvisi che ha dati sufficienti.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Kor Efret 1|name|657|0
units.english: Visit <planet>
units.italian: Visita <planet>

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Kor Efret 1|description|658|0
units.english: Visit Ektasi Rek and the Korath on <planet>, and see if they have information that could help in neutralizing the Kor Mereti automata.
units.italian: Visita Ektasi Rek e i Korath su <planet>, e vedi se hanno informazioni utili a neutralizzare gli automi Kor Mereti.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Kor Efret 1|log|665|0
units.english: The Wanderers think that it might be possible to infect the Kor Mereti communications network with something akin to a computer virus, to either take control of the drones or disable them entirely.
units.italian: I Wanderers pensano che potrebbe essere possibile infettare la rete di comunicazioni dei Kor Mereti con qualcosa di simile a un virus informatico, per prendere il controllo dei droni o disabilitarli del tutto.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Kor Efret 1|You hand off the communications recordings to the team of scientists, then meet with Tele'ek for a while to discuss the possible weaknesses of the Mereti drones when in combat. "Of course," he says, "it would be far better if we could [subvert, hijack] them rather than destroying them outright. Otherwise the second drone [faction, variant] will gain in power, without the Mereti drones to [cull them, keep them in check]."|667|0
units.english: You hand off the communications recordings to the team of scientists, then meet with Tele'ek for a while to discuss the possible weaknesses of the Mereti drones when in combat. "Of course," he says, "it would be far better if we could [subvert, hijack] them rather than destroying them outright. Otherwise the second drone [faction, variant] will gain in power, without the Mereti drones to [cull them, keep them in check]."
units.italian: Consegni le registrazioni delle comunicazioni alla squadra di scienziati, poi ti incontri con Tele'ek per un po' a discutere dei possibili punti deboli dei droni Mereti in combattimento. "Naturalmente," dice, "sarebbe molto meglio se potessimo [sovvertirli, dirottarli] invece di distruggerli del tutto. Altrimenti la seconda [fazione, variante] di droni guadagnerebbe potere, senza i droni Mereti a [contenerli, tenerli a freno]."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Kor Efret 1|	About an hour later, the scientists contact Tele'ek. You return to their facility, and the lead scientist tells you, "It is as we [suspected, hypothesized]. The Mereti drones function as [components, elements] of a single unified [collective intelligence? gestalt consciousness?]. We will [analyze, deconstruct] their protocols further to see if we can somehow [infect, corrupt] their network."|668|0
units.english: About an hour later, the scientists contact Tele'ek. You return to their facility, and the lead scientist tells you, "It is as we [suspected, hypothesized]. The Mereti drones function as [components, elements] of a single unified [collective intelligence? gestalt consciousness?]. We will [analyze, deconstruct] their protocols further to see if we can somehow [infect, corrupt] their network."
units.italian: Circa un'ora dopo gli scienziati contattano Tele'ek. Torni alla loro struttura, e la scienziata capo ti dice: "È come [sospettavamo, ipotizzavamo]. I droni Mereti funzionano come [componenti, elementi] di un'unica [intelligenza collettiva? coscienza gestaltica?]. [Analizzeremo, scomporremo] ancora i loro protocolli per vedere se possiamo in qualche modo [infettare, corrompere] la loro rete."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Kor Efret 1|	While you are waiting for them to come up with a plan, Tele'ek suggests that you make a visit to Ektasi Rek. If she has made progress in communicating with the Korath survivors, perhaps they will be able to help the Wanderers think of a way to hack into the Mereti network and take control of the drones.|669|0
units.english: While you are waiting for them to come up with a plan, Tele'ek suggests that you make a visit to Ektasi Rek. If she has made progress in communicating with the Korath survivors, perhaps they will be able to help the Wanderers think of a way to hack into the Mereti network and take control of the drones.
units.italian: Mentre aspetti che mettano a punto un piano, Tele'ek ti suggerisce di fare una visita a Ektasi Rek. Se ha fatto progressi nel comunicare con i Korath superstiti, forse saranno in grado di aiutare i Wanderers a trovare un modo per violare la rete Mereti e prendere il controllo dei droni.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Kor Efret 2|name|676|0
units.english: Korath Engineers
units.italian: Ingegneri Korath

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Kor Efret 2|description|677|0
units.english: The Korath on <origin> referred you to a team of engineers on <planet> who have been working to try to eliminate the automata.
units.italian: I Korath su <origin> ti hanno indirizzato a una squadra di ingegneri su <planet> che lavorano da tempo per cercare di eliminare gli automi.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Kor Efret 2|blocked|682|0
units.english: To take on this mission, you will need a bunk free for Rek.
units.italian: Per accettare questa missione ti serve una cuccetta libera per Rek.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Kor Efret 2|Rek seems delighted to see you, and is even more confident and full of life than she was when you left. She introduces you to several of the Korath, speaking to them rapidly in their own language.|687|0
units.english: Rek seems delighted to see you, and is even more confident and full of life than she was when you left. She introduces you to several of the Korath, speaking to them rapidly in their own language.
units.italian: Rek sembra felice di vederti, ed è ancora più sicura di sé e piena di vita di quando l'hai lasciata. Ti presenta diversi Korath, parlando con loro rapidamente nella loro lingua.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Kor Efret 2|	"Rek! How have you learned their language so fast?"|689|0
units.english: "Rek! How have you learned their language so fast?"
units.italian: "Rek! Come hai fatto a imparare la loro lingua così in fretta?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Kor Efret 2|	"I'm here to see if the Korath could help us hack into the Kor Mereti communication network and take over control of the drones."|690|0
units.english: "I'm here to see if the Korath could help us hack into the Kor Mereti communication network and take over control of the drones."
units.italian: "Sono qui per vedere se i Korath potrebbero aiutarci a violare la rete di comunicazioni dei Kor Mereti e a prendere il controllo dei droni."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Kor Efret 2|	She says, "It seems that the Molt has altered not only my vocal organs, but also my mind. Any language just feels clear and obvious to me now. It is strange, because the Molt is a random mutation; I had no say in what I would become. Yet, it has given me the exact skills I need to create a partnership with the Korath."|693|0
units.english: She says, "It seems that the Molt has altered not only my vocal organs, but also my mind. Any language just feels clear and obvious to me now. It is strange, because the Molt is a random mutation; I had no say in what I would become. Yet, it has given me the exact skills I need to create a partnership with the Korath."
units.italian: Dice: "Sembra che la Muta abbia alterato non solo i miei organi vocali, ma anche la mia mente. Qualsiasi lingua ora mi sembra chiara e ovvia. È strano, perché la Muta è una mutazione casuale; non ho avuto voce in capitolo su ciò che sarei diventata. Eppure mi ha dato esattamente le capacità che mi servono per creare una collaborazione con i Korath."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Kor Efret 2|	"Well, if it was really just a matter of chance what you would turn into, I'm glad that your new form suits you so perfectly."|695|0
units.english: "Well, if it was really just a matter of chance what you would turn into, I'm glad that your new form suits you so perfectly."
units.italian: "Beh, se davvero era solo questione di caso ciò in cui ti saresti trasformata, sono contento che la tua nuova forma ti si addica così bene."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Kor Efret 2|	"I'm here to see if the Korath could help us hack into the Kor Mereti communication network and take over control of the drones."|696|0
units.english: "I'm here to see if the Korath could help us hack into the Kor Mereti communication network and take over control of the drones."
units.italian: "Sono qui per vedere se i Korath potrebbero aiutarci a violare la rete di comunicazioni dei Kor Mereti e a prendere il controllo dei droni."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Kor Efret 2|	"I am glad too," she says. "It is strange. Years ago, I thought that if I Molted I would resent the loss of my old body and my old identity. Yet I feel more at home in this new body than I ever did before. It is an unexpected gift. But now, how can I help you?" You tell her about the scientists hoping to hack into the Mereti network, and ask her to suggest the idea to the Korath.|699|0
units.english: "I am glad too," she says. "It is strange. Years ago, I thought that if I Molted I would resent the loss of my old body and my old identity. Yet I feel more at home in this new body than I ever did before. It is an unexpected gift. But now, how can I help you?" You tell her about the scientists hoping to hack into the Mereti network, and ask her to suggest the idea to the Korath.
units.italian: "Sono contenta anch'io," dice. "È strano. Anni fa pensavo che, se avessi subito la Muta, avrei odiato la perdita del mio vecchio corpo e della mia vecchia identità. Eppure in questo corpo nuovo mi sento più a casa di quanto mi sia mai sentita prima. È un dono inatteso. Ma ora, come posso aiutarti?" Le racconti degli scienziati che sperano di violare la rete Mereti, e le chiedi di proporre l'idea ai Korath.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Kor Efret 2|	Rek does her best to explain your suggestion to the Korath. One of them responds, and she translates, "She said that there is a team of Korath engineers on <planet> who have been working for fifty years to find a way to destroy the automata. She says perhaps they can assist us."|702|0
units.english: Rek does her best to explain your suggestion to the Korath. One of them responds, and she translates, "She said that there is a team of Korath engineers on <planet> who have been working for fifty years to find a way to destroy the automata. She says perhaps they can assist us."
units.italian: Rek fa del suo meglio per spiegare la tua proposta ai Korath. Uno di loro risponde, e lei traduce: "Ha detto che su <planet> c'è una squadra di ingegneri Korath che da cinquant'anni lavora per trovare un modo di distruggere gli automi. Dice che forse possono aiutarci."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Kor Efret 2|	You agree to travel with Rek to <planet> and see what the engineers can tell you.|703|0
units.english: You agree to travel with Rek to <planet> and see what the engineers can tell you.
units.italian: Accetti di viaggiare con Rek fino a <planet> e di vedere che cosa possono dirti gli ingegneri.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Kor Efret 2|dialog|706|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Rek hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it to arrive.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta che porta Rek non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Kor Efret 3|name|722|0
units.english: Defend <planet>
units.italian: Difendi <planet>

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Kor Efret 3|description|723|0
units.english: Defend this Kor Efret world from a Kor Mereti raid. Hopefully if you hold out long enough, more reinforcements will arrive.
units.italian: Difendi questo mondo dei Kor Efret da un'incursione dei Kor Mereti. Si spera che, se resisterete abbastanza a lungo, arriveranno altri rinforzi.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Kor Efret 3|With Rek's help, you make contact with the team of Korath engineers, and Rek explains the Wanderer plan to hack into the Kor Mereti network. Her speech is slower than before, and she has to keep asking questions; clearly the conversation involves technical jargon that she is not yet familiar with. When she is done explaining, the Korath are silent for a minute, then one of them answers quite loudly, almost shouting, gesturing in your direction as if pushing you away.|730|0
units.english: With Rek's help, you make contact with the team of Korath engineers, and Rek explains the Wanderer plan to hack into the Kor Mereti network. Her speech is slower than before, and she has to keep asking questions; clearly the conversation involves technical jargon that she is not yet familiar with. When she is done explaining, the Korath are silent for a minute, then one of them answers quite loudly, almost shouting, gesturing in your direction as if pushing you away.
units.italian: Con l'aiuto di Rek riesci a metterti in contatto con la squadra di ingegneri Korath, e Rek spiega il piano dei Wanderers per violare la rete Kor Mereti. Il suo parlato è più lento di prima, e deve continuare a fare domande; chiaramente la conversazione comporta un gergo tecnico che ancora non conosce. Quando ha finito di spiegare, i Korath restano in silenzio per un minuto, poi uno di loro risponde a voce piuttosto alta, quasi gridando, gesticolando nella tua direzione come per respingerti.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Kor Efret 3|	Rek says, "He said, 'Do you think we are idiots? Do you think we have not attempted that?'" The Korath leader follows up with another long statement that Rek hesitantly translates. "The Mereti... consciousness? It is impossible to subvert. It has a sort of... immune system? Like a living creature. Any foreign influence that impinges on its network is sequestered and analyzed. It does not become part of the... gestalt? ... unless it is proven to be beneficial."|731|0
units.english: Rek says, "He said, 'Do you think we are idiots? Do you think we have not attempted that?'" The Korath leader follows up with another long statement that Rek hesitantly translates. "The Mereti... consciousness? It is impossible to subvert. It has a sort of... immune system? Like a living creature. Any foreign influence that impinges on its network is sequestered and analyzed. It does not become part of the... gestalt? ... unless it is proven to be beneficial."
units.italian: Rek dice: "Ha detto: 'Ci credete che siamo idioti? Credete che non ci abbiamo provato?'" Il capo dei Korath aggiunge un'altra lunga dichiarazione che Rek traduce con esitazione. "La coscienza... dei Mereti? È impossibile sovvertirla. Ha una specie di... sistema immunitario? Come una creatura vivente. Qualsiasi influenza estranea che intacchi la sua rete viene isolata e analizzata. Non diventa parte del... gestalt? ... a meno che non si dimostri utile."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Kor Efret 3|	"But perhaps the Wanderers could succeed where the Korath have failed."|733|0
units.english: "But perhaps the Wanderers could succeed where the Korath have failed."
units.italian: "Ma forse i Wanderers potrebbero riuscire dove i Korath hanno fallito."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Kor Efret 3|	"What about the Kor Sestor? Do they have any hope of taking over those drones?"|734|0
units.english: "What about the Kor Sestor? Do they have any hope of taking over those drones?"
units.italian: "E i Kor Sestor? C'è qualche speranza di prendere il controllo di quei droni?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Kor Efret 3|	She says, "I'm sorry, <first>, but I'm not going to translate that. It would be an insult to the Korath, and they are very prickly when it comes to their honor. I wish you the best of luck, though."|737|0
units.english: She says, "I'm sorry, <first>, but I'm not going to translate that. It would be an insult to the Korath, and they are very prickly when it comes to their honor. I wish you the best of luck, though."
units.italian: Dice: "Mi dispiace, <first>, ma questo non lo tradurrò. Sarebbe un insulto ai Korath, e sono molto suscettibili quando si tratta del loro onore. Ti auguro comunque ogni fortuna."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Kor Efret 3|	Rek asks the Korath a question, and translates the response. "They say that none of them know what is controlling the Kor Sestor, but that wherever the control center is, it is certainly tightly guarded. They have not been willing to risk their own lives to explore Sestor space, but you are free to do so if you think it would be beneficial."|741|0
units.english: Rek asks the Korath a question, and translates the response. "They say that none of them know what is controlling the Kor Sestor, but that wherever the control center is, it is certainly tightly guarded. They have not been willing to risk their own lives to explore Sestor space, but you are free to do so if you think it would be beneficial."
units.italian: Rek fa una domanda ai Korath e traduce la risposta. "Dicono che nessuno di loro sa che cosa controlli i Kor Sestor, ma che, ovunque sia il centro di controllo, è di certo ben sorvegliato. Non sono stati disposti a rischiare la vita per esplorare lo spazio Sestor, ma tu sei libero di farlo se pensi che sarebbe utile."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Kor Efret 3|	The conversation is interrupted as alarm sirens begin to sound throughout the spaceport. One of the Korath says something to Rek, and they all begin running toward the landing pads. Rek says, "Another Kor Mereti attack. They have become more frequent, lately. You should join the defenders; fighting alongside them will help to gain their trust." You hurry back to your ship and take off...|744|0
units.english: The conversation is interrupted as alarm sirens begin to sound throughout the spaceport. One of the Korath says something to Rek, and they all begin running toward the landing pads. Rek says, "Another Kor Mereti attack. They have become more frequent, lately. You should join the defenders; fighting alongside them will help to gain their trust." You hurry back to your ship and take off...
units.italian: La conversazione viene interrotta quando le sirene d'allarme cominciano a suonare in tutto lo spazioporto. Uno dei Korath dice qualcosa a Rek, e corrono tutti verso le piazzole di atterraggio. Rek dice: "Un altro attacco dei Kor Mereti. Ultimamente sono diventati più frequenti. Dovresti unirti ai difensori; combattere al loro fianco ti aiuterà a guadagnare la loro fiducia." Ti precipiti alla tua nave e decolli...

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Kor Efret 3|dialog|757|0
units.english: The Kor Mereti drones have been neutralized. You should land on the planet and reconnect with Rek and the Korath engineers.
units.italian: I droni Kor Mereti sono stati neutralizzati. Dovresti atterrare sul pianeta e rimetterti in contatto con Rek e gli ingegneri Korath.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Kor Efret 4|name|806|0
units.english: Return to <planet>
units.italian: Ritorna su <planet>

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Kor Efret 4|description|807|0
units.english: Transport Ektasi Rek back to <planet>, where she will continue her work to understand the Korath language and culture.
units.italian: Trasporta Ektasi Rek di nuovo su <planet>, dove continuerà il suo lavoro per capire la lingua e la cultura dei Korath.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Kor Efret 4|blocked|812|0
units.english: To take on this mission, you will need a bunk free for Rek.
units.italian: Per accettare questa missione ti serve una cuccetta libera per Rek.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Kor Efret 4|log|816|0
units.english: Helped to defend one of the friendly Korath worlds from an attack by Kor Mereti drones. There are Korath scientists on that world who have been working for decades to find a way to hack into the Kor Mereti network, but they do not think it is possible.
units.italian: Hai aiutato a difendere uno dei mondi amici dei Korath da un attacco dei droni Kor Mereti. Su quel mondo ci sono scienziati Korath che da decenni lavorano per trovare un modo di violare la rete Kor Mereti, ma non credono che sia possibile.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Kor Efret 4|log|817|0
units.english: When the Korath civil war reached a point where they had nearly driven themselves extinct, the Drak Archons stepped in and offered the surviving Korath an ultimatum: they must either give up their advanced weaponry and live peaceably under the protection of the Quarg, or be banished to some lifeless star systems near the galactic core. Those who chose banishment apparently took with them the secret of how to build jump drives, which has enabled them to raid other species and steal from them.
units.italian: Quando la guerra civile Korath arrivò al punto che stavano quasi estinguendosi da soli, gli Archon dei Drak intervennero e offrirono ai Korath superstiti un ultimatum: rinunciare alle loro armi avanzate e vivere in pace sotto la protezione dei Quarg, oppure essere banditi in alcuni sistemi stellari senza vita vicino al nucleo galattico. Quelli che scelsero il bando portarono con sé, a quanto pare, il segreto per costruire motori di salto, il che ha permesso loro di fare incursioni contro altre specie e depredarle.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Kor Efret 4|When you land back on the planet, Rek and several of the Korath meet you at your ship. "They would like to thank you for your assistance in defending their home," says Rek, "and they apologize for being so dismissive of the Wanderer plans to defeat the drones. They still think that hacking or corrupting the Mereti network is impossible, though."|819|0
units.english: When you land back on the planet, Rek and several of the Korath meet you at your ship. "They would like to thank you for your assistance in defending their home," says Rek, "and they apologize for being so dismissive of the Wanderer plans to defeat the drones. They still think that hacking or corrupting the Mereti network is impossible, though."
units.italian: Quando atterri di nuovo sul pianeta, Rek e diversi Korath ti vengono incontro alla nave. "Vorrebbero ringraziarti per l'aiuto nel difendere la loro casa," dice Rek, "e si scusano di essere stati così sprezzanti verso i piani dei Wanderers per sconfiggere i droni. Continuano però a pensare che violare o corrompere la rete Mereti sia impossibile."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Kor Efret 4|	"Well, I guess I should tell that to the Wanderer leaders."|821|0
units.english: "Well, I guess I should tell that to the Wanderer leaders."
units.italian: "Beh, credo che dovrei dirlo ai capi dei Wanderers."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Kor Efret 4|	"Can they at least tell us more about where the drones came from?"|822|0
units.english: "Can they at least tell us more about where the drones came from?"
units.italian: "Possono almeno dirci qualcosa di più su da dove vengono i droni?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Kor Efret 4|	Rek asks a question, and translates the answer. "There was a civil war. It lasted hundreds of years. The Kor Mereti and the Kor Sestor were the two rival empires. The Kor Efret were those who sought to remain neutral and not join in the fighting."|824|0
units.english: Rek asks a question, and translates the answer. "There was a civil war. It lasted hundreds of years. The Kor Mereti and the Kor Sestor were the two rival empires. The Kor Efret were those who sought to remain neutral and not join in the fighting."
units.italian: Rek fa una domanda e traduce la risposta. "C'è stata una guerra civile. È durata centinaia di anni. I Kor Mereti e i Kor Sestor erano i due imperi rivali. I Kor Efret erano quelli che cercarono di restare neutrali e di non partecipare ai combattimenti."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Kor Efret 4|	She waits as the Korath continue the story, then says, "The Mereti and the Sestor each built drone fleets programmed to attack the other. They also made many other weapons, very dangerous ones. Eventually, about a century ago, it became clear that the war would consume and destroy both empires, if it continued. The Archons stepped in and gave a choice to each member of the Kor Mereti and the Kor Sestor."|825|0
units.english: She waits as the Korath continue the story, then says, "The Mereti and the Sestor each built drone fleets programmed to attack the other. They also made many other weapons, very dangerous ones. Eventually, about a century ago, it became clear that the war would consume and destroy both empires, if it continued. The Archons stepped in and gave a choice to each member of the Kor Mereti and the Kor Sestor."
units.italian: Aspetta mentre i Korath proseguono il racconto, poi dice: "Mereti e Sestor costruirono ciascuno flotte di droni programmate per attaccare l'altro. Fecero anche molte altre armi, molto pericolose. Alla fine, circa un secolo fa, divenne chiaro che la guerra avrebbe consumato e distrutto entrambi gli imperi, se fosse continuata. Gli Archon intervennero e offrirono una scelta a ogni membro dei Kor Mereti e dei Kor Sestor."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Kor Efret 4|	The Korath continue the story. Rek says, "The choice was: to give up jump drives, give up their advanced technologies of war, and join the Kor Efret, living under Quarg supervision. Any who refused were exiled to the lifeless star systems near the core. Sestor and Mereti, forced to live together in exile and to depend on each other, united by their anger toward the Archons who exiled them."|826|0
units.english: The Korath continue the story. Rek says, "The choice was: to give up jump drives, give up their advanced technologies of war, and join the Kor Efret, living under Quarg supervision. Any who refused were exiled to the lifeless star systems near the core. Sestor and Mereti, forced to live together in exile and to depend on each other, united by their anger toward the Archons who exiled them."
units.italian: I Korath proseguono il racconto. Rek dice: "La scelta era: rinunciare ai motori di salto, rinunciare alle loro tecnologie avanzate di guerra e unirsi ai Kor Efret, vivendo sotto la supervisione dei Quarg. Chi rifiutava veniva esiliato nei sistemi stellari senza vita vicino al nucleo. Sestor e Mereti, costretti a vivere insieme in esilio e a dipendere l'uno dall'altro, uniti dalla rabbia verso gli Archon che li avevano esiliati."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Kor Efret 4|	"What sort of technologies did they develop?"|828|0
units.english: "What sort of technologies did they develop?"
units.italian: "Che tipo di tecnologie hanno sviluppato?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Kor Efret 4|	"What do they mean, 'give up jump drives'? Did they figure out how to manufacture them?"|829|0
units.english: "What do they mean, 'give up jump drives'? Did they figure out how to manufacture them?"
units.italian: "Che cosa significa 'rinunciare ai motori di salto'? Avevano capito come produrli?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Kor Efret 4|	Rek asks, and translates the response. "They say, they will not relive the shame of their parents by describing their deeds. But the scars that they left on their former planets, and even on entire star systems, speak for themselves. As do the drone fleets, who continue to drain their homes of resources to prosecute a war that their creators have long since abandoned."|832|0
units.english: Rek asks, and translates the response. "They say, they will not relive the shame of their parents by describing their deeds. But the scars that they left on their former planets, and even on entire star systems, speak for themselves. As do the drone fleets, who continue to drain their homes of resources to prosecute a war that their creators have long since abandoned."
units.italian: Rek fa la domanda e traduce la risposta. "Dicono che non rivivranno la vergogna dei loro genitori descrivendone le imprese. Ma le cicatrici che hanno lasciato sui loro vecchi pianeti, e persino su interi sistemi stellari, parlano da sole. Come parlano da sole le flotte di droni, che continuano a prosciugare le loro case di risorse per portare avanti una guerra che i loro creatori hanno abbandonato da tempo."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Kor Efret 4|	Rek asks, and translates the response. "Yes, one thing that the exiles were unwilling to give up was the knowledge of how to create jump drives so they could raid other nearby species. Although..." She pauses to listen as one of the Korath says something else. "He says, the exiles would be far better off without them. The manufacturing process is precarious, and one wrong step can cause an explosion that destroys the ship or station where the drives are being constructed."|836|0
units.english: Rek asks, and translates the response. "Yes, one thing that the exiles were unwilling to give up was the knowledge of how to create jump drives so they could raid other nearby species. Although..." She pauses to listen as one of the Korath says something else. "He says, the exiles would be far better off without them. The manufacturing process is precarious, and one wrong step can cause an explosion that destroys the ship or station where the drives are being constructed."
units.italian: Rek fa la domanda e traduce la risposta. "Sì, una cosa a cui gli esiliati non vollero rinunciare fu la conoscenza di come creare motori di salto, per poter depredare le altre specie vicine. Anche se..." Si ferma ad ascoltare mentre uno dei Korath dice qualcos'altro. "Dice che gli esiliati starebbero molto meglio senza. Il processo di produzione è precario, e un passo sbagliato può causare un'esplosione che distrugge la nave o la stazione dove si costruiscono i motori."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Kor Efret 4|	Rek tells you that she wants to return to <planet> to continue her work with the Korath community there. You agree to take her there before returning to report to Tele'ek.|839|0
units.english: Rek tells you that she wants to return to <planet> to continue her work with the Korath community there. You agree to take her there before returning to report to Tele'ek.
units.italian: Rek ti dice che vuole tornare su <planet> per continuare il suo lavoro con la comunità Korath che c'è lì. Accetti di portarcela prima di tornare a riferire a Tele'ek.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Kor Efret 4|dialog|842|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Rek hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it to arrive.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta che porta Rek non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Kor Efret 5|name|848|0
units.english: Return to <planet>
units.italian: Ritorna su <planet>

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Kor Efret 5|description|849|0
units.english: Return to <planet> and report to Sobari Tele'ek that the Korath do not think the Mereti drone network can be compromised.
units.italian: Torna su <planet> e riferisci a Sobari Tele'ek che i Korath non credono che la rete di droni Mereti possa essere compromessa.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Kor Efret 5|You drop off Ektasi Rek on <origin>, and wish her the best of luck in her continued efforts to understand and befriend the Korath. She is clearly eager to get back to work.|857|0
units.english: You drop off Ektasi Rek on <origin>, and wish her the best of luck in her continued efforts to understand and befriend the Korath. She is clearly eager to get back to work.
units.italian: Lasci Ektasi Rek su <origin> e le auguri ogni fortuna nel suo continuo impegno per capire e diventare amica dei Korath. È chiaramente impaziente di rimettersi al lavoro.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Kor Efret 5|	Then, you get ready to return to <planet>. Sobari Tele'ek will not be happy to hear that the Korath engineers think there is no hope of compromising the Kor Mereti network.|858|0
units.english: Then, you get ready to return to <planet>. Sobari Tele'ek will not be happy to hear that the Korath engineers think there is no hope of compromising the Kor Mereti network.
units.italian: Poi ti prepari a tornare su <planet>. Sobari Tele'ek non sarà felice di sentire che gli ingegneri Korath ritengono che non ci sia speranza di compromettere la rete Kor Mereti.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Kor Mereti Hacking|name|865|0
units.english: Kor Mereti Hacking
units.italian: Hacking dei Kor Mereti

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Kor Mereti Hacking|description|866|0
units.english: Test a device that the Wanderers think may be able to gain access to the Kor Mereti network and disrupt it.
units.italian: Prova un dispositivo che i Wanderers pensano possa dare accesso alla rete Kor Mereti e turbarla.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Kor Mereti Hacking|blocked|873|0
units.english: You will need <capacity> to take on the next Wanderer mission.
units.italian: Ti serve <capacity> per accettare la prossima missione dei Wanderers.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Kor Mereti Hacking|You expect the Wanderers to be discouraged by the news that the Korath think the Mereti gestalt consciousness is too robust to be hacked into or compromised. But when you arrive, the communications scientists are excited about a breakthrough: they have managed to develop a program that makes the one sample Reasoning Node you fetched for them follow orders that they give it. They ask you to bring the device to one of the Kor Mereti systems and test it out on the drones there.|876|0
units.english: You expect the Wanderers to be discouraged by the news that the Korath think the Mereti gestalt consciousness is too robust to be hacked into or compromised. But when you arrive, the communications scientists are excited about a breakthrough: they have managed to develop a program that makes the one sample Reasoning Node you fetched for them follow orders that they give it. They ask you to bring the device to one of the Kor Mereti systems and test it out on the drones there.
units.italian: Ti aspetti che i Wanderers siano scoraggiati dalla notizia che i Korath ritengono la coscienza gestaltica Mereti troppo robusta per essere violata o compromessa. Ma quando arrivi, gli scienziati delle comunicazioni sono entusiasti di una scoperta: sono riusciti a sviluppare un programma che fa seguire i loro ordini all'unico Nodo di Ragionamento campione che gli hai recuperato. Ti chiedono di portare il dispositivo in uno dei sistemi Kor Mereti e di provarlo sui droni che ci sono.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Kor Mereti Hacking|	Meanwhile, you can't help but notice that Sobari Tele'ek is showing the same thinning feathers and disheveled appearance that heralded the beginning of the Molt for Iktat Rek. You're not sure if it's polite to say something or not.|877|0
units.english: Meanwhile, you can't help but notice that Sobari Tele'ek is showing the same thinning feathers and disheveled appearance that heralded the beginning of the Molt for Iktat Rek. You're not sure if it's polite to say something or not.
units.italian: Nel frattempo non puoi fare a meno di notare che Sobari Tele'ek mostra lo stesso diradarsi delle piume e lo stesso aspetto trasandato che avevano annunciato l'inizio della Muta per Iktat Rek. Non sei sicuro che sia educato dire qualcosa o no.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Kor Mereti Hacking|	"Tele'ek, are you beginning to Molt?"|879|0
units.english: "Tele'ek, are you beginning to Molt?"
units.italian: "Tele'ek, hai cominciato la Muta?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Kor Mereti Hacking|	(Say nothing, and return to my ship.)|880|0
units.english: (Say nothing, and return to my ship.)
units.italian: (Non dire nulla e torna alla mia nave.)

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Kor Mereti Hacking|	"I believe so," he says. "My [appetite? caloric intake?] has doubled in the past week, and as you can see, I am losing feathers. It is [inconvenient, disruptive] timing. I now understand why Rek sought to [fight, postpone] the Molt rather than give in to it."|883|0
units.english: "I believe so," he says. "My [appetite? caloric intake?] has doubled in the past week, and as you can see, I am losing feathers. It is [inconvenient, disruptive] timing. I now understand why Rek sought to [fight, postpone] the Molt rather than give in to it."
units.italian: "Credo di sì," dice. "Il mio [appetito? apporto calorico?] è raddoppiato nell'ultima settimana e, come vedi, sto perdendo le piume. È un momento [inopportuno, problematico]. Ora capisco perché Rek cercasse di [combattere, rimandare] la Muta invece di cedervi."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Kor Mereti Hacking|	You aren't sure what you can say that would be helpful to him, so you return to your ship and prepare to travel to the Mekislepti system to test out the Kor Mereti hacking program.|886|0
units.english: You aren't sure what you can say that would be helpful to him, so you return to your ship and prepare to travel to the Mekislepti system to test out the Kor Mereti hacking program.
units.italian: Non sei sicuro di che cosa potresti dire che gli sia utile, quindi torni alla tua nave e ti prepari a viaggiare verso il sistema Mekislepti per provare il programma di hacking dei Kor Mereti.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Kor Mereti Hacking|When you enter the Mekislepti system, an entire fleet of drones moves to intercept you. Hardly daring to hope, you press the button that activates the Wanderer program. For a fraction of a second, the drones' engines stop firing and they drift as if out of control. Then, with renewed purpose, they move to attack you.|892|0
units.english: When you enter the Mekislepti system, an entire fleet of drones moves to intercept you. Hardly daring to hope, you press the button that activates the Wanderer program. For a fraction of a second, the drones' engines stop firing and they drift as if out of control. Then, with renewed purpose, they move to attack you.
units.italian: Quando entri nel sistema Mekislepti, un'intera flotta di droni si muove per intercettarti. Quasi senza osare sperare, premi il pulsante che attiva il programma dei Wanderers. Per una frazione di secondo i motori dei droni smettono di accendersi e loro vanno alla deriva come fuori controllo. Poi, con rinnovato proposito, si muovono per attaccarti.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Kor Mereti Hacking|	Oh well. It was worth a shot.|893|0
units.english: Oh well. It was worth a shot.
units.italian: Beh. Valeva la pena provare.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mind 1|name|909|0
units.english: Travel to <planet>
units.italian: Recati su <planet>

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mind 1|description|910|0
units.english: Travel to the Wanderer artificial intelligence lab on <planet>, where they will give you one of the "artificial minds" they have constructed.
units.italian: Recati al laboratorio di intelligenza artificiale dei Wanderers su <planet>, dove ti daranno una delle "menti artificiali" che hanno costruito.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mind 1|log|917|0
units.english: Tested a device that the Wanderers thought would be able to force itself into the Kor Mereti network and take control of it. The experiment completely failed, however.
units.italian: Hai provato un dispositivo che i Wanderers pensavano potesse imporsi nella rete Kor Mereti e prenderne il controllo. L'esperimento però è fallito del tutto.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mind 1|You meet with the Wanderer leaders and tell them that the attempt to hack the Kor Mereti drones has failed. They seem uncertain of what to do next. Some of them want to try to target the Kor Sestor instead; others want to give the scientists another shot.|919|0
units.english: You meet with the Wanderer leaders and tell them that the attempt to hack the Kor Mereti drones has failed. They seem uncertain of what to do next. Some of them want to try to target the Kor Sestor instead; others want to give the scientists another shot.
units.italian: Ti incontri con i capi dei Wanderers e dici loro che il tentativo di violare i droni Kor Mereti è fallito. Sembrano incerti su che cosa fare. Alcuni vogliono provare a puntare sui Kor Sestor; altri vogliono dare agli scienziati un'altra possibilità.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mind 1|	Tema'a Iriket asks you, "Why do you think our [attempt, experiment] failed?"|920|0
units.english: Tema'a Iriket asks you, "Why do you think our [attempt, experiment] failed?"
units.italian: Tema'a Iriket ti chiede: "Perché pensi che il nostro [tentativo, esperimento] sia fallito?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mind 1|	"The Korath survivors say that the Mereti drones have a sort of immune system that allows them to reject any intrusion that seeks to disrupt or coopt their network."|922|0
units.english: "The Korath survivors say that the Mereti drones have a sort of immune system that allows them to reject any intrusion that seeks to disrupt or coopt their network."
units.italian: "I Korath superstiti dicono che i droni Mereti hanno una specie di sistema immunitario che permette loro di respingere qualsiasi intrusione che cerchi di turbare o di appropriarsi della loro rete."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mind 1|	"Perhaps we just need a more sophisticated or intelligent program, something that could overpower the Mereti defenses."|923|0
units.english: "Perhaps we just need a more sophisticated or intelligent program, something that could overpower the Mereti defenses."
units.italian: "Forse ci serve solo un programma più sofisticato o più intelligente, qualcosa che possa sopraffare le difese Mereti."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mind 1|	She thinks about that for a moment, then says, "In terraforming, we say that each planet has a [will, identity], and it will never work to [overrule, overpower] the planet. Instead, we must [collaborate, partner] with it. Perhaps we can do the same with this [consciousness]."|925|0
units.english: She thinks about that for a moment, then says, "In terraforming, we say that each planet has a [will, identity], and it will never work to [overrule, overpower] the planet. Instead, we must [collaborate, partner] with it. Perhaps we can do the same with this [consciousness]."
units.italian: Ci pensa un momento, poi dice: "Nel terraformaggio diciamo che ogni pianeta ha una sua [volontà, identità], e che non funzionerà mai [imporre la propria volontà, sopraffare] il pianeta. Dobbiamo invece [collaborare, fare squadra] con lui. Forse possiamo fare lo stesso con questa [coscienza]."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mind 1|	A stir of excitement passes through the Wanderers. Finally, this is a strategy that lines up with their preferred way of doing things. "What do you mean?" asks one of them.|926|0
units.english: A stir of excitement passes through the Wanderers. Finally, this is a strategy that lines up with their preferred way of doing things. "What do you mean?" asks one of them.
units.italian: Un fremito di eccitazione attraversa i Wanderers. Finalmente una strategia che si allinea al loro modo preferito di fare le cose. "Che cosa vuoi dire?" chiede uno di loro.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mind 1|	Iriket says, "We give them one of the [artificial minds?] that we use for [planetary oversight?]. Let it [merge with, become a part of] the Mereti gestalt consciousness. Not to [destroy, subvert] it, but to reach an [understanding, partnership] with it."|927|0
units.english: Iriket says, "We give them one of the [artificial minds?] that we use for [planetary oversight?]. Let it [merge with, become a part of] the Mereti gestalt consciousness. Not to [destroy, subvert] it, but to reach an [understanding, partnership] with it."
units.italian: Iriket dice: "Diamo loro una delle [menti artificiali?] che usiamo per [la supervisione planetaria?]. Lasciamo che si [fonda con, diventi parte di] la coscienza gestaltica Mereti. Non per [distruggerla, sovvertirla], ma per raggiungere una [comprensione, collaborazione] con lei."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mind 1|	Several of the Wanderers seem very agitated by that suggestion. Tele'ek says, "You would give them access to a [technology, resource] that would make them even more [powerful, capable] than before?"|928|0
units.english: Several of the Wanderers seem very agitated by that suggestion. Tele'ek says, "You would give them access to a [technology, resource] that would make them even more [powerful, capable] than before?"
units.italian: Diversi Wanderers sembrano molto agitati da quella proposta. Tele'ek dice: "Daresti loro accesso a una [tecnologia, risorsa] che li renderebbe ancora più [potenti, capaci] di prima?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mind 1|	"That sounds like it might work. If your artificial intelligence truly means them no harm, the Mereti might recognize that."|930|0
units.english: "That sounds like it might work. If your artificial intelligence truly means them no harm, the Mereti might recognize that."
units.italian: "Sembra che potrebbe funzionare. Se la vostra intelligenza artificiale davvero non vuole far loro del male, i Mereti potrebbero riconoscerlo."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mind 1|	"I think Tele'ek is right. The Mereti drones are already plenty dangerous without access to advanced computing technology."|931|0
units.english: "I think Tele'ek is right. The Mereti drones are already plenty dangerous without access to advanced computing technology."
units.italian: "Credo che Tele'ek abbia ragione. I droni Mereti sono già abbastanza pericolosi senza accesso a una tecnologia di calcolo avanzata."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mind 1|	You try to speak up, but the Wanderers are so hotly engaged in conversation that they have switched from the common language of the Hai back into their own native tongue, and you have no idea what they are saying. Eventually the debate ends, and Tele'ek says, "Very well, we will attempt this thing.
