Not because it is the [wise, certain] course of action, but because it is [in keeping with Wanderer values?]."|933|0
units.english: You try to speak up, but the Wanderers are so hotly engaged in conversation that they have switched from the common language of the Hai back into their own native tongue, and you have no idea what they are saying. Eventually the debate ends, and Tele'ek says, "Very well, we will attempt this thing. Not because it is the [wise, certain] course of action, but because it is [in keeping with Wanderer values?]."
units.italian: Provi a intervenire, ma i Wanderers sono così presi dalla discussione che sono passati dalla lingua comune degli Hai di nuovo alla loro lingua nativa, e non hai idea di che cosa dicano. Alla fine il dibattito si chiude, e Tele'ek dice: "Molto bene, tenteremo questa cosa. Non perché sia la via d'azione [saggia, sicura], ma perché è [coerente con i valori dei Wanderers?]."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mind 1|	They ask you to travel back through the wormhole and visit the artificial intelligence lab on <planet>.|934|0
units.english: They ask you to travel back through the wormhole and visit the artificial intelligence lab on <planet>.
units.italian: Ti chiedono di tornare attraverso il cunicolo e di visitare il laboratorio di intelligenza artificiale su <planet>.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mind 2|name|941|0
units.english: Return to <planet>
units.italian: Ritorna su <planet>

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mind 2|description|942|0
units.english: Return to <planet> with a Wanderer named Meto Pa'aret and an "artificial mind" that he constructed.
units.italian: Torna su <planet> con un Wanderer di nome Meto Pa'aret e una "mente artificiale" che lui ha costruito.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mind 2|blocked|950|0
units.english: To take this mission, you will need <capacity> free.
units.italian: Per accettare questa missione ti serve <capacity> libera.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mind 2|log|952|0
units.english: The Wanderers have a new plan: to try to either subvert or possibly even befriend the Kor Mereti network by connecting it to a powerful Wanderer artificial intelligence.
units.italian: I Wanderers hanno un nuovo piano: cercare di sovvertire, o forse persino di diventare amici, della rete Kor Mereti collegandola a una potente intelligenza artificiale dei Wanderers.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mind 2|log|953|0
units.english: Pa'aret runs a Wanderer artificial intelligence laboratory. He is in charge of the effort to establish a connection between the Wanderers and the Kor Mereti collective by introducing a Wanderer "artificial Mind" into the collective.
units.italian: Pa'aret dirige un laboratorio di intelligenza artificiale dei Wanderers. È responsabile dello sforzo di stabilire un collegamento fra i Wanderers e il collettivo Kor Mereti, introducendo una "Mente artificiale" Wanderer nel collettivo.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mind 2|On <origin> you are met by a Wanderer named Meto Pa'aret. He explains that he is in charge of the artificial intelligence lab, and he wants to travel with you along with the "Mind" that is being entrusted to your care. "We have already [altered, reconfigured] one of the climate [simulation, prediction] Minds for this new purpose," he says. "It now contains [stores, databases, libraries] of historical and cultural information, things we hope will help the alien [consciousness, intelligence] to [understand, sympathize with] us and realize our intentions are [peaceful, forthright]."|955|0
units.english: On <origin> you are met by a Wanderer named Meto Pa'aret. He explains that he is in charge of the artificial intelligence lab, and he wants to travel with you along with the "Mind" that is being entrusted to your care. "We have already [altered, reconfigured] one of the climate [simulation, prediction] Minds for this new purpose," he says. "It now contains [stores, databases, libraries] of historical and cultural information, things we hope will help the alien [consciousness, intelligence] to [understand, sympathize with] us and realize our intentions are [peaceful, forthright]."
units.italian: Su <origin> ti viene incontro un Wanderer di nome Meto Pa'aret. Spiega che dirige il laboratorio di intelligenza artificiale e che vuole viaggiare con te insieme alla "Mente" che ti viene affidata. "Abbiamo già [modificato, riconfigurato] una delle Menti di [simulazione, previsione] climatica per questo nuovo scopo," dice. "Ora contiene [archivi, basi di dati, raccolte] di informazioni storiche e culturali, cose che speriamo aiutino la [coscienza, intelligenza] aliena a [capirci, provare simpatia per noi] e a rendersi conto che le nostre intenzioni sono [pacifiche, leali]."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mind 2|	"Are you sure that's wise, giving the Kor Mereti access to so much information about the Wanderers?"|957|0
units.english: "Are you sure that's wise, giving the Kor Mereti access to so much information about the Wanderers?"
units.italian: "Sei sicuro che sia saggio dare ai Kor Mereti accesso a così tante informazioni sui Wanderers?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mind 2|	"How likely do you think this is to work?"|958|0
units.english: "How likely do you think this is to work?"
units.italian: "Quanto pensi che sia probabile che funzioni?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mind 2|	"It is certainly not wise," he says, "but it is [right? fitting?]."|961|0
units.english: "It is certainly not wise," he says, "but it is [right? fitting?]."
units.italian: "Di certo non è saggio," dice, "ma è [giusto? opportuno?]."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mind 2|	He says, "There is insufficient [data, information] to even [attempt, hazard] a guess. But nevertheless it is the most [appealing, pleasing] [course of action?]."|965|0
units.english: He says, "There is insufficient [data, information] to even [attempt, hazard] a guess. But nevertheless it is the most [appealing, pleasing] [course of action?]."
units.italian: "Non ci sono [dati, informazioni] sufficienti nemmeno per [tentare, azzardare] una previsione. Eppure è la più [attraente, gradita] [linea d'azione?]."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mind 2|	The "artificial Mind" turns out to be a computer not much larger than a typical cargo crate. Pa'aret walks beside it with one wing draped around it like an overprotective parent while Wanderer workers load it onto your ship. Clearly this particular piece of technology is very valuable to the Wanderers.|968|0
units.english: The "artificial Mind" turns out to be a computer not much larger than a typical cargo crate. Pa'aret walks beside it with one wing draped around it like an overprotective parent while Wanderer workers load it onto your ship. Clearly this particular piece of technology is very valuable to the Wanderers.
units.italian: La "Mente artificiale" si rivela un computer non molto più grande di una normale cassa da carico. Pa'aret le cammina accanto con un'ala drappeggiata intorno, come un genitore iperprotettivo, mentre gli operai Wanderer la caricano sulla tua nave. Chiaramente questo particolare pezzo di tecnologia è molto prezioso per i Wanderers.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mind 2|dialog|971|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Meto Pa'aret and the Mind hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it to arrive.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta che porta Meto Pa'aret e la Mente non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mind 3|name|977|0
units.english: Fetch Escorts
units.italian: Recupera le scorte

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mind 3|description|978|0
units.english: When you are ready, visit <planet> to rendezvous with the fleet that will be accompanying you in your attempt to link a Wanderer artificial Mind to the Kor Mereti network.
units.italian: Quando sei pronto, recati su <planet> per incontrarti con la flotta che ti accompagnerà nel tentativo di collegare una Mente artificiale dei Wanderers alla rete Kor Mereti.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mind 3|While you were gone, the Wanderers have been conducting patrols of Kor Mereti space. Tele'ek tells you, "We have [decided, theorized] that the Mind is most likely to be accepted into the Mereti [gestalt consciousness] if it is physically located in their [home, territory]. Our goal is to install it within the [hull, shell] of one of their space stations. You will carry the [team, strike force] that does this, and our fleet will [protect, shield] you."|986|0
units.english: While you were gone, the Wanderers have been conducting patrols of Kor Mereti space. Tele'ek tells you, "We have [decided, theorized] that the Mind is most likely to be accepted into the Mereti [gestalt consciousness] if it is physically located in their [home, territory]. Our goal is to install it within the [hull, shell] of one of their space stations. You will carry the [team, strike force] that does this, and our fleet will [protect, shield] you."
units.italian: Mentre eri via, i Wanderers hanno condotto pattugliamenti dello spazio Kor Mereti. Tele'ek ti dice: "Abbiamo [deciso, ipotizzato] che la Mente abbia più probabilità di essere accolta nella [coscienza gestaltica] Mereti se si trova fisicamente nel loro [territorio, spazio]. Il nostro obiettivo è installarla dentro lo [scafo, guscio] di una delle loro stazioni spaziali. Tu porterai la [squadra, forza d'attacco] che se ne occupa, e la nostra flotta ti [proteggerà, farà da scudo]."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mind 3|	It will take them some time to make the necessary modifications to the Mind. In the meantime, Tele'ek suggests that you should prepare for a major battle. "When you are ready," he says, "go to <planet> and rendezvous with the fleet that will accompany you to the Mereti system."|987|0
units.english: It will take them some time to make the necessary modifications to the Mind. In the meantime, Tele'ek suggests that you should prepare for a major battle. "When you are ready," he says, "go to <planet> and rendezvous with the fleet that will accompany you to the Mereti system."
units.italian: Ci vorrà un po' di tempo perché facciano le modifiche necessarie alla Mente. Nel frattempo Tele'ek ti suggerisce di prepararti a una battaglia importante. "Quando sei pronto," dice, "va' su <planet> e incontrati con la flotta che ti accompagnerà nel sistema Mereti."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mind 4|name|1014|0
units.english: Return to <planet>
units.italian: Ritorna su <planet>

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mind 4|description|1015|0
units.english: Escort the Wanderer fleet back to <planet>, where you will prepare to infiltrate the Kor Mereti station.
units.italian: Scorta la flotta dei Wanderers fino a <planet>, dove ti preparerai a infiltrarti nella stazione Kor Mereti.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mind 4|A Wanderer fleet is waiting here to take part in the attempt at joining the Wanderer Mind to the Kor Mereti. You notice that some of the ships that will be accompanying you are of yet another new design that you have never seen before; the Wanderer war machine is continuing to ramp up with remarkable speed.|1022|0
units.english: A Wanderer fleet is waiting here to take part in the attempt at joining the Wanderer Mind to the Kor Mereti. You notice that some of the ships that will be accompanying you are of yet another new design that you have never seen before; the Wanderer war machine is continuing to ramp up with remarkable speed.
units.italian: Qui è in attesa una flotta dei Wanderers che prenderà parte al tentativo di unire la Mente dei Wanderers ai Kor Mereti. Noti che alcune delle navi che ti accompagneranno sono di un altro modello ancora, che non hai mai visto; la macchina da guerra dei Wanderers continua a crescere a un ritmo notevole.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mind 5|name|1029|0
units.english: Install the Mind
units.italian: Installa la Mente

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mind 5|description|1030|0
units.english: A Wanderer fleet will accompany you to the Chimitarp system, to install the Mind on the Korath station there.
units.italian: Una flotta dei Wanderers ti accompagnerà nel sistema Chimitarp per installare la Mente sulla stazione Korath che c'è lì.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mind 5|blocked|1039|0
units.english: To take this mission, you will need <capacity> free.
units.italian: Per accettare questa missione ti serve <capacity> libera.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mind 5|log|1041|0
units.english: The Wanderers want to install one of their artificial Minds on a space station controlled by the Kor Mereti. Their theory is that if the Mind is physically located within a Kor Mereti station, the drones will be much more likely to accept it as part of their own network instead of reacting to it as an outside intruder.
units.italian: I Wanderers vogliono installare una delle loro Menti artificiali su una stazione spaziale controllata dai Kor Mereti. La loro teoria è che, se la Mente si trova fisicamente dentro una stazione Kor Mereti, i droni avranno molte più probabilità di accettarla come parte della propria rete invece di reagire a essa come a un intruso esterno.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mind 5|When you meet with him, Meto Pa'aret tells you, "We have added a [backdoor, failsafe] to the Mind so that we can shut it down or regain control of it remotely if the [attempt? experiment?] fails. So we may lose the Mind, but at least the Mereti will not [turn, use] it against us."|1043|0
units.english: When you meet with him, Meto Pa'aret tells you, "We have added a [backdoor, failsafe] to the Mind so that we can shut it down or regain control of it remotely if the [attempt? experiment?] fails. So we may lose the Mind, but at least the Mereti will not [turn, use] it against us."
units.italian: Quando lo incontri, Meto Pa'aret ti dice: "Abbiamo aggiunto alla Mente una [porta di servizio, misura di sicurezza] che ci permette di spegnerla o di riprenderne il controllo a distanza se il [tentativo? esperimento?] fallisce. Quindi potremmo perdere la Mente, ma almeno i Mereti non la [useranno, rivolteranno] contro di noi."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mind 5|	"Okay, I'm ready to give this a try!"|1045|0
units.english: "Okay, I'm ready to give this a try!"
units.italian: "Va bene, sono pronto a provare!"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mind 5|	"What do you think will happen when the Mind starts trying to access the Mereti network?"|1047|0
units.english: "What do you think will happen when the Mind starts trying to access the Mereti network?"
units.italian: "Che cosa pensi che succederà quando la Mente comincerà a cercare di accedere alla rete Mereti?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mind 5|	Pa'aret says, "It may take some time for the Mind to be [accepted, integrated] into their [consciousness?]. We may not know immediately if we have [succeeded? done the right thing?]."|1049|0
units.english: Pa'aret says, "It may take some time for the Mind to be [accepted, integrated] into their [consciousness?]. We may not know immediately if we have [succeeded? done the right thing?]."
units.italian: Pa'aret dice: "Potrebbe volerci un po' perché la Mente sia [accettata, integrata] nella loro [coscienza?]. Potremmo non sapere subito se abbiamo [avuto successo? fatto la cosa giusta?]."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mind 5|	A team of Wanderer engineers boards your ship, and you prepare to deliver them, along with the artificial Mind, to the Kor Mereti space station in the <system> system.|1052|0
units.english: A team of Wanderer engineers boards your ship, and you prepare to deliver them, along with the artificial Mind, to the Kor Mereti space station in the <system> system.
units.italian: Una squadra di ingegneri Wanderer sale sulla tua nave, e tu ti prepari a consegnarli, insieme alla Mente artificiale, alla stazione spaziale dei Kor Mereti nel sistema <system>.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mind 5|dialog|1055|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Wanderer engineers and the Mind hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it to arrive.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta che porta gli ingegneri Wanderer e la Mente non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mind 6|name|1111|0
units.english: Defend the Mind
units.italian: Difendi la Mente

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mind 6|description|1112|0
units.english: Fight off any of the Kor Mereti drones that are still attacking the Wanderers. Try not to anger the ones that seem to have switched sides.
units.italian: Respingi i droni Kor Mereti che stanno ancora attaccando i Wanderers. Cerca di non far arrabbiare quelli che sembrano essere passati dall'altra parte.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mind 6|With the Wanderer fleet keeping the automata off your back, you carefully pilot your ship into an abandoned docking bay. The Wanderers install the Mind in a niche near the back of the bay and then begin welding sheets of metal over the opening to prevent the Mereti drones from gaining easy access to the Mind to shut it down or destroy it. Meanwhile, every few seconds the bay is lit by a bright flash of weapons fire or exploding ships outside. Hopefully the Wanderer fleet is managing to hold its own against the drones.|1121|0
units.english: With the Wanderer fleet keeping the automata off your back, you carefully pilot your ship into an abandoned docking bay. The Wanderers install the Mind in a niche near the back of the bay and then begin welding sheets of metal over the opening to prevent the Mereti drones from gaining easy access to the Mind to shut it down or destroy it. Meanwhile, every few seconds the bay is lit by a bright flash of weapons fire or exploding ships outside. Hopefully the Wanderer fleet is managing to hold its own against the drones.
units.italian: Con la flotta dei Wanderers che tiene gli automi lontani dalle tue spalle, piloti con cautela la nave dentro un bacino di attracco abbandonato. I Wanderers installano la Mente in una nicchia vicino al fondo del bacino, poi cominciano a saldare lastre di metallo sopra l'apertura per impedire ai droni Mereti di accedere facilmente alla Mente e di spegnerla o distruggerla. Intanto, ogni pochi secondi il bacino viene illuminato da un lampo di armi o di navi che esplodono là fuori. Si spera che la flotta dei Wanderers riesca a tener testa ai droni.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mind 6|	Soon the engineers are done, and you return to your ship to take off. As soon as you depart, the bay doors, which seemed inactive when you first entered, slam shut, and your ship's sensors detect Korath hull repair drones swarming over the doors, welding them in place and piling new layers of hull material on top of them. There is no longer any possibility of returning to the bay to retrieve the Mind. And meanwhile, it is time to rejoin the battle...|1122|0
units.english: Soon the engineers are done, and you return to your ship to take off. As soon as you depart, the bay doors, which seemed inactive when you first entered, slam shut, and your ship's sensors detect Korath hull repair drones swarming over the doors, welding them in place and piling new layers of hull material on top of them. There is no longer any possibility of returning to the bay to retrieve the Mind. And meanwhile, it is time to rejoin the battle...
units.italian: Presto gli ingegneri hanno finito, e torni alla tua nave per decollare. Appena parti, le porte del bacino, che sembravano inattive quando sei entrato, si chiudono di colpo, e i sensori della tua nave rilevano droni di riparazione Korath che brulicano sulle porte, saldandole in posizione e accumulando sopra nuovi strati di materiale di scafo. Non c'è più alcuna possibilità di tornare al bacino per recuperare la Mente. E intanto è tempo di tornare in battaglia...

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mind 6|dialog|1125|0
units.english: This star system is in utter chaos. A vast number of Mereti drones are here. Some are attacking each other. Others are attacking the Wanderers. And still others, sadly, seem intent on attacking you. You'll have to hold them off as long as you can, while trying to stay on the good side of the drones that now seem to be defending you.
units.italian: Questo sistema stellare è nel caos più totale. Ci sono moltissimi droni Mereti. Alcuni si stanno attaccando a vicenda. Altri attaccano i Wanderers. E altri ancora, purtroppo, sembrano intenzionati ad attaccare te. Dovrai trattenerli il più a lungo possibile, cercando di restare nelle grazie dei droni che ora sembrano difenderti.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mind 6|dialog|1138|0
units.english: The last of the hostile Kor Mereti drones are destroyed; the remaining drones are not attacking the Wanderers. It is not entirely clear what has happened, but hopefully the Wanderers back on <planet> will have gained some information through the backdoor connection to their AI.
units.italian: Gli ultimi droni Kor Mereti ostili sono distrutti; i droni rimasti non attaccano i Wanderers. Non è del tutto chiaro che cosa sia successo, ma si spera che i Wanderers su <planet> abbiano ottenuto qualche informazione attraverso il collegamento alla porta di servizio della loro IA.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mind 6|dialog|1151|0
units.english: You've landed on <planet>, but there are still hostile Kor Mereti drones in the Chimitarp system. Better depart and make sure they've been taken care of.
units.italian: Sei atterrato su <planet>, ma ci sono ancora droni Kor Mereti ostili nel sistema Chimitarp. Meglio ripartire e assicurarti che siano stati sistemati.

units.id: event:wanderers: kor mereti transformation|add|1172|0
units.english: Far from the ruined cities, the Kor Mereti have begun building a sort of village of their own: a sprawling complex of greenhouses containing a wide variety of plant samples.
units.italian: Lontano dalle città in rovina, i Kor Mereti hanno cominciato a costruire una specie di villaggio proprio: un complesso esteso di serre che contengono una grande varietà di campioni vegetali.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mind 7|name|1176|0
units.english: Investigate <planet>
units.italian: Indaga su <planet>

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mind 7|description|1177|0
units.english: Visit <destination> and figure out what the Kor Mereti are doing there, now that they are apparently no longer hostile.
units.italian: Visita <destination> e scopri che cosa stanno facendo lì i Kor Mereti, ora che apparentemente non sono più ostili.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mind 7|The Wanderers back on <origin> are in a frenzy to know the outcome of the battle. Pa'aret tells you, "Less than a second after the Mind [made contact, merged] with the Mereti, it severed the [backdoor, failsafe] connection. So we have no [information, visibility] on what the Mind is doing or whether the Mereti [received, welcomed] it."|1186|0
units.english: The Wanderers back on <origin> are in a frenzy to know the outcome of the battle. Pa'aret tells you, "Less than a second after the Mind [made contact, merged] with the Mereti, it severed the [backdoor, failsafe] connection. So we have no [information, visibility] on what the Mind is doing or whether the Mereti [received, welcomed] it."
units.italian: I Wanderers su <origin> sono in fermento per sapere com'è andata la battaglia. Pa'aret ti dice: "Meno di un secondo dopo che la Mente è [entrata in contatto, si è fusa] con i Mereti, ha tagliato il collegamento con la [porta di servizio, misura di sicurezza]. Quindi non abbiamo [informazioni, visibilità] su che cosa stia facendo la Mente né se i Mereti [l'abbiano accolta, l'abbiano gradita]."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mind 7|	"Most of the drones started fighting on our side. That seems like a good sign."|1188|0
units.english: "Most of the drones started fighting on our side. That seems like a good sign."
units.italian: "La maggior parte dei droni ha cominciato a combattere dalla nostra parte. Mi sembra un buon segno."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mind 7|	"They've sealed up access to the Mind. There is no way we can get it back now."|1189|0
units.english: "They've sealed up access to the Mind. There is no way we can get it back now."
units.italian: "Hanno sigillato l'accesso alla Mente. Ora non c'è modo di recuperarla."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mind 7|	"Indeed," says Pa'aret. "But whatever [transformation, change] the Mind [wreaks, catalyzes] may not be complete. It is too soon to trust that we have [succeeded, chosen correctly]."|1192|0
units.english: "Indeed," says Pa'aret. "But whatever [transformation, change] the Mind [wreaks, catalyzes] may not be complete. It is too soon to trust that we have [succeeded, chosen correctly]."
units.italian: "Davvero," dice Pa'aret. "Ma qualunque [trasformazione, cambiamento] la Mente [provochi, catalizzi] potrebbe non essere completo. È troppo presto per fidarci di aver [avuto successo, scelto bene]."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mind 7|	"That is [gratifying, encouraging]," says Pa'aret. "Surely if they viewed it as an [intruder, enemy] they would have destroyed the Mind rather than building a [nest, fortress] to protect it."|1196|0
units.english: "That is [gratifying, encouraging]," says Pa'aret. "Surely if they viewed it as an [intruder, enemy] they would have destroyed the Mind rather than building a [nest, fortress] to protect it."
units.italian: "Questo è [gratificante, incoraggiante]," dice Pa'aret. "Di certo, se l'avessero visto come un [intruso, nemico], avrebbero distrutto la Mente invece di costruire un [nido, fortino] per proteggerla."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mind 7|	A few minutes later Tele'ek arrives with some scout ships from the Wanderer fleet. "The drones have sealed up every [entrance, ingress] to that station," he says, "and they are [swarming, gathering] around it [protectively, jealously]. There is no way we can return there to [discover, assess] what is happening inside. And there is also some [activity, development] on the planet's surface."|1199|0
units.english: A few minutes later Tele'ek arrives with some scout ships from the Wanderer fleet. "The drones have sealed up every [entrance, ingress] to that station," he says, "and they are [swarming, gathering] around it [protectively, jealously]. There is no way we can return there to [discover, assess] what is happening inside. And there is also some [activity, development] on the planet's surface."
units.italian: Pochi minuti dopo arriva Tele'ek con alcune navi esploratrici della flotta dei Wanderers. "I droni hanno sigillato ogni [ingresso, accesso] a quella stazione," dice, "e le [brulicano, si radunano] intorno [in modo protettivo, geloso]. Non c'è modo di tornare lì per [scoprire, valutare] che cosa succede dentro. E c'è anche una certa [attività, novità] sulla superficie del pianeta."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mind 7|	"What sort of activity?"|1201|0
units.english: "What sort of activity?"
units.italian: "Che tipo di attività?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mind 7|	"I'd like to go and investigate."|1202|0
units.english: "I'd like to go and investigate."
units.italian: "Vorrei andare a indagare."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mind 7|	"They seem to be [scavenging, hunting] for resources to build something," says Pa'aret. "It is [strange, surprising]; the Mereti drones until now were ignoring the planets in their [systems, territory]. Would you be [willing, bold] to land your ship on the surface and investigate?" You agree to do so.|1205|0
units.english: "They seem to be [scavenging, hunting] for resources to build something," says Pa'aret. "It is [strange, surprising]; the Mereti drones until now were ignoring the planets in their [systems, territory]. Would you be [willing, bold] to land your ship on the surface and investigate?" You agree to do so.
units.italian: "Sembrano [saccheggiare, cacciare] risorse per costruire qualcosa," dice Pa'aret. "È [strano, sorprendente]; finora i droni Mereti ignoravano i pianeti dei loro [sistemi, territorio]. Saresti [disposto, audace] ad atterrare sulla superficie e indagare?" Accetti di farlo.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mind 7|	The Wanderers wish you the best of luck, and you prepare to return to the <system> system. Hopefully the Mereti drones will not become hostile once more while you are landed on the planet's surface, exposed and relatively defenseless.|1208|0
units.english: The Wanderers wish you the best of luck, and you prepare to return to the <system> system. Hopefully the Mereti drones will not become hostile once more while you are landed on the planet's surface, exposed and relatively defenseless.
units.italian: I Wanderers ti augurano ogni fortuna, e tu ti prepari a tornare nel sistema <system>. Si spera che i droni Mereti non tornino ostili mentre sei atterrato sulla superficie del pianeta, esposto e relativamente indifeso.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mind 8|name|1215|0
units.english: Investigate <origin>
units.italian: Indaga su <origin>

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mind 8|description|1216|0
units.english: Report the new behavior of the Kor Mereti drones to the Wanderers.
units.italian: Riferisci ai Wanderers il nuovo comportamento dei droni Kor Mereti.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mind 8|blocked|1223|0
units.english: You will need 1 ton of cargo space to receive the next mission.
units.italian: Ti serve 1 tonnellata di spazio cargo per ricevere la prossima missione.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mind 8|log|1225|0
units.english: The Wanderer ploy has succeeded, but with an unexpected result. The Kor Mereti drones have so thoroughly absorbed the Wanderer Mind into their own consciousness that the drones now believe that they themselves are Wanderers.
units.italian: Il piano dei Wanderers è riuscito, ma con un risultato inatteso. I droni Kor Mereti hanno assorbito la Mente dei Wanderers nella propria coscienza così a fondo che ora i droni credono di essere loro stessi Wanderers.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mind 8|As you come in for a landing, you see that the Kor Mereti drones, which up until recently had been ignoring the surfaces of the planets they controlled, are now constructing some sort of facility on <origin>. Sunlight glints off the fresh and spotless buildings, but it is not until you are only a few dozen meters above it that you realize what the facility is.|1227|0
units.english: As you come in for a landing, you see that the Kor Mereti drones, which up until recently had been ignoring the surfaces of the planets they controlled, are now constructing some sort of facility on <origin>. Sunlight glints off the fresh and spotless buildings, but it is not until you are only a few dozen meters above it that you realize what the facility is.
units.italian: Mentre ti avvicini per atterrare, vedi che i droni Kor Mereti, che fino a poco tempo fa ignoravano le superfici dei pianeti che controllavano, stanno ora costruendo una specie di struttura su <origin>. La luce del sole brilla sui nuovi edifici immacolati, ma solo quando sei a poche decine di metri sopra di essa capisci che cos'è quella struttura.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mind 8|	It is a greenhouse.|1228|0
units.english: It is a greenhouse.
units.italian: È proprio una serra.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mind 8|	Inside the facility are rows and rows of plants of all different shapes and sizes. Like the Mereti drones themselves, the layout of the facility is random and haphazard. Drones nearly the size of a shuttlecraft buzz around it like bees, some of them arriving with fresh samples and others tending and watering the plants.|1229|0
units.english: Inside the facility are rows and rows of plants of all different shapes and sizes. Like the Mereti drones themselves, the layout of the facility is random and haphazard. Drones nearly the size of a shuttlecraft buzz around it like bees, some of them arriving with fresh samples and others tending and watering the plants.
units.italian: Dentro la struttura ci sono file e file di piante di ogni forma e dimensione. Come i droni Mereti stessi, la disposizione della struttura è casuale e disordinata. Droni grandi quasi quanto una navetta ronzano intorno come api, alcuni arrivano con campioni freschi e altri si prendono cura delle piante e le annaffiano.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mind 8|	A few drones approach your ship when it lands, and one of them speaks in a booming, synthesized voice. "You are the human who helped us [fight, resist] the warlike Hai," it says. "You are our friend."|1230|0
units.english: A few drones approach your ship when it lands, and one of them speaks in a booming, synthesized voice. "You are the human who helped us [fight, resist] the warlike Hai," it says. "You are our friend."
units.italian: Alcuni droni si avvicinano alla tua nave quando atterra, e uno di loro parla con una voce tonante e sintetizzata. "Tu sei l'umano che ci ha aiutato a [combattere, resistere] gli Hai bellicosi," dice. "Tu sei nostro amico."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mind 8|	"Do you mean that I helped the Wanderers? I don't recall the Unfettered entering Korath space or attacking you."|1232|0
units.english: "Do you mean that I helped the Wanderers? I don't recall the Unfettered entering Korath space or attacking you."
units.italian: "Vuoi dire che ho aiutato i Wanderers? Non ricordo che gli Slegati siano entrati nello spazio Korath o che vi abbiano attaccato."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mind 8|	"Yes, I am your friend."|1233|0
units.english: "Yes, I am your friend."
units.italian: "Sì, sono vostro amico."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mind 8|	The drone hesitates for a moment as if confused, then says, "You helped us [hold back, resist] the Unfettered in our old territory, for long enough that we could enter the Eye, and Molt, and take on our new [form, essence]."|1236|0
units.english: The drone hesitates for a moment as if confused, then says, "You helped us [hold back, resist] the Unfettered in our old territory, for long enough that we could enter the Eye, and Molt, and take on our new [form, essence]."
units.italian: Il drone esita un momento come confuso, poi dice: "Ci hai aiutato a [trattenere, resistere] gli Slegati nel nostro vecchio territorio, abbastanza a lungo da poter entrare nell'Occhio, e mutare, e assumere la nostra nuova [forma, essenza]."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mind 8|	The drone says, "We are grateful to you. You [won, earned] us enough time to enter the Eye, and Molt, and take on our new [form, essence]."|1240|0
units.english: The drone says, "We are grateful to you. You [won, earned] us enough time to enter the Eye, and Molt, and take on our new [form, essence]."
units.italian: Il drone dice: "Ti siamo grati. Ci hai [conquistato, guadagnato] abbastanza tempo per entrare nell'Occhio, e mutare, e assumere la nostra nuova [forma, essenza]."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mind 8|	"You are not Wanderers. You were created by the Korath."|1244|0
units.english: "You are not Wanderers. You were created by the Korath."
units.italian: "Non siete Wanderers. Siete stati creati dai Korath."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mind 8|	"Are you saying that you are the new form of the Wanderers?"|1246|0
units.english: "Are you saying that you are the new form of the Wanderers?"
units.italian: "Stai dicendo che siete la nuova forma dei Wanderers?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mind 8|	The drone repeats, "We entered the Eye. We took on a new form. We are the [children, offspring] born to the Wanderers in their new place of [sojourn, wandering]."|1248|0
units.english: The drone repeats, "We entered the Eye. We took on a new form. We are the [children, offspring] born to the Wanderers in their new place of [sojourn, wandering]."
units.italian: Il drone ripete: "Siamo entrati nell'Occhio. Abbiamo assunto una nuova forma. Siamo i [figli, la prole] nati dai Wanderers nel loro nuovo luogo di [soggiorno, peregrinazione]."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mind 8|	The drone says, haltingly, "The Korath. The Korath... created our bodies? Yes, the Korath created our bodies." It sounds like it's either conversing with someone else, or perhaps trying hard to remember something. "Yes, but the Wanderers..." It tilts its body closer to you. In a slightly less booming voice, which is perhaps its attempt at a whisper, it says, "The Wanderers created our soul."|1252|0
units.english: The drone says, haltingly, "The Korath. The Korath... created our bodies? Yes, the Korath created our bodies." It sounds like it's either conversing with someone else, or perhaps trying hard to remember something. "Yes, but the Wanderers..." It tilts its body closer to you. In a slightly less booming voice, which is perhaps its attempt at a whisper, it says, "The Wanderers created our soul."
units.italian: Il drone dice, con esitazione: "I Korath. I Korath... hanno creato i nostri corpi? Sì, i Korath hanno creato i nostri corpi." Sembra che stia conversando con qualcun altro, o forse che si stia sforzando di ricordare qualcosa. "Sì, ma i Wanderers..." Inclina il corpo verso di te. Con una voce un po' meno tonante, che forse è il suo tentativo di sussurrare, dice: "I Wanderers hanno creato la nostra anima."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mind 8|	While you are still trying to process the drone's statement, another drone comes flying out of the greenhouse facility carrying a large square metal pot. The pot is filled with soil, and in the soil is planted a small, very dry-looking bush with a few dead leaves clinging to it. "We broke it," says the drone. "Fix it please."|1255|0
units.english: While you are still trying to process the drone's statement, another drone comes flying out of the greenhouse facility carrying a large square metal pot. The pot is filled with soil, and in the soil is planted a small, very dry-looking bush with a few dead leaves clinging to it. "We broke it," says the drone. "Fix it please."
units.italian: Mentre stai ancora cercando di elaborare la dichiarazione del drone, un altro drone esce volando dalla serra portando un grande vaso metallico quadrato. Il vaso è pieno di terra, e nella terra è piantato un piccolo cespuglio dall'aspetto molto secco, con qualche foglia morta ancora attaccata. "L'abbiamo rotto," dice il drone. "Riparalo, per favore."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mind 8|	"I think it's dead."|1257|0
units.english: "I think it's dead."
units.italian: "Credo che sia morto."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mind 8|	(Look at the plant more closely.)|1259|0
units.english: (Look at the plant more closely.)
units.italian: (Guarda la pianta più da vicino.)

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mind 8|	The plant is dry and brittle, and shows no signs of life. "I'm sorry," you say, "but I think it's dead."|1261|0
units.english: The plant is dry and brittle, and shows no signs of life. "I'm sorry," you say, "but I think it's dead."
units.italian: La pianta è secca e fragile e non mostra segni di vita. "Mi dispiace," dici, "ma credo che sia morta."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mind 8|	The drone says, "We gave it water. But maybe the dirt was [poisoned, unhealthy]. Or the light is too bright. A human cannot fix it, but our [parents? ancestors?] would know how. Will you bring it to them?"|1264|0
units.english: The drone says, "We gave it water. But maybe the dirt was [poisoned, unhealthy]. Or the light is too bright. A human cannot fix it, but our [parents? ancestors?] would know how. Will you bring it to them?"
units.italian: Il drone dice: "Gli abbiamo dato acqua. Ma forse la terra era [avvelenata, malsana]. O la luce è troppo forte. Un umano non può ripararlo, ma i nostri [genitori? antenati?] saprebbero come fare. Lo porterai da loro?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mind 8|	They seem too distraught about the dead plant to be willing to give you more information about themselves. Despite the absurdity of the situation, you agree to take the plant back to the Wanderers and see if they can do anything for it.|1265|0
units.english: They seem too distraught about the dead plant to be willing to give you more information about themselves. Despite the absurdity of the situation, you agree to take the plant back to the Wanderers and see if they can do anything for it.
units.italian: Sembrano troppo sconvolti per la pianta morta per essere disposti a darti altre informazioni su loro stessi. Nonostante l'assurdità della situazione, accetti di riportare la pianta ai Wanderers e di vedere se possono fare qualcosa per lei.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mind 8|dialog|1268|0
units.english: You've reached <planet>, but your escort who is carrying the dead plant hasn't arrived in the system yet. Better depart and wait for it.
units.italian: Hai raggiunto <planet>, ma la tua scorta che porta la pianta morta non è ancora arrivata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mentors 1|name|1274|0
units.english: Visit <planet>
units.italian: Visita <planet>

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mentors 1|description|1275|0
units.english: Travel to <planet> to meet up with a team of Wanderer professors and scientists who are eager to work with the Kor Mereti drones.
units.italian: Recati su <planet> per incontrare una squadra di professori e scienziati Wanderer che non vedono l'ora di lavorare con i droni Kor Mereti.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mentors 1|log|1282|0
units.english: The Wanderers have come to believe that prior to the introduction of their Mind, the Kor Mereti network was not actually a self-aware entity, but that it has now become a sentient being in its own right. And, it is apparently a sentient being with a deep interest in gardening.
units.italian: I Wanderers sono arrivati a credere che, prima dell'introduzione della loro Mente, la rete Kor Mereti non fosse in realtà un'entità autocosciente, ma che ora sia diventata un essere senziente a tutti gli effetti. E, a quanto pare, è un essere senziente con un profondo interesse per il giardinaggio.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mentors 1|It must reveal something interesting about Wanderer psychology that when you return, they are more interested in poking and prodding the dead plant than in hearing your report about the Mereti drones. But once they've sent off a soil sample to be analyzed and can achieve no more until the results come back, they listen to your story.|1284|0
units.english: It must reveal something interesting about Wanderer psychology that when you return, they are more interested in poking and prodding the dead plant than in hearing your report about the Mereti drones. But once they've sent off a soil sample to be analyzed and can achieve no more until the results come back, they listen to your story.
units.italian: Deve pur dire qualcosa di interessante sulla psicologia dei Wanderers il fatto che, al tuo ritorno, siano più interessati a tastare e frugare la pianta morta che ad ascoltare il tuo rapporto sui droni Mereti. Ma dopo aver mandato un campione di terra da analizzare e non potendo fare altro finché non arrivano i risultati, ascoltano la tua storia.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mentors 1|	"Our goal was to communicate with them," says Tele'ek, "not to [destroy, erase] their identity and replace it with our own. What have we done?"|1285|0
units.english: "Our goal was to communicate with them," says Tele'ek, "not to [destroy, erase] their identity and replace it with our own. What have we done?"
units.italian: "Il nostro obiettivo era comunicare con loro," dice Tele'ek, "non [distruggere, cancellare] la loro identità e sostituirla con la nostra. Che cosa abbiamo fatto?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mentors 1|	Meto Pa'aret has been listening quietly, and finally speaks up. "Identity is the story the mind tells to [explain? justify? give meaning to?] its existence," he says. "Perhaps before our [intrusion, intervention] the Mereti had intelligence but no story, and thus no [self-awareness, consciousness]."|1286|0
units.english: Meto Pa'aret has been listening quietly, and finally speaks up. "Identity is the story the mind tells to [explain? justify? give meaning to?] its existence," he says. "Perhaps before our [intrusion, intervention] the Mereti had intelligence but no story, and thus no [self-awareness, consciousness]."
units.italian: Meto Pa'aret ha ascoltato in silenzio, e alla fine prende la parola. "L'identità è la storia che la mente racconta per [spiegare? giustificare? dare un senso a?] la propria esistenza," dice. "Forse prima del nostro [intervento, intrusione] i Mereti avevano intelligenza ma nessuna storia, e quindi nessuna [autocoscienza, coscienza di sé]."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mentors 1|	"Are you saying that we inadvertently created a sentient species?"|1288|0
units.english: "Are you saying that we inadvertently created a sentient species?"
units.italian: "Stai dicendo che abbiamo creato una specie senziente senza volerlo?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mentors 1|	"Does that make the Mereti less of a threat, or more of one?"|1289|0
units.english: "Does that make the Mereti less of a threat, or more of one?"
units.italian: "Questo rende i Mereti una minaccia minore, o maggiore?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mentors 1|	Your question is completely ignored as, in response to Pa'aret's comment, the other Wanderers gain a renewed interest in the potted plant. "Very sturdy [construction, joining]," says one, running a talon along the corner of the pot.|1291|0
units.english: Your question is completely ignored as, in response to Pa'aret's comment, the other Wanderers gain a renewed interest in the potted plant. "Very sturdy [construction, joining]," says one, running a talon along the corner of the pot.
units.italian: La tua domanda viene completamente ignorata: in risposta al commento di Pa'aret, gli altri Wanderers ritrovano interesse per la pianta in vaso. "Costruzione molto [solida, robusta]," dice uno, passando un artiglio lungo l'angolo del vaso.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mentors 1|	"Yes," says another, "but why make a [flower pot?] out of metal? It will oxidize."|1292|0
units.english: "Yes," says another, "but why make a [flower pot?] out of metal? It will oxidize."
units.italian: "Sì," dice un altro, "ma perché fare un [vaso da fiori?] di metallo? Si ossiderà."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mentors 1|	"They [learned, figured out] that the pot needs drainage holes," says another, looking at the bottom of the pot.|1293|0
units.english: "They [learned, figured out] that the pot needs drainage holes," says another, looking at the bottom of the pot.
units.italian: "Hanno [imparato, capito] che il vaso ha bisogno di fori di drenaggio," dice un altro, guardando il fondo del vaso.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mentors 1|	"This is excellent work for such a [young, immature] species," says Sobari Tele'ek, with a hint of pride.|1294|0
units.english: "This is excellent work for such a [young, immature] species," says Sobari Tele'ek, with a hint of pride.
units.italian: "È un lavoro eccellente per una specie così [giovane, immatura]," dice Sobari Tele'ek, con un accenno di orgoglio.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mentors 1|	"I'm sorry to interrupt, but have any of you thought through the implications of having created a new sentient species?"|1296|0
units.english: "I'm sorry to interrupt, but have any of you thought through the implications of having created a new sentient species?"
units.italian: "Mi dispiace interrompere, ma qualcuno di voi ha riflettuto sulle conseguenze di aver creato una nuova specie senziente?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mentors 1|	They are all silent for a moment, then Pa'aret says, "They will need [mentors, teachers]."|1298|0
units.english: They are all silent for a moment, then Pa'aret says, "They will need [mentors, teachers]."
units.italian: Restano tutti in silenzio per un momento, poi Pa'aret dice: "Avranno bisogno di [mentori, insegnanti]."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mentors 1|	Tema'a Iriket, the terraforming director, says, "I will ask <planet> to send a team of [experts? professors?] immediately. Captain <last>, can you journey there and escort them safely through the Eye and to Korbatri Eska?"|1299|0
units.english: Tema'a Iriket, the terraforming director, says, "I will ask <planet> to send a team of [experts? professors?] immediately. Captain <last>, can you journey there and escort them safely through the Eye and to Korbatri Eska?"
units.italian: Tema'a Iriket, la direttrice del terraformaggio, dice: "Chiederò a <planet> di inviare subito una squadra di [esperti? professori?]. Capitano <last>, puoi andare là e scortarli al sicuro attraverso l'Occhio fino a Korbatri Eska?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mentors 1|	You agree to do so. The Wanderers switch into their own language and begin an impassioned conversation as you leave the room to head back to your ship.|1300|0
units.english: You agree to do so. The Wanderers switch into their own language and begin an impassioned conversation as you leave the room to head back to your ship.
units.italian: Accetti di farlo. I Wanderers passano alla loro lingua e cominciano una conversazione appassionata mentre tu lasci la stanza per tornare alla tua nave.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mentors 2|name|1307|0
units.english: Wanderers to <planet>
units.italian: Wanderer per <planet>

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mentors 2|description|1308|0
units.english: Escort this Wanderer transport safely to <planet>, where the scientists and professors on board will begin teaching and mentoring the Kor Mereti.
units.italian: Scorta questo trasporto dei Wanderers sano e salvo fino a <planet>, dove gli scienziati e i professori a bordo cominceranno a istruire e guidare i Kor Mereti.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mentors 2|A team of Wanderer terraforming experts has been assembled on <origin>. They have requisitioned a transport and filled it with an overwhelming variety of sensors, bioreactors, chemical filters, and other scientific devices. But, it's clear that none of them quite understand what is going on with the Kor Mereti. The team's manager says, "We are to meet with [sentient? awakened?] robots? They are interested in [foliage, plants]? There are worlds to be [repaired, healed]?"|1316|0
units.english: A team of Wanderer terraforming experts has been assembled on <origin>. They have requisitioned a transport and filled it with an overwhelming variety of sensors, bioreactors, chemical filters, and other scientific devices. But, it's clear that none of them quite understand what is going on with the Kor Mereti. The team's manager says, "We are to meet with [sentient? awakened?] robots? They are interested in [foliage, plants]? There are worlds to be [repaired, healed]?"
units.italian: Su <origin> è stata radunata una squadra di esperti di terraformaggio dei Wanderers. Hanno requisito un trasporto e l'hanno riempito di una varietà impressionante di sensori, bioreattori, filtri chimici e altri dispositivi scientifici. Ma è chiaro che nessuno di loro capisce bene che cosa stia succedendo con i Kor Mereti. Il responsabile della squadra dice: "Dobbiamo incontrarci con dei robot [senzienti? risvegliati?]? Sono interessati al [fogliame, alle piante]? Ci sono mondi da [riparare, guarire]?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mentors 2|	You do your best to answer their questions, but this is clearly not a situation that any of them had anticipated. Perhaps not even a situation that their species has ever had to deal with before, given that usually they are working in regions of space that have long since been abandoned by their former inhabitants.|1317|0
units.english: You do your best to answer their questions, but this is clearly not a situation that any of them had anticipated. Perhaps not even a situation that their species has ever had to deal with before, given that usually they are working in regions of space that have long since been abandoned by their former inhabitants.
units.italian: Fai del tuo meglio per rispondere alle loro domande, ma chiaramente questa non è una situazione che nessuno di loro avesse previsto. Forse nemmeno una situazione che la loro specie abbia mai dovuto affrontare, dato che di solito lavorano in regioni di spazio abbandonate da tempo dai loro antichi abitanti.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mentors 2|	The transport gets ready to follow you back to <planet>, where hopefully more of their questions will be answered.|1318|0
units.english: The transport gets ready to follow you back to <planet>, where hopefully more of their questions will be answered.
units.italian: Il trasporto si prepara a seguirti di nuovo fino a <planet>, dove si spera che altre loro domande troveranno risposta.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mentors 2|dialog|1325|0
units.english: You've reached <planet>, but you left the Wanderer ship behind. Better depart and wait for it to arrive.
units.italian: Hai raggiunto <planet>, ma hai lasciato indietro la nave dei Wanderers. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mentors 3|name|1331|0
units.english: Return to <planet>
units.italian: Ritorna su <planet>

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mentors 3|description|1332|0
units.english: Return to <planet> to see what the Wanderer leaders have planned next.
units.italian: Torna su <planet> per vedere che cosa hanno in programma adesso i capi dei Wanderers.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mentors 3|log|1339|0
units.english: Brought a group of Wanderer mentors and teachers to one of the Kor Mereti worlds, where they will seek to build a relationship with the drones and to help them learn to care for living things and to join in the Wanderer work of healing devastated planets.
units.italian: Hai portato un gruppo di mentori e insegnanti Wanderer su uno dei mondi dei Kor Mereti, dove cercheranno di costruire un rapporto con i droni e di aiutarli a imparare a prendersi cura delle cose viventi e a unirsi al lavoro dei Wanderers di guarigione dei pianeti devastati.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mentors 3|When you last left <origin>, there were less than a dozen buildings in the greenhouse facility. It has now grown to the size of a major spaceport, including some towers that are dozens of stories high. Some plants now grow on open-air terraces; others are in domed enclosures tall enough to house fully-grown trees. The larger domes also have birds flying about inside them, and some larger land animals as well. Everything is built of gleaming steel and glass and filled with lush vegetation; from high above the facility looks like a scattered handful of diamonds and emeralds.|1341|0
units.english: When you last left <origin>, there were less than a dozen buildings in the greenhouse facility. It has now grown to the size of a major spaceport, including some towers that are dozens of stories high. Some plants now grow on open-air terraces; others are in domed enclosures tall enough to house fully-grown trees. The larger domes also have birds flying about inside them, and some larger land animals as well. Everything is built of gleaming steel and glass and filled with lush vegetation; from high above the facility looks like a scattered handful of diamonds and emeralds.
units.italian: L'ultima volta che hai lasciato <origin>, nella struttura delle serre c'erano meno di una dozzina di edifici. Ora è cresciuta fino alle dimensioni di un grande spazioporto, con anche torri alte decine di piani. Alcune piante crescono ora su terrazze all'aperto; altre sono in cupole abbastanza alte da ospitare alberi adulti. Dentro le cupole più grandi volano anche uccelli, e ci sono anche animali terrestri più grandi. Tutto è costruito in acciaio e vetro scintillanti e pieno di vegetazione lussureggiante; dall'alto la struttura sembra una manciata sparsa di diamanti e smeraldi.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mentors 3|	The transport you were escorting was full of professors and researchers, who are clearly not used to any sort of military discipline or to living in a dangerous region of space: the moment the transport lands they fly off toward the greenhouse without bothering to wait for instructions from their supposed manager. Several of them are already engaged in conversation with the drones, while others are exploring the different rooms of the facility, examining plants and probing soil with their talons.|1342|0
units.english: The transport you were escorting was full of professors and researchers, who are clearly not used to any sort of military discipline or to living in a dangerous region of space: the moment the transport lands they fly off toward the greenhouse without bothering to wait for instructions from their supposed manager. Several of them are already engaged in conversation with the drones, while others are exploring the different rooms of the facility, examining plants and probing soil with their talons.
units.italian: Il trasporto che stavi scortando era pieno di professori e ricercatori, che chiaramente non sono abituati ad alcuna disciplina militare né a vivere in una regione pericolosa dello spazio: appena il trasporto atterra, volano via verso le serre senza preoccuparsi di aspettare istruzioni dal loro presunto responsabile. Alcuni stanno già conversando con i droni, mentre altri esplorano le diverse stanze della struttura, esaminando le piante e frugando la terra con gli artigli.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mentors 3|	The team's manager, already looking a bit overwhelmed, flies over to talk with you. "What are we [expected, requested] to do next?" he asks.|1343|0
units.english: The team's manager, already looking a bit overwhelmed, flies over to talk with you. "What are we [expected, requested] to do next?" he asks.
units.italian: Il responsabile della squadra, che sembra già un po' sopraffatto, vola da te per parlare. "Che cosa ci [si aspetta, si chiede] di fare adesso?" chiede.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mentors 3|	"Help the drones to learn to take care of the planets in this region."|1345|0
units.english: "Help the drones to learn to take care of the planets in this region."
units.italian: "Aiutate i droni a imparare a prendersi cura dei pianeti di questa regione."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mentors 3|	"Make sure the drones remain convinced that the Wanderers are on their side."|1346|0
units.english: "Make sure the drones remain convinced that the Wanderers are on their side."
units.italian: "Assicuratevi che i droni restino convinti che i Wanderers siano dalla loro parte."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mentors 3|	"Maybe see if the drones will share their technology with us? They have impressive weapons."|1348|0
units.english: "Maybe see if the drones will share their technology with us? They have impressive weapons."
units.italian: "Magari vedete se i droni sono disposti a condividere la loro tecnologia con noi? Hanno armi impressionanti."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mentors 3|	He says, "We will try to do that. But this, storing [plants, living things] in boxes made of metal, is not the Wanderer way. We seek to return worlds to their [natural, pristine] state, not to build our own [monuments, structures] on them."|1351|0
units.english: He says, "We will try to do that. But this, storing [plants, living things] in boxes made of metal, is not the Wanderer way. We seek to return worlds to their [natural, pristine] state, not to build our own [monuments, structures] on them."
units.italian: Dice: "Proveremo a farlo. Ma questo, rinchiudere [piante, cose viventi] in scatole di metallo, non è il modo dei Wanderers. Noi cerchiamo di riportare i mondi al loro stato [naturale, incontaminato], non di costruirvi sopra i nostri [monumenti, edifici]."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mentors 3|	"Very well," he says, "we will do that. Please return to <planet> and see what our [leaders, elders] think should be done next."|1355|0
units.english: "Very well," he says, "we will do that. Please return to <planet> and see what our [leaders, elders] think should be done next."
units.italian: "Molto bene," dice, "lo faremo. Per favore torna su <planet> e vedi che cosa pensano i nostri [capi, anziani] che si debba fare adesso."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mentors 3|	He doesn't seem enthusiastic about that suggestion. "Human," he says, "you have very different [priorities, goals] than we do. I am more [excited, intrigued] by the possibility of using these drones for [renewal, creation] than by their capacity for destruction."|1359|0
units.english: He doesn't seem enthusiastic about that suggestion. "Human," he says, "you have very different [priorities, goals] than we do. I am more [excited, intrigued] by the possibility of using these drones for [renewal, creation] than by their capacity for destruction."
units.italian: Non sembra entusiasta della proposta. "Umano," dice, "tu hai [priorità, obiettivi] molto diversi dai nostri. Sono più [entusiasta, incuriosito] dalla possibilità di usare questi droni per [la rigenerazione, la creazione] che dalla loro capacità di distruzione."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mentors 3|	You return to your ship. It will be interesting to see what else has changed the next time you return to this world.|1362|0
units.english: You return to your ship. It will be interesting to see what else has changed the next time you return to this world.
units.italian: Torni alla tua nave. Sarà interessante vedere che cos'altro è cambiato la prossima volta che tornerai su questo mondo.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mentors 3|The mood among the Wanderer leaders is much lighter now that the danger from the Mereti drones appears to have been eliminated. In fact, they're now so intrigued by the emergent Mereti consciousness that they don't seem to be thinking about the more distant threat of the drones in Kor Sestor space. Instead, they want to focus on their true calling: terraforming planets.|1368|0
units.english: The mood among the Wanderer leaders is much lighter now that the danger from the Mereti drones appears to have been eliminated. In fact, they're now so intrigued by the emergent Mereti consciousness that they don't seem to be thinking about the more distant threat of the drones in Kor Sestor space. Instead, they want to focus on their true calling: terraforming planets.
units.italian: L'umore fra i capi dei Wanderers è molto più leggero ora che il pericolo dei droni Mereti sembra eliminato. Anzi, ora sono così incuriositi dalla coscienza Mereti emergente che non sembrano pensare alla minaccia più lontana dei droni nello spazio Kor Sestor. Vogliono invece concentrarsi sulla loro vera vocazione: il terraformaggio dei pianeti.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mentors 3|	Sobari Tele'ek tells you, "We should take time to enjoy this [peace, respite]. We need not [face, deal with] the other drones immediately. We will be working to start a second [settlement, base] nearby. Visit us there when the base is [formed, established] and we will decide our next [actions, steps]. In the meantime, our latest ship of [war, defense] is now being produced on our [major, central] worlds, and you may buy one."|1369|0
units.english: Sobari Tele'ek tells you, "We should take time to enjoy this [peace, respite]. We need not [face, deal with] the other drones immediately. We will be working to start a second [settlement, base] nearby. Visit us there when the base is [formed, established] and we will decide our next [actions, steps]. In the meantime, our latest ship of [war, defense] is now being produced on our [major, central] worlds, and you may buy one."
units.italian: Sobari Tele'ek ti dice: "Dovremmo prenderci il tempo di goderci questa [pace, tregua]. Non dobbiamo [affrontare, occuparci di] subito degli altri droni. Lavoreremo per avviare un secondo [insediamento, avamposto] qui vicino. Vieni a trovarci là quando l'avamposto sarà [formato, stabilito] e decideremo i prossimi [passi, provvedimenti]. Nel frattempo la nostra ultima nave da [guerra, difesa] è ora in produzione sui nostri mondi [principali, centrali], e puoi comprarne una."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Tour 1|name|1375|0
units.english: Kor Efret Diplomacy
units.italian: Diplomazia Kor Efret

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Tour 1|description|1376|0
units.english: Visit Ektasi Rek on <planet> and see if the Kor Efret would like to come to <origin> for a diplomatic visit.
units.italian: Visita Ektasi Rek su <planet> e vedi se i Kor Efret gradirebbero venire su <origin> per una visita diplomatica.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Tour 1|Most of the Wanderer elders have moved to this world, to be more involved in the newest terraforming effort, which they clearly find much more rewarding than the battle against the drones. After listening to them talk for nearly an hour about soil restoration and atmospheric particulates and carbon cycles, you ask what you can help them with next.|1384|0
units.english: Most of the Wanderer elders have moved to this world, to be more involved in the newest terraforming effort, which they clearly find much more rewarding than the battle against the drones. After listening to them talk for nearly an hour about soil restoration and atmospheric particulates and carbon cycles, you ask what you can help them with next.
units.italian: La maggior parte degli anziani Wanderer si è trasferita su questo mondo per essere più coinvolta nell'ultimo sforzo di terraformaggio, che chiaramente trovano molto più gratificante della battaglia contro i droni. Dopo averli ascoltati parlare per quasi un'ora di ripristino del suolo, particolato atmosferico e cicli del carbonio, chiedi in che cosa puoi aiutarli adesso.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Tour 1|	Tema'a Iriket says, "We should take further action to [befriend, collaborate with] the Korath. Perhaps you could visit Rek, and [invite, welcome] her Korath friends to [witness, inspect] the work we are doing here? Our hope is that our next [settlement, project] will be a [joint effort?] with them."|1385|0
units.english: Tema'a Iriket says, "We should take further action to [befriend, collaborate with] the Korath. Perhaps you could visit Rek, and [invite, welcome] her Korath friends to [witness, inspect] the work we are doing here? Our hope is that our next [settlement, project] will be a [joint effort?] with them."
units.italian: Tema'a Iriket dice: "Dovremmo fare altri passi per [diventare amici, collaborare con] i Korath. Forse potresti visitare Rek e [invitare, accogliere] i suoi amici Korath a [vedere, ispezionare] il lavoro che facciamo qui? Speriamo che il nostro prossimo [insediamento, progetto] sia un [sforzo congiunto?] con loro."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Tour 1|	"Sure, I would be glad to do that."|1387|0
units.english: "Sure, I would be glad to do that."
units.italian: "Certo, lo farò volentieri."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Tour 1|	"What about dealing with the Sestor drones?"|1389|0
units.english: "What about dealing with the Sestor drones?"
units.italian: "E che cosa facciamo con i droni Sestor?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Tour 1|	"There will be [time, opportunity] for that later," says Iriket. "They are not a [threat, pressing concern] to us at this time."|1390|0
units.english: "There will be [time, opportunity] for that later," says Iriket. "They are not a [threat, pressing concern] to us at this time."
units.italian: "Ci sarà [tempo, occasione] anche per quello più avanti," dice Iriket. "Al momento non sono una [minaccia, preoccupazione urgente] per noi."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Tour 1|	You agree to visit the Kor Efreti and invite them to come back here for a visit.|1391|0
units.english: You agree to visit the Kor Efreti and invite them to come back here for a visit.
units.italian: Accetti di visitare i Kor Efret e di invitarli a tornare qui in visita.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Tour 2|name|1398|0
units.english: Kor Efret Diplomacy
units.italian: Diplomazia Kor Efret

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Tour 2|description|1399|0
units.english: Escort a Kor Efret ship back to <planet> for a diplomatic visit.
units.italian: Scorta una nave dei Kor Efret fino a <planet> per una visita diplomatica.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Tour 2|log|1405|0
units.english: Leading some of the friendly Korath on a tour through Wanderer space, to show them how successful the Wanderers have been at repairing and caring for worlds that have been damaged by war.
units.italian: Stai guidando alcuni dei Korath amichevoli in un tour attraverso lo spazio dei Wanderers, per mostrare loro quanto sono stati bravi i Wanderers a riparare e curare mondi danneggiati dalla guerra.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Tour 2|Rek is making marvelous progress not only in learning the Korath language, but also in winning their trust. They have built her a Wanderer-style treehouse here to live in, and it seems that she is entertaining a constant stream of new visitors. "What can I help you with?" she asks.|1407|0
units.english: Rek is making marvelous progress not only in learning the Korath language, but also in winning their trust. They have built her a Wanderer-style treehouse here to live in, and it seems that she is entertaining a constant stream of new visitors. "What can I help you with?" she asks.
units.italian: Rek sta facendo progressi meravigliosi non solo nell'imparare la lingua Korath, ma anche nel conquistare la loro fiducia. Le hanno costruito qui una casa sull'albero in stile Wanderer, e sembra che riceva un flusso continuo di nuovi visitatori. "In che cosa posso aiutarti?" chiede.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Tour 2|	"The Wanderers on <planet> want to invite some Kor Efret leaders to visit them."|1409|0
units.english: "The Wanderers on <planet> want to invite some Kor Efret leaders to visit them."
units.italian: "I Wanderers su <planet> vogliono invitare alcuni capi Kor Efret a far loro visita."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Tour 2|	"What is your impression of the Korath so far?"|1411|0
units.english: "What is your impression of the Korath so far?"
units.italian: "Che impressione ti stanno facendo i Korath finora?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Tour 2|	She says, "We Wanderers have seen the ruins left behind by so many failed species. It puzzles us greatly to wonder why some are able to transition to a strong and stable and sustainable civilization, as we have done, while others descend into chaos. The Kor Efret hope that what they build out of the ashes will finally be a society of true peace and prosperity."|1412|0
units.english: She says, "We Wanderers have seen the ruins left behind by so many failed species. It puzzles us greatly to wonder why some are able to transition to a strong and stable and sustainable civilization, as we have done, while others descend into chaos. The Kor Efret hope that what they build out of the ashes will finally be a society of true peace and prosperity."
units.italian: Dice: "Noi Wanderers abbiamo visto le rovine lasciate da tante specie fallite. Ci lascia molto perplessi chiederci perché alcune riescano a passare a una civiltà forte, stabile e sostenibile, come abbiamo fatto noi, mentre altre scivolano nel caos. I Kor Efret sperano che ciò che costruiranno dalle ceneri sia finalmente una società di vera pace e prosperità."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Tour 2|	You tell her about the Wanderer invitation, and she takes you to visit some of the Korath leaders. They are eager to learn more about the Wanderers, but after some negotiation they make it clear that they would prefer to travel in one of their own ships, and with Rek as their guest, rather than going as your passengers.|1414|0
units.english: You tell her about the Wanderer invitation, and she takes you to visit some of the Korath leaders. They are eager to learn more about the Wanderers, but after some negotiation they make it clear that they would prefer to travel in one of their own ships, and with Rek as their guest, rather than going as your passengers.
units.italian: Le parli dell'invito dei Wanderers, e lei ti porta a visitare alcuni dei capi Korath. Sono impazienti di saperne di più sui Wanderers, ma dopo qualche trattativa chiariscono che preferirebbero viaggiare su una loro nave, con Rek come ospite, piuttosto che come tuoi passeggeri.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Tour 2|	(Agree to escort their ship to <planet>.)|1416|0
units.english: (Agree to escort their ship to <planet>.)
units.italian: (Accetta di scortare la loro nave fino a <planet>.)

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Tour 2|	"I think you might be safer if you travel aboard my ship."|1418|0
units.english: "I think you might be safer if you travel aboard my ship."
units.italian: "Credo che sareste più al sicuro se viaggiaste sulla mia nave."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Tour 2|	Rek talks with them for a while, then explains to you, "They want to be in control of their own journey, rather than being no more than 'living cargo' aboard an alien ship. It sounds like this is a matter of honor." Since it seems like the only option, you agree to let them follow you to <planet> in their own ship.|1419|0
units.english: Rek talks with them for a while, then explains to you, "They want to be in control of their own journey, rather than being no more than 'living cargo' aboard an alien ship. It sounds like this is a matter of honor." Since it seems like the only option, you agree to let them follow you to <planet> in their own ship.
units.italian: Rek parla con loro per un po', poi ti spiega: "Vogliono avere il controllo del proprio viaggio, invece di essere solo 'carico vivo' su una nave aliena. Sembra che sia una questione d'onore." Dato che sembra l'unica opzione, accetti di lasciare che ti seguano fino a <planet> sulla loro nave.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Tour 2|dialog|1422|0
units.english: You've reached <planet>, but the Korath ship isn't here yet. Better depart and wait for it to arrive.
units.italian: Hai raggiunto <planet>, ma la nave dei Korath non è ancora qui. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Tour 3|name|1432|0
units.english: Kor Efret Tour
units.italian: Tour dei Kor Efret

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Tour 3|description|1433|0
units.english: Escort a Kor Efret ship to <planet>, to give them a taste of what Wanderer terraforming of a world can achieve.
units.italian: Scorta una nave dei Kor Efret fino a <planet>, per dare loro un assaggio di ciò che il terraformaggio dei Wanderers può ottenere su un mondo.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Tour 3|The Kor Efret ship lands next to yours, and Rek brings their leaders to meet with the Wanderers. They spend nearly the whole day being led around the settlement, asking questions and inspecting the Wanderer terraforming equipment. But at last, one of the Korath leaders says, "How long until we will see the change here? How long until it will be clear that your plans will work?"|1440|0
units.english: The Kor Efret ship lands next to yours, and Rek brings their leaders to meet with the Wanderers. They spend nearly the whole day being led around the settlement, asking questions and inspecting the Wanderer terraforming equipment. But at last, one of the Korath leaders says, "How long until we will see the change here? How long until it will be clear that your plans will work?"
units.italian: La nave dei Kor Efret atterra accanto alla tua, e Rek porta i loro capi a incontrare i Wanderers. Passano quasi l'intera giornata a farsi guidare per l'insediamento, facendo domande e ispezionando l'attrezzatura di terraformaggio dei Wanderers. Ma alla fine uno dei capi Korath dice: "Quanto ci vorrà per vedere il cambiamento qui? Quanto ci vorrà perché sia chiaro che i vostri piani funzioneranno?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Tour 3|	When Tema'a Iriket, translating through Rek, explains that it will take centuries, the leader says, "Can you show us a world where you have completed your work?"|1441|0
units.english: When Tema'a Iriket, translating through Rek, explains that it will take centuries, the leader says, "Can you show us a world where you have completed your work?"
units.italian: Quando Tema'a Iriket, traducendo tramite Rek, spiega che ci vorranno secoli, il capo dice: "Potete mostrarci un mondo dove avete completato il vostro lavoro?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Tour 3|	The Wanderers discuss that, and Tele'ek says, "They should [visit, journey to] <planet>, and be shown what we can achieve at the [apex, conclusion] of our work. Captain <last>, will you [accompany, lead] them to there?"|1442|0
units.english: The Wanderers discuss that, and Tele'ek says, "They should [visit, journey to] <planet>, and be shown what we can achieve at the [apex, conclusion] of our work. Captain <last>, will you [accompany, lead] them to there?"
units.italian: I Wanderers ne discutono, e Tele'ek dice: "Dovrebbero [visitare, recarsi su] <planet> e vedere che cosa possiamo ottenere al [culmine, termine] del nostro lavoro. Capitano <last>, vuoi [accompagnarli, condurli] là?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Tour 3|	"Sure, I would be glad to."|1444|0
units.english: "Sure, I would be glad to."
units.italian: "Certo, con piacere."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Tour 3|	"Are you sure it is safe to let them bring their ship to your homeworld?"|1446|0
units.english: "Are you sure it is safe to let them bring their ship to your homeworld?"
units.italian: "Sei sicuro che sia sicuro lasciarli portare la loro nave sul vostro mondo d'origine?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Tour 3|	Tele'ek says, "If we do not [choose, take a risk] to trust them, they will never have [opportunity, impetus] to show themselves trustworthy. So, we will take the [first, catalyzing] step."|1447|0
units.english: Tele'ek says, "If we do not [choose, take a risk] to trust them, they will never have [opportunity, impetus] to show themselves trustworthy. So, we will take the [first, catalyzing] step."
units.italian: Tele'ek dice: "Se non [scegliamo, rischiamo] di fidarci di loro, non avranno mai [occasione, motivo] di mostrarsi degni di fiducia. Quindi faremo noi il [primo, decisivo] passo."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Tour 3|	You agree to escort the Kor Efret ship on a journey through the wormhole to <planet>.|1448|0
units.english: You agree to escort the Kor Efret ship on a journey through the wormhole to <planet>.
units.italian: Accetti di scortare la nave dei Kor Efret in un viaggio attraverso il cunicolo fino a <planet>.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Tour 3|dialog|1451|0
units.english: You've reached <planet>, but the Korath ship isn't here yet. Better depart and wait for it to arrive.
units.italian: Hai raggiunto <planet>, ma la nave dei Korath non è ancora qui. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Tour 4|name|1461|0
units.english: Kor Efret Tour
units.italian: Tour dei Kor Efret

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Tour 4|description|1462|0
units.english: Escort a Kor Efret ship to <planet>, to show them how Wanderer farming worlds are run.
units.italian: Scorta una nave dei Kor Efret fino a <planet>, per mostrare loro come funzionano i mondi agricoli dei Wanderers.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Tour 4|The Kor Efret are awed by the treetop villages, the towering buildings, and the bustling spaceport here on <origin>. But what moves them most deeply is the wild forests and mountains outside the city. After being led there by some of the local Wanderer leaders, they stand for half an hour just watching the trees swaying in the wind and the birds circling overhead. A few of them make a strange barking, keening noise, and Rek tells you they are weeping: mourning the fact that few places this beautiful and unspoiled are left on their own worlds.|1469|0
units.english: The Kor Efret are awed by the treetop villages, the towering buildings, and the bustling spaceport here on <origin>.
