But what moves them most deeply is the wild forests and mountains outside the city. After being led there by some of the local Wanderer leaders, they stand for half an hour just watching the trees swaying in the wind and the birds circling overhead. A few of them make a strange barking, keening noise, and Rek tells you they are weeping: mourning the fact that few places this beautiful and unspoiled are left on their own worlds.
units.italian: I Kor Efret sono pieni di meraviglia davanti ai villaggi sugli alberi, agli edifici altissimi e allo spazioporto affollato di <origin>. Ma ciò che li tocca più profondamente sono le foreste selvagge e le montagne fuori dalla città. Dopo esservi stati condotti da alcuni capi Wanderer del posto, restano mezz'ora fermi a guardare gli alberi che ondeggiano nel vento e gli uccelli che girano in cerchio sopra di loro. Alcuni emettono uno strano suono, fra l'abbaiare e il lamento, e Rek ti dice che stanno piangendo: piangono il fatto che sui loro mondi siano rimasti pochi luoghi così belli e intatti.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Tour 4|	The Korath are eager to see more places of natural beauty like this one, and the Wanderer leaders suggest that they travel to <planet> next, to see how the Wanderers have built farms that will produce rich crops year after year without depleting the soil.|1470|0
units.english: The Korath are eager to see more places of natural beauty like this one, and the Wanderer leaders suggest that they travel to <planet> next, to see how the Wanderers have built farms that will produce rich crops year after year without depleting the soil.
units.italian: I Korath sono impazienti di vedere altri luoghi di bellezza naturale come questo, e i capi dei Wanderers suggeriscono di andare poi su <planet>, per vedere come i Wanderers hanno costruito fattorie che producono ricchi raccolti anno dopo anno senza esaurire il suolo.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Tour 4|dialog|1473|0
units.english: You've reached <planet>, but the Korath ship isn't here yet. Better depart and wait for it to arrive.
units.italian: Hai raggiunto <planet>, ma la nave dei Korath non è ancora qui. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Tour 5|name|1483|0
units.english: Kor Efret Tour
units.italian: Tour dei Kor Efret

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Tour 5|description|1484|0
units.english: Escort a Kor Efret ship to <planet>, where the Wanderers are battling the Unfettered.
units.italian: Scorta una nave dei Kor Efret fino a <planet>, dove i Wanderers stanno combattendo contro gli Slegati.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Tour 5|The Korath are very interested to see how the farms here work. "We are trying to learn to do this on our worlds," one of them explains, "but there has been blight, and drought, and crops that fail for reasons we do not even understand." The Wanderer scientists here do their best to explain how they keep the crops and the soil healthy, with Rek working hard to translate their technical jargon into terms that the Korath can understand.|1491|0
units.english: The Korath are very interested to see how the farms here work. "We are trying to learn to do this on our worlds," one of them explains, "but there has been blight, and drought, and crops that fail for reasons we do not even understand." The Wanderer scientists here do their best to explain how they keep the crops and the soil healthy, with Rek working hard to translate their technical jargon into terms that the Korath can understand.
units.italian: I Korath sono molto interessati a vedere come funzionano le fattorie qui. "Stiamo cercando di imparare a farlo sui nostri mondi," spiega uno di loro, "ma ci sono state malattie delle piante, siccità e raccolti che falliscono per ragioni che non capiamo nemmeno." Gli scienziati Wanderer del posto fanno del loro meglio per spiegare come mantengono sani i raccolti e il suolo, con Rek che si sforza di tradurre il loro gergo tecnico in termini che i Korath possano capire.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Tour 5|	When they have completed their tour, Rek says to you in your own language, "<first>, I think we should show them <planet> next. We should show them the war with the Unfettered. If they see that we are few in number, embattled, with only a handful of worlds, they will feel less threatened by us."|1492|0
units.english: When they have completed their tour, Rek says to you in your own language, "<first>, I think we should show them <planet> next. We should show them the war with the Unfettered. If they see that we are few in number, embattled, with only a handful of worlds, they will feel less threatened by us."
units.italian: Quando hanno completato il loro giro, Rek ti dice nella tua lingua: "<first>, credo che ora dovremmo mostrare loro <planet>. Dovremmo mostrare loro la guerra con gli Slegati. Se vedono che siamo pochi, in difficoltà, con solo una manciata di mondi, si sentiranno meno minacciati da noi."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Tour 5|	"That sounds like a good idea."|1494|0
units.english: "That sounds like a good idea."
units.italian: "Mi sembra una buona idea."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Tour 5|	"What if seeing you as less of a threat emboldens them to attack you?"|1496|0
units.english: "What if seeing you as less of a threat emboldens them to attack you?"
units.italian: "E se vederci come una minaccia minore li spingesse ad attaccarvi?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Tour 5|	Rek says, "We are still more numerous and more advanced. And besides, wars are started by fear as often as they are started by aggression."|1497|0
units.english: Rek says, "We are still more numerous and more advanced. And besides, wars are started by fear as often as they are started by aggression."
units.italian: Rek dice: "Siamo comunque più numerosi e più avanzati. E inoltre le guerre nascono dalla paura tanto spesso quanto dall'aggressività."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Tour 5|	You agree to escort the Korath ship to <planet>. Hopefully they won't be blown to bits by an Unfettered fleet; that would be quite a diplomatic disaster.|1499|0
units.english: You agree to escort the Korath ship to <planet>. Hopefully they won't be blown to bits by an Unfettered fleet; that would be quite a diplomatic disaster.
units.italian: Accetti di scortare la nave dei Korath fino a <planet>. Si spera che non venga fatta a pezzi da una flotta degli Slegati: sarebbe un disastro diplomatico non da poco.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Tour 5|dialog|1502|0
units.english: You've reached <planet>, but the Korath ship isn't here yet. Better depart and wait for it to arrive.
units.italian: Hai raggiunto <planet>, ma la nave dei Korath non è ancora qui. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Tour 6|name|1517|0
units.english: Kor Efret Tour
units.italian: Tour dei Kor Efret

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Tour 6|description|1518|0
units.english: Escort the Kor Efret ship back through the Eye to <planet>.
units.italian: Scorta la nave dei Kor Efret di ritorno attraverso l'Occhio fino a <planet>.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Tour 6|The Korath ship lands safely on <origin>. Rek explains to the Korath that the entire Wanderer territory was once controlled by the Hai, but that the Hai ruined these worlds and abandoned them. She tells them that now that the Wanderers have completed their work of healing these worlds, they are returning them to the Hai.|1525|0
units.english: The Korath ship lands safely on <origin>. Rek explains to the Korath that the entire Wanderer territory was once controlled by the Hai, but that the Hai ruined these worlds and abandoned them. She tells them that now that the Wanderers have completed their work of healing these worlds, they are returning them to the Hai.
units.italian: La nave dei Korath atterra sana e salva su <origin>. Rek spiega ai Korath che l'intero territorio dei Wanderers un tempo era controllato dagli Hai, ma che gli Hai hanno rovinato questi mondi e li hanno abbandonati. Dice loro che ora che i Wanderers hanno completato il loro lavoro di guarigione di questi mondi, li stanno restituendo agli Hai.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Tour 6|	It's a somewhat slanted story, and the Korath are dubious. "If you have done them this great favor," one of them asks, "why are they attacking you?"|1526|0
units.english: It's a somewhat slanted story, and the Korath are dubious. "If you have done them this great favor," one of them asks, "why are they attacking you?"
units.italian: È una storia un po' parziale, e i Korath sono dubbiosi. "Se avete fatto loro questo grande favore," chiede uno di loro, "perché vi stanno attaccando?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Tour 6|	Rek explains that the Hai wanted these worlds back before the Wanderers were ready to give them back, and the same Korath says, "So, if we allow you to spread to our worlds, you will return them to us not when we ask you to, but when you decide you are done?"|1527|0
units.english: Rek explains that the Hai wanted these worlds back before the Wanderers were ready to give them back, and the same Korath says, "So, if we allow you to spread to our worlds, you will return them to us not when we ask you to, but when you decide you are done?"
units.italian: Rek spiega che gli Hai volevano indietro questi mondi prima che i Wanderers fossero pronti a restituirli, e lo stesso Korath dice: "Quindi se vi permettiamo di espandervi sui nostri mondi, ce li restituirete non quando ve lo chiediamo, ma quando deciderete voi che avete finito?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Tour 6|	Rek tries to assure them that in their own territory, they will be working and living side by side with the Wanderers, in joint control of their worlds. It's not clear if they believe her. "We have seen enough," says the same Korath. "We will return to our world now." You agree to escort them back through the Eye and to make sure they reach <planet> safely.|1528|0
units.english: Rek tries to assure them that in their own territory, they will be working and living side by side with the Wanderers, in joint control of their worlds. It's not clear if they believe her. "We have seen enough," says the same Korath. "We will return to our world now." You agree to escort them back through the Eye and to make sure they reach <planet> safely.
units.italian: Rek cerca di assicurarli che nel loro territorio lavoreranno e vivranno fianco a fianco con i Wanderers, con il controllo congiunto dei mondi. Non è chiaro se le credano. "Abbiamo visto abbastanza," dice lo stesso Korath. "Ora torneremo sul nostro mondo." Accetti di scortarli di ritorno attraverso l'Occhio e di assicurarti che arrivino sani e salvi a <planet>.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Tour 6|dialog|1531|0
units.english: You've reached <planet>, but the Korath ship isn't here yet. Better depart and wait for it to arrive.
units.italian: Hai raggiunto <planet>, ma la nave dei Korath non è ancora qui. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Tour 7|name|1541|0
units.english: Return to <planet>
units.italian: Ritorna su <planet>

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Tour 7|description|1542|0
units.english: Return to <planet> with Rek's report from the Kor Efret diplomatic tour.
units.italian: Torna su <planet> con il rapporto di Rek sul tour diplomatico dei Kor Efret.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Tour 7|You have escorted the Korath world-ship safely back to their home. Hopefully what they saw on their journey will make them more eager to be friends with the Wanderers, rather than less. Rek hands you a written report that she says is an account of the diplomatic mission and says, "Please deliver this to Sobari Tele'ek on <planet>."|1550|0
units.english: You have escorted the Korath world-ship safely back to their home. Hopefully what they saw on their journey will make them more eager to be friends with the Wanderers, rather than less. Rek hands you a written report that she says is an account of the diplomatic mission and says, "Please deliver this to Sobari Tele'ek on <planet>."
units.italian: Hai scortato la nave-mondo dei Korath sana e salva a casa. Si spera che ciò che hanno visto nel viaggio li renda più desiderosi di essere amici dei Wanderers, non meno. Rek ti consegna un rapporto scritto che, dice, è un resoconto della missione diplomatica, e aggiunge: "Per favore consegnalo a Sobari Tele'ek su <planet>."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Tour 7|	"Okay, I'll do that."|1552|0
units.english: "Okay, I'll do that."
units.italian: "Va bene, lo farò."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Tour 7|	"Do you think the mission was a success?"|1554|0
units.english: "Do you think the mission was a success?"
units.italian: "Pensi che la missione sia riuscita?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Tour 7|	"I hope so," she says. "The true test will be how we treat the Kor Efreti in the days to come. Clearly it will take some effort to earn their trust."|1555|0
units.english: "I hope so," she says. "The true test will be how we treat the Kor Efreti in the days to come. Clearly it will take some effort to earn their trust."
units.italian: "Lo spero," dice. "La vera prova sarà come tratteremo i Kor Efret nei giorni a venire. Chiaramente ci vorrà un po' di impegno per guadagnare la loro fiducia."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Tour 7|	You return to your ship, and get ready to travel to <planet>.|1556|0
units.english: You return to your ship, and get ready to travel to <planet>.
units.italian: Torni alla tua nave e ti prepari a viaggiare verso <planet>.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Scanning|name|1563|0
units.english: Scan Sestor Planets
units.italian: Scansiona i pianeti Sestor

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Scanning|description|1564|0
units.english: Scan all the habitable planets in Sestor space to attempt to find where the control center for the automata is located.
units.italian: Scansiona tutti i pianeti abitabili nello spazio Sestor per cercare di scoprire dove si trovi il centro di controllo degli automi.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Scanning|blocked|1569|0
units.english: You will need <capacity> to take on the next mission.
units.italian: Ti serve <capacity> per accettare la prossima missione.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Scanning|log|1580|0
units.english: Agreed to travel through Kor Sestor space, scanning the planets to try to look for the facility that is remotely controlling the Kor Sestor drones.
units.italian: Hai accettato di attraversare lo spazio Kor Sestor, scansionando i pianeti per cercare la struttura che controlla a distanza i droni Kor Sestor.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Scanning|The Wanderers are eager to hear the results of your diplomatic mission, and whatever is in Rek's report seems to encourage them. Tele'ek says, "If we can [deal with, neutralize] the Kor Sestor drones as well, all of Korath space will be [open, available] for us and for the Korath survivors. Then there will be no more [barriers, impediments] to peace."|1582|0
units.english: The Wanderers are eager to hear the results of your diplomatic mission, and whatever is in Rek's report seems to encourage them. Tele'ek says, "If we can [deal with, neutralize] the Kor Sestor drones as well, all of Korath space will be [open, available] for us and for the Korath survivors. Then there will be no more [barriers, impediments] to peace."
units.italian: I Wanderers sono impazienti di sentire i risultati della tua missione diplomatica, e qualunque cosa ci sia nel rapporto di Rek sembra incoraggiarli. Tele'ek dice: "Se riusciamo ad [affrontare, neutralizzare] anche i droni Kor Sestor, tutto lo spazio Korath sarà [aperto, disponibile] per noi e per i Korath superstiti. Allora non ci saranno più [barriere, ostacoli] alla pace."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Scanning|	"If you combined your fleet with the Kor Mereti, you could destroy the Kor Sestor drones outright."|1584|0
units.english: "If you combined your fleet with the Kor Mereti, you could destroy the Kor Sestor drones outright."
units.italian: "Se uniste la vostra flotta a quella dei Kor Mereti, potreste distruggere del tutto i droni Kor Sestor."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Scanning|	"If the Sestor drones are being controlled remotely, we should try to find the control station and take it over, or destroy it."|1585|0
units.english: "If the Sestor drones are being controlled remotely, we should try to find the control station and take it over, or destroy it."
units.italian: "Se i droni Sestor sono controllati a distanza, dovremmo cercare la stazione di controllo e prenderne il comando, o distruggerla."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Scanning|	"With great [destruction, loss] of life," says Tema'a Iriket. "That is not [acceptable, moral]. We should seek a more [subtle, elegant] solution."|1588|0
units.english: "With great [destruction, loss] of life," says Tema'a Iriket. "That is not [acceptable, moral]. We should seek a more [subtle, elegant] solution."
units.italian: "Con grande [distruzione, perdita] di vite," dice Tema'a Iriket. "Questo non è [accettabile, morale]. Dovremmo cercare una soluzione più [sottile, elegante]."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Scanning|	After some discussion, the Wanderers agree that the best way to deal with the Sestor drones is to try to figure out where their control center is. "Their communications are [untraceable, undetectable]," says Tele'ek, "but surely the [control center, communications hub] will be well defended. So by [hunting, searching] for a well defended [site, installation] we may find it."|1591|0
units.english: After some discussion, the Wanderers agree that the best way to deal with the Sestor drones is to try to figure out where their control center is. "Their communications are [untraceable, undetectable]," says Tele'ek, "but surely the [control center, communications hub] will be well defended. So by [hunting, searching] for a well defended [site, installation] we may find it."
units.italian: Dopo qualche discussione, i Wanderers concordano che il modo migliore per affrontare i droni Sestor sia cercare di capire dove si trovi il loro centro di controllo. "Le loro comunicazioni sono [non rintracciabili, non rilevabili]," dice Tele'ek, "ma di certo il [centro di controllo, nodo di comunicazione] sarà ben difeso. Quindi [cercando, scandagliando] un [sito, impianto] ben difeso potremmo trovarlo."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Scanning|	Iriket says, "I can supply Captain <last> with [surveying?] scanners and [ground-penetrating radar?] from the terraforming team. Such a [facility, installation] might well be deep underground."|1592|0
units.english: Iriket says, "I can supply Captain <last> with [surveying?] scanners and [ground-penetrating radar?] from the terraforming team. Such a [facility, installation] might well be deep underground."
units.italian: Iriket dice: "Posso fornire al Capitano <last> gli scanner [da rilevamento?] e [il radar penetrante?] della squadra di terraformaggio. Una [struttura, installazione] del genere potrebbe benissimo essere in profondità sotto terra."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Scanning|	The Wanderers begin loading the scanning equipment onto your ship, and ask you to land on each of the planets in Kor Sestor space to collect measurements. "Bring the [data, results] back to us to be analyzed," says Iriket.|1593|0
units.english: The Wanderers begin loading the scanning equipment onto your ship, and ask you to land on each of the planets in Kor Sestor space to collect measurements. "Bring the [data, results] back to us to be analyzed," says Iriket.
units.italian: I Wanderers cominciano a caricare l'equipaggiamento di scansione sulla tua nave e ti chiedono di atterrare su ciascuno dei pianeti dello spazio Kor Sestor per raccogliere misurazioni. "Portaci i [dati, risultati] da analizzare," dice Iriket.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Scanning|dialog|1598|0
units.english: That was the last of the Kor Sestor planets that the Wanderers asked you to scan. Time to return to <planet> with the data.
units.italian: Quello era l'ultimo dei pianeti Kor Sestor che i Wanderers ti hanno chiesto di scansionare. È tempo di tornare su <planet> con i dati.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Attack|name|1615|0
units.english: Defend <planet>
units.italian: Difendi <planet>

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Attack|description|1616|0
units.english: <planet> is under attack by a Kor Sestor fleet. Drive them off, then return to the planet to figure out what to do next.
units.italian: <planet> è sotto attacco di una flotta Kor Sestor. Respingili, poi torna sul pianeta per decidere che cosa fare.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Attack|A few hours after you present the scanning data to the scientists, you are called into a meeting with the Wanderer leaders. "We may have found the [facility, center]," says, Tele'ek, "but we are not [certain, confident]. There is indeed an underground [bunker, fortress] on one of the planets, but it must have been [damaged, overrun] in the course of their war." He calls up a holographic display of the facility, showing that one section of it has been breached, and a tunnel leads from there to the surface.|1622|0
units.english: A few hours after you present the scanning data to the scientists, you are called into a meeting with the Wanderer leaders. "We may have found the [facility, center]," says, Tele'ek, "but we are not [certain, confident]. There is indeed an underground [bunker, fortress] on one of the planets, but it must have been [damaged, overrun] in the course of their war." He calls up a holographic display of the facility, showing that one section of it has been breached, and a tunnel leads from there to the surface.
units.italian: Poche ore dopo che hai presentato i dati delle scansioni agli scienziati, vieni convocato a una riunione con i capi dei Wanderers. "Potremmo aver trovato la [struttura, il centro]," dice Tele'ek, "ma non ne siamo [certi, sicuri]. C'è davvero un [bunker, fortino] sotterraneo su uno dei pianeti, ma deve essere stato [danneggiato, travolto] nel corso della loro guerra." Richiama una proiezione olografica della struttura, che mostra come una sua sezione sia stata violata e da lì un tunnel risalga fino alla superficie.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Attack|	"You're probably right that they wouldn't have kept using the facility once it had been breached."|1624|0
units.english: "You're probably right that they wouldn't have kept using the facility once it had been breached."
units.italian: "Probabilmente hai ragione: non avrebbero continuato a usare la struttura dopo che era stata violata."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Attack|	"Is there any sign that they tried to rebuild it after the damage? Or that it's still in use?"|1625|0
units.english: "Is there any sign that they tried to rebuild it after the damage? Or that it's still in use?"
units.italian: "C'è qualche segno che abbiano provato a ricostruirla dopo il danno? O che sia ancora in uso?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Attack|	Iriket walks up closer to the display to look on it. She adjusts some controls, and an overlay shows up in another color. "The Kor Efret said their [civil war, cultural collapse] ended a century ago, yes?" she asks. You nod. She walks around the display, examining it carefully, then says, "These [cracks, fractures] in the [bedrock?] have not yet been [infiltrated, saturated] with ground water. This damage is not a century old. It is from at most one [month?] ago."|1627|0
units.english: Iriket walks up closer to the display to look on it. She adjusts some controls, and an overlay shows up in another color. "The Kor Efret said their [civil war, cultural collapse] ended a century ago, yes?" she asks. You nod. She walks around the display, examining it carefully, then says, "These [cracks, fractures] in the [bedrock?] have not yet been [infiltrated, saturated] with ground water. This damage is not a century old. It is from at most one [month?] ago."
units.italian: Iriket si avvicina alla proiezione per guardarla. Regola alcuni comandi, e compare una sovrapposizione di un altro colore. "I Kor Efret hanno detto che la loro [guerra civile, crisi culturale] è finita un secolo fa, giusto?" chiede. Annuisci. Lei gira intorno alla proiezione, la esamina con attenzione, poi dice: "Queste [crepe, fratture] nel [substrato roccioso?] non sono ancora state [penetrate, saturate] dall'acqua di falda. Questo danno non ha un secolo. Risale ad al massimo un [mese?] fa."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Attack|	"Could it be that whoever was living down there decided to give up and return to the surface?"|1629|0
units.english: "Could it be that whoever was living down there decided to give up and return to the surface?"
units.italian: "Può essere che chi viveva laggiù abbia deciso di rinunciare e tornare in superficie?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Attack|	"Does that mean that someone else captured the facility before we could?"|1630|0
units.english: "Does that mean that someone else captured the facility before we could?"
units.italian: "Vuol dire che qualcun altro ha preso la struttura prima di noi?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Attack|	Suddenly, you hear the noise of alarm sirens from the spaceport, and a messenger comes bursting into the room, his talons screeching across the floor as he skids to a stop. "Sestor drones!" he says. "[Enormous, overwhelming] fleet. Need all [defenders, fighters] immediately."|1632|0
units.english: Suddenly, you hear the noise of alarm sirens from the spaceport, and a messenger comes bursting into the room, his talons screeching across the floor as he skids to a stop. "Sestor drones!" he says. "[Enormous, overwhelming] fleet. Need all [defenders, fighters] immediately."
units.italian: Improvvisamente senti il suono delle sirene d'allarme dallo spazioporto, e un messaggero irrompe nella stanza, con gli artigli che stridono sul pavimento mentre frena di colpo. "Droni Sestor!" dice. "Flotta [enorme, soverchiante]. Servono tutti i [difensori, combattenti] subito."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Attack|	You return to your ship and quickly fire up the engines...|1633|0
units.english: You return to your ship and quickly fire up the engines...
units.italian: Torni alla tua nave e accendi in fretta i motori...

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Attack|dialog|1636|0
units.english: There is indeed a Kor Sestor fleet here, but it is nowhere near as large as the messenger indicated. Either the messenger was exaggerating, or some of the fleet has already fled.
units.italian: C'è davvero una flotta Kor Sestor qui, ma non è neanche lontanamente grande come il messaggero aveva indicato. O il messaggero esagerava, o una parte della flotta è già fuggita.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Attack|dialog|1638|0
units.english: There are still Kor Sestor ships overhead. You should take off and rejoin the battle.
units.italian: Ci sono ancora navi Kor Sestor là sopra. Dovresti decollare e tornare in battaglia.

units.id: event:wanderers: kor sestor are aimless|add|1774|0
units.english: There used to be a thriving spaceport here, but it has been razed to the ground by the Kor Sestor fleet.
units.italian: Qui c'era uno spazioporto fiorente, ma la flotta Kor Sestor l'ha rasa al suolo.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Search|name|1787|0
units.english: Find the Sestor fleet
units.italian: Trova la flotta Sestor

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Search|description|1788|0
units.english: A large Kor Sestor fleet passed through the wormhole to Wanderer space. Figure out where they went and what they are doing there.
units.italian: Una grande flotta Kor Sestor è passata attraverso il cunicolo verso lo spazio dei Wanderers. Scopri dove sono andati e che cosa stanno facendo lì.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Search|log|1797|0
units.english: Someone else seems to have located the Kor Sestor central command before the Wanderers did, and has taken control of the Kor Sestor fleet. Most of the Kor Sestor drones flew through the Eye into the old Wanderer territory, where the Wanderers will probably not be prepared to fight them.
units.italian: Qualcun altro sembra aver individuato il comando centrale dei Kor Sestor prima dei Wanderers, e ha preso il controllo della flotta Kor Sestor. La maggior parte dei droni Kor Sestor è volata attraverso l'Occhio nel vecchio territorio dei Wanderers, dove i Wanderers probabilmente non saranno pronti a combatterli.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Search|You return to the planet expecting the Wanderers to be celebrating their victory, but the leaders have grim news. "The drones we fought were only the [rearguard? remnant?] of the fleet," says Tele'ek. "Dozens of [capital ships?] passed through this system and continued on. With this [heading, destination]." On the holographic projector, he brings up a star map, and points to the system where the Eye is. The wormhole leading back to Wanderer space.|1800|0
units.english: You return to the planet expecting the Wanderers to be celebrating their victory, but the leaders have grim news. "The drones we fought were only the [rearguard? remnant?] of the fleet," says Tele'ek. "Dozens of [capital ships?] passed through this system and continued on. With this [heading, destination]." On the holographic projector, he brings up a star map, and points to the system where the Eye is. The wormhole leading back to Wanderer space.
units.italian: Torni sul pianeta aspettandoti che i Wanderers festeggino la vittoria, ma i capi hanno notizie cupe. "I droni contro cui abbiamo combattuto erano solo la [retroguardia? il resto?] della flotta," dice Tele'ek. "Decine di [navi capitali?] hanno attraversato questo sistema e sono proseguite. Con questa [rotta, destinazione]." Sul proiettore olografico richiama una mappa stellare e indica il sistema dove si trova l'Occhio. Il cunicolo che riporta allo spazio dei Wanderers.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Search|	Tele'ek says, "Every ship we can spare must [pursue, follow] the Sestor drones through the Eye, and hope that we [locate, track down] the drones before they can cause [harm, destruction] to our people." You should probably join them.|1801|0
units.english: Tele'ek says, "Every ship we can spare must [pursue, follow] the Sestor drones through the Eye, and hope that we [locate, track down] the drones before they can cause [harm, destruction] to our people." You should probably join them.
units.italian: Tele'ek dice: "Ogni nave che possiamo risparmiare deve [inseguire, seguire] i droni Sestor attraverso l'Occhio, e sperare di [individuarli, rintracciarli] prima che possano causare [danni, distruzione] alla nostra gente." Probabilmente dovresti unirti a loro.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Search|dialog|1804|0
units.english: You've returned to <planet>, but you haven't yet found out where the Sestor fleet has gone. Keep searching for it; it's dangerous letting such a powerful hostile fleet roam free.
units.italian: Sei tornato su <planet>, ma non hai ancora scoperto dove sia andata la flotta Sestor. Continua a cercarla; è pericoloso lasciare una flotta ostile così potente libera di muoversi.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Search|A major battle was fought here. The burned-out hulks of several Wanderer ships are floating around in space, along with a handful of disabled Kor Sestor ships. Meanwhile, Wanderer ships are engaged in some sort of rescue or evacuation process on the surface of Varu K'prai. But there is no sign of the bulk of the Kor Sestor fleet.|1809|0
units.english: A major battle was fought here. The burned-out hulks of several Wanderer ships are floating around in space, along with a handful of disabled Kor Sestor ships. Meanwhile, Wanderer ships are engaged in some sort of rescue or evacuation process on the surface of Varu K'prai. But there is no sign of the bulk of the Kor Sestor fleet.
units.italian: Qui si è combattuta una grande battaglia. I relitti bruciati di diverse navi dei Wanderers galleggiano nello spazio, insieme a una manciata di navi Kor Sestor neutralizzate. Nel frattempo le navi dei Wanderers sono impegnate in una specie di operazione di soccorso o evacuazione sulla superficie di Varu K'prai. Ma non c'è traccia del grosso della flotta Kor Sestor.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Search|Quite a few Kor Sestor ships are in orbit around the anarchist world of Zenith, and you detect many more on the surface. Strangely, the Kor Sestor ships are not attacking the local pirate and anarchist fleets.|1824|0
units.english: Quite a few Kor Sestor ships are in orbit around the anarchist world of Zenith, and you detect many more on the surface. Strangely, the Kor Sestor ships are not attacking the local pirate and anarchist fleets.
units.italian: Diverse navi Kor Sestor sono in orbita intorno al mondo anarchico di Zenith, e ne rilevi molte altre sulla superficie. Stranamente, le navi Kor Sestor non attaccano le flotte locali di pirati e anarchici.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Search|	That is probably not a good sign.|1825|0
units.english: That is probably not a good sign.
units.italian: Probabilmente non è un buon segno.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Search: Vara K'chrai|Everyone in the spaceport on Vara K'chrai is still in a panic from watching the Kor Sestor fleet fly through their system, but fortunately the drones did not attack the planet. In fact, they did not even fire on the Wanderer ships that were in orbit at the time. The Wanderer defenders, not wanting to provoke a fight with a fleet they could probably not defeat, did not attack either. So, the Kor Sestor fleet passed peacefully through this system and continued on to... wherever it is going. No one here has any idea yet what the fleet's destination was.|1857|0
units.english: Everyone in the spaceport on Vara K'chrai is still in a panic from watching the Kor Sestor fleet fly through their system, but fortunately the drones did not attack the planet. In fact, they did not even fire on the Wanderer ships that were in orbit at the time. The Wanderer defenders, not wanting to provoke a fight with a fleet they could probably not defeat, did not attack either. So, the Kor Sestor fleet passed peacefully through this system and continued on to... wherever it is going. No one here has any idea yet what the fleet's destination was.
units.italian: Tutti nello spazioporto di Vara K'chrai sono ancora nel panico per aver visto la flotta Kor Sestor attraversare il loro sistema, ma per fortuna i droni non hanno attaccato il pianeta. Anzi, non hanno sparato nemmeno alle navi dei Wanderers che erano in orbita in quel momento. Anche i difensori Wanderer, non volendo provocare uno scontro con una flotta che probabilmente non avrebbero potuto sconfiggere, non hanno attaccato. Così la flotta Kor Sestor ha attraversato questo sistema in pace ed è proseguita verso... ovunque stia andando. Nessuno qui ha ancora idea di quale fosse la destinazione della flotta.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Search: Varu Tev'kei|The defenders on <planet> have heard of the Kor Sestor incursion into Wanderer space, but they tell you that the fleet did not pass through this system. And here, they are clearly too worried about the Unfettered threat to be able to think about fighting a war on a second front at the same time.|1869|0
units.english: The defenders on <planet> have heard of the Kor Sestor incursion into Wanderer space, but they tell you that the fleet did not pass through this system. And here, they are clearly too worried about the Unfettered threat to be able to think about fighting a war on a second front at the same time.
units.italian: I difensori su <planet> hanno sentito dell'incursione dei Kor Sestor nello spazio dei Wanderers, ma ti dicono che la flotta non è passata per questo sistema. E qui sono chiaramente troppo preoccupati per la minaccia degli Slegati per poter pensare di combattere contemporaneamente una guerra su un secondo fronte.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Search: Varu K'prai|The entire spaceport on <planet> has been razed to the ground. Teams of Wanderers are sifting through the rubble to recover the bodies of those who were killed here. Apparently the Kor Sestor fleet destroyed the spaceport and every Wanderer ship it found in this system, and then occupied the system for several days, destroying or driving away any scout ships that entered the system.|1881|0
units.english: The entire spaceport on <planet> has been razed to the ground. Teams of Wanderers are sifting through the rubble to recover the bodies of those who were killed here. Apparently the Kor Sestor fleet destroyed the spaceport and every Wanderer ship it found in this system, and then occupied the system for several days, destroying or driving away any scout ships that entered the system.
units.italian: L'intero spazioporto su <planet> è stato raso al suolo. Squadre di Wanderers setacciano le macerie per recuperare i corpi di chi è stato ucciso qui. A quanto pare la flotta Kor Sestor ha distrutto lo spazioporto e ogni nave dei Wanderers che ha trovato in questo sistema, poi ha occupato il sistema per diversi giorni, distruggendo o scacciando ogni nave esploratrice che vi entrava.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Search: Varu K'prai|	The Wanderers don't know what happened next, but the drones are no longer here. Perhaps they have moved beyond Wanderer space.|1882|0
units.english: The Wanderers don't know what happened next, but the drones are no longer here. Perhaps they have moved beyond Wanderer space.
units.italian: I Wanderers non sanno che cosa sia successo dopo, ma i droni non sono più qui. Forse sono andati oltre lo spazio dei Wanderers.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Search: Human Spaceport|As you bring your ship in for landing at an empty pad, you notice the captain of an adjacent Behemoth inspecting his ship, which is raked with projectile punctures.|1897|0
units.english: As you bring your ship in for landing at an empty pad, you notice the captain of an adjacent Behemoth inspecting his ship, which is raked with projectile punctures.
units.italian: Mentre porti la nave ad atterrare su una piazzola vuota, noti il capitano di un Behemoth lì accanto che ispeziona la sua nave, crivellata di fori di proiettile.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Search: Human Spaceport|	(Approach the captain and try to find out what happened.)|1899|0
units.english: (Approach the captain and try to find out what happened.)
units.italian: (Avvicinati al capitano e cerca di scoprire che cosa è successo.)

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Search: Human Spaceport|	(Ignore him.)|1901|0
units.english: (Ignore him.)
units.italian: (Ignoralo.)

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Search: Human Spaceport|	You get a better view of the Behemoth - the Heart of Gold, as indicated on the ship's stern - as you walk up to it. The rear of the ship is badly hammered, and black scorch marks streak forward across the hull. You can't help but notice that at several projectile entry points along the hull, the metal is bent smoothly inwards, almost as if the penetrator seared or melted its way through the ship's armor. The captain of the Behemoth looks up from his inspection. Seeing you, he says, "We were lucky to get out of that one alive!"|1905|0
units.english: You get a better view of the Behemoth - the Heart of Gold, as indicated on the ship's stern - as you walk up to it. The rear of the ship is badly hammered, and black scorch marks streak forward across the hull. You can't help but notice that at several projectile entry points along the hull, the metal is bent smoothly inwards, almost as if the penetrator seared or melted its way through the ship's armor. The captain of the Behemoth looks up from his inspection. Seeing you, he says, "We were lucky to get out of that one alive!"
units.italian: Ti avvicini al Behemoth e ne hai una visione migliore: è l'Heart of Gold, come indica la poppa. La parte posteriore della nave è malconcia, e tracce nere di bruciatura si allungano in avanti lungo lo scafo. Non puoi fare a meno di notare che in diversi punti di ingresso dei proiettili il metallo è piegato verso l'interno in modo uniforme, quasi che il penetratore si sia fatto strada attraverso la corazza della nave bruciandola o fondendola. Il capitano del Behemoth alza lo sguardo dall'ispezione. Vedendoti, dice: "Siamo stati fortunati a uscirne vivi!"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Search: Human Spaceport|	"How did your ship end up in such a state?"|1907|0
units.english: "How did your ship end up in such a state?"
units.italian: "Come è finita la tua nave in questo stato?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Search: Human Spaceport|	"Was this beauty the victim of a pirate attack?"|1908|0
units.english: "Was this beauty the victim of a pirate attack?"
units.italian: "Questo gioiellino è stato vittima di un attacco di pirati?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Search: Human Spaceport|	"I'm not quite sure," the captain says. "We were shot at by a fleet of hostile ships that our computer couldn't identify. They didn't look at all like a run-of-the-mill pirate ship, though, and they were kitted out with tech I've never seen before."|1910|0
units.english: "I'm not quite sure," the captain says. "We were shot at by a fleet of hostile ships that our computer couldn't identify. They didn't look at all like a run-of-the-mill pirate ship, though, and they were kitted out with tech I've never seen before."
units.italian: "Non ne sono del tutto sicuro," dice il capitano. "Ci ha sparato una flotta di navi ostili che il nostro computer non è riuscito a identificare. Non somigliavano affatto a una normale nave pirata, però, ed erano equipaggiate con una tecnologia che non avevo mai visto."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Search: Human Spaceport|	"How many ships were there? What did they look like?"|1912|0
units.english: "How many ships were there? What did they look like?"
units.italian: "Quante navi erano? Che aspetto avevano?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Search: Human Spaceport|	"Where did this fight take place?"|1913|0
units.english: "Where did this fight take place?"
units.italian: "Dove è avvenuto lo scontro?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Search: Human Spaceport|	"You should be glad you're still in one piece."|1915|0
units.english: "You should be glad you're still in one piece."
units.italian: "Dovresti essere contento di essere ancora intero."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Search: Human Spaceport|	"Well," the pilot says, "we had hired a beefy Leviathan escort to Farpoint. When we were going in for landing, two of these hostile ships jumped in from the northwest, the direction of all the anarchist colonies in this area. The ships weren't big, but they were tough: our four Heavy Laser Turrets weren't enough to produce even a dent in their shields. They made short work of the Leviathan, and nearly disabled our ship, too. It was lucky I decided that jumping would be faster than landing. We warped out of the system while in atmosphere, saving the ship, but now I'm in debt to all my crew because I couldn't meet a rush delivery deadline. Still had to deliver the goods, but lost a pretty substantial bonus."|1918|0
units.english: "Well," the pilot says, "we had hired a beefy Leviathan escort to Farpoint. When we were going in for landing, two of these hostile ships jumped in from the northwest, the direction of all the anarchist colonies in this area. The ships weren't big, but they were tough: our four Heavy Laser Turrets weren't enough to produce even a dent in their shields. They made short work of the Leviathan, and nearly disabled our ship, too. It was lucky I decided that jumping would be faster than landing. We warped out of the system while in atmosphere, saving the ship, but now I'm in debt to all my crew because I couldn't meet a rush delivery deadline. Still had to deliver the goods, but lost a pretty substantial bonus."
units.italian: "Beh," dice il pilota, "avevamo ingaggiato un robusto Leviathan come scorta fino a Farpoint. Mentre ci avvicinavamo per atterrare, due di queste navi ostili sono saltate fuori da nord-ovest, la direzione di tutte le colonie anarchiche di questa zona. Le navi non erano grandi, ma erano toste: le nostre quattro torrette laser pesanti non bastavano nemmeno a scalfire i loro scudi. Hanno fatto piazza pulita del Leviathan e quasi neutralizzato anche la nostra nave. È stato un bene che decidessi che saltare sarebbe stato più rapido che atterrare. Siamo usciti dal sistema in curvatura mentre eravamo ancora in atmosfera, salvando la nave, ma ora sono in debito con tutto l'equipaggio perché non ho rispettato una scadenza di consegna urgente. Ho dovuto consegnare comunque la merce, ma ho perso un bonus piuttosto sostanzioso."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Search: Human Spaceport|	"You're lucky as hell to be here today."|1920|0
units.english: "You're lucky as hell to be here today."
units.italian: "Sei fortunato da far paura a essere ancora qui oggi."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Search: Human Spaceport|	"Thanks for the information. I think that these hostile ships are the ones I'm looking for."|1922|0
units.english: "Thanks for the information. I think that these hostile ships are the ones I'm looking for."
units.italian: "Grazie per le informazioni. Credo che queste navi ostili siano quelle che sto cercando."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Search: Human Spaceport|	"Well," the pilot says, "we were on a deadline to do a large cargo run to Farpoint, when two of these hostile ships jumped in from the northwest, the direction of all the anarchist colonies in this area. I had to jump the ship in atmosphere to stop us from getting shredded by their strange melting weaponry. I immediately reported the attack to a desk clerk at the Navy base in the neighboring system Saiph, but their servers show no logs of any unidentified ships beyond Farpoint, so I guess they turned around after scouting out the Alnitak system. Just my luck to be in the system the moment those things entered, too, because I missed the delivery deadline. Still had to deliver the goods, but lost a pretty substantial bonus."|1926|0
units.english: "Well," the pilot says, "we were on a deadline to do a large cargo run to Farpoint, when two of these hostile ships jumped in from the northwest, the direction of all the anarchist colonies in this area. I had to jump the ship in atmosphere to stop us from getting shredded by their strange melting weaponry. I immediately reported the attack to a desk clerk at the Navy base in the neighboring system Saiph, but their servers show no logs of any unidentified ships beyond Farpoint, so I guess they turned around after scouting out the Alnitak system. Just my luck to be in the system the moment those things entered, too, because I missed the delivery deadline. Still had to deliver the goods, but lost a pretty substantial bonus."
units.italian: "Beh," dice il pilota, "avevamo una scadenza per un grosso carico da portare a Farpoint, quando due di queste navi ostili sono saltate fuori da nord-ovest, la direzione di tutte le colonie anarchiche di questa zona. Ho dovuto far saltare la nave in atmosfera per impedire che le loro strane armi che fondono ci facessero a pezzi. Ho subito denunciato l'attacco a un impiegato della base della Marina nel sistema vicino, Saiph, ma i loro server non hanno registrazioni di navi non identificate oltre Farpoint, quindi credo che abbiano fatto dietrofront dopo aver esplorato il sistema Alnitak. Sfortuna mia essere nel sistema proprio nel momento in cui quelle cose sono entrate, perché ho perso la scadenza di consegna. Ho dovuto consegnare comunque la merce, ma ho perso un bonus piuttosto sostanzioso."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Search: Human Spaceport|	"You're lucky as hell to be here today."|1928|0
units.english: "You're lucky as hell to be here today."
units.italian: "Sei fortunato da far paura a essere ancora qui oggi."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Search: Human Spaceport|	"Thanks for the information. I think that these hostile ships are the ones I'm hunting."|1930|0
units.english: "Thanks for the information. I think that these hostile ships are the ones I'm hunting."
units.italian: "Grazie per le informazioni. Credo che queste navi ostili siano quelle che sto dando la caccia."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Search: Human Spaceport|	"I am! The attacking ships weren't big, but they were tough: our four Heavy Laser Turrets couldn't even produce a dent in their shields," the captain says. "We even hired a beefy Leviathan to protect us from the pirate raids as we traveled to Farpoint, but when these hostile ships jumped in from the northwest, they made short work of our escort and nearly disabled our ship, too. I had to jump out of the system while in atmosphere to save the ship, but now I'm in debt to all my crew because I didn't meet a rush delivery deadline. Still had to deliver the goods, but lost a pretty substantial bonus."|1934|0
units.english: "I am! The attacking ships weren't big, but they were tough: our four Heavy Laser Turrets couldn't even produce a dent in their shields," the captain says. "We even hired a beefy Leviathan to protect us from the pirate raids as we traveled to Farpoint, but when these hostile ships jumped in from the northwest, they made short work of our escort and nearly disabled our ship, too. I had to jump out of the system while in atmosphere to save the ship, but now I'm in debt to all my crew because I didn't meet a rush delivery deadline. Still had to deliver the goods, but lost a pretty substantial bonus."
units.italian: "Lo sono! Le navi attaccanti non erano grandi, ma erano toste: le nostre quattro torrette laser pesanti non riuscivano nemmeno a scalfire i loro scudi," dice il capitano. "Avevamo persino ingaggiato un robusto Leviathan per proteggerci dalle incursioni dei pirati mentre viaggiavamo verso Farpoint, ma quando queste navi ostili sono saltate fuori da nord-ovest hanno fatto piazza pulita della nostra scorta e quasi neutralizzato anche la nostra nave. Ho dovuto saltare fuori dal sistema mentre eravamo in atmosfera per salvare la nave, ma ora sono in debito con tutto l'equipaggio perché non ho rispettato una scadenza di consegna urgente. Ho dovuto consegnare comunque la merce, ma ho perso un bonus piuttosto sostanzioso."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Search: Human Spaceport|	"You really are lucky as hell to be here today."|1936|0
units.english: "You really are lucky as hell to be here today."
units.italian: "Sei davvero fortunato da far paura a essere ancora qui oggi."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Search: Human Spaceport|	"Thanks for the information. I think that these hostile ships are the ones I'm looking for."|1938|0
units.english: "Thanks for the information. I think that these hostile ships are the ones I'm looking for."
units.italian: "Grazie per le informazioni. Credo che queste navi ostili siano quelle che sto cercando."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Search: Human Spaceport|	"No problem, kiddo," the captain says, although he looks awed that you are even attempting to fight such powerful ships. "Remember, northwest of Farpoint. If they're anarchists of any sort, they'll be hiding in one of those pirate systems up there. Take care of yourself out there; those are some dangerous ships that jumped us." With that, he bids you farewell.|1942|0
units.english: "No problem, kiddo," the captain says, although he looks awed that you are even attempting to fight such powerful ships. "Remember, northwest of Farpoint. If they're anarchists of any sort, they'll be hiding in one of those pirate systems up there. Take care of yourself out there; those are some dangerous ships that jumped us." With that, he bids you farewell.
units.italian: "Nessun problema, ragazzo," dice il capitano, anche se sembra stupefatto che tu stia persino tentando di combattere navi così potenti. "Ricorda, a nord-ovest di Farpoint. Se sono anarchici di qualsiasi tipo, si nasconderanno in uno di quei sistemi pirata laggiù. Stai attento là fuori; quelle che ci hanno saltato addosso sono navi pericolose." Detto questo, ti saluta.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Search: Human Spaceport|	"Yeah, those ships would have obliterated us if we hadn't jumped pronto." The pilot looks at you, then asks quizzically, "Say, do you know anything about those ships?"|1946|0
units.english: "Yeah, those ships would have obliterated us if we hadn't jumped pronto." The pilot looks at you, then asks quizzically, "Say, do you know anything about those ships?"
units.italian: "Sì, quelle navi ci avrebbero obliterati se non avessimo saltato subito." Il pilota ti guarda, poi chiede con curiosità: "Di', sai qualcosa di quelle navi?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Search: Human Spaceport|	"Yeah, those were Korath ships that attacked you."|1948|0
units.english: "Yeah, those were Korath ships that attacked you."
units.italian: "Sì, quelle che vi hanno attaccato erano navi Korath."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Search: Human Spaceport|	"Maybe. I have a feeling that they're the alien ships that I'm hunting."|1949|0
units.english: "Maybe. I have a feeling that they're the alien ships that I'm hunting."
units.italian: "Forse. Ho la sensazione che siano le navi aliene che sto cercando."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Search: Human Spaceport|	"I don't want to jump to any conclusions."|1950|0
units.english: "I don't want to jump to any conclusions."
units.italian: "Non voglio saltare a conclusioni affrettate."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Search: Human Spaceport|	"Aliens?" The pilot's face reddens, and his eyes narrow in anger. "Like those detestable squirrels, you mean? Told me they were peaceful, but when I went further north, I nearly had my ship torn to pieces!" You try to tell him that the Hai are a separate species from the Korath, but he clearly does not want to hear any more, so you decide to bring the conversation to an end.|1953|0
units.english: "Aliens?" The pilot's face reddens, and his eyes narrow in anger. "Like those detestable squirrels, you mean? Told me they were peaceful, but when I went further north, I nearly had my ship torn to pieces!" You try to tell him that the Hai are a separate species from the Korath, but he clearly does not want to hear any more, so you decide to bring the conversation to an end.
units.italian: "Alieni?" Il viso del pilota si fa rosso e gli occhi gli si restringono per la rabbia. "Come quei detestabili scoiattoli, vuoi dire? Mi avevano detto che erano pacifici, ma quando sono andato più a nord per poco non mi facevo fare a pezzi la nave!" Cerchi di dirgli che gli Hai sono una specie diversa dai Korath, ma chiaramente non vuole sentirne altro, quindi decidi di chiudere la conversazione.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Search: Human Spaceport|	The pilot seems disappointed in your response, so you decide to bring the conversation to an end.|1957|0
units.english: The pilot seems disappointed in your response, so you decide to bring the conversation to an end.
units.italian: Il pilota sembra deluso dalla tua risposta, quindi decidi di chiudere la conversazione.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Search: Human Spaceport|	"Thank you for your time," you say to the captain.|1961|0
units.english: "Thank you for your time," you say to the captain.
units.italian: "Grazie per il tempo che mi hai dedicato," dici al capitano.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Search: Human Spaceport|	The pilot sobers up again, and says, "No problem. Remember, northwest of Farpoint. If they're anarchists of any sort, they'll be hiding in one of those pirate systems up there. Take care of yourself out there; those were dangerous ships we faced." With that, he bids you farewell.|1962|0
units.english: The pilot sobers up again, and says, "No problem. Remember, northwest of Farpoint. If they're anarchists of any sort, they'll be hiding in one of those pirate systems up there. Take care of yourself out there; those were dangerous ships we faced." With that, he bids you farewell.
units.italian: Il pilota torna serio e dice: "Nessun problema. Ricorda, a nord-ovest di Farpoint. Se sono anarchici di qualsiasi tipo, si nasconderanno in uno di quei sistemi pirata laggiù. Stai attento là fuori; erano navi pericolose quelle che abbiamo affrontato." Detto questo, ti saluta.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Search: Human Hint|name|1969|0
units.english: Warn Admiral Danforth
units.italian: Avverti l'ammiraglio Danforth

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Search: Human Hint|description|1970|0
units.english: Meet with Admiral Danforth on <planet> as soon as possible, to warn him of the possible threat from the Kor Sestor fleet.
units.italian: Incontra l'ammiraglio Danforth su <planet> il prima possibile, per avvertirlo della possibile minaccia della flotta Kor Sestor.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Search: Human Hint|You've located the Kor Sestor fleet, in the Alnilam system. The Republic Navy is probably ill-equipped to fight such powerful alien ships, but they may be the only thing standing in the way of an outright invasion of human space. You should warn Admiral Danforth and the Oathkeepers of the impending threat as soon as possible.|1980|0
units.english: You've located the Kor Sestor fleet, in the Alnilam system. The Republic Navy is probably ill-equipped to fight such powerful alien ships, but they may be the only thing standing in the way of an outright invasion of human space. You should warn Admiral Danforth and the Oathkeepers of the impending threat as soon as possible.
units.italian: Hai localizzato la flotta Kor Sestor nel sistema Alnilam. La Marina della Repubblica è probabilmente poco attrezzata per combattere navi aliene così potenti, ma potrebbe essere l'unica cosa che si frappone a un'invasione vera e propria dello spazio umano. Dovresti avvertire l'ammiraglio Danforth e gli Oathkeepers della minaccia imminente il prima possibile.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Search: Wanderer Hint|name|1987|0
units.english: Warn Admiral Danforth
units.italian: Avverti l'ammiraglio Danforth

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Search: Wanderer Hint|description|1988|0
units.english: Meet with Admiral Danforth on <planet> as soon as possible, to warn him of the possible threat from the Kor Sestor fleet.
units.italian: Incontra l'ammiraglio Danforth su <planet> il prima possibile, per avvertirlo della possibile minaccia della flotta Kor Sestor.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Search: Wanderer Hint|You've located the Kor Sestor fleet, in the Alnilam system. The Republic Navy is probably ill-equipped to fight such powerful alien ships, but they may be the only thing standing in the way of an outright invasion of human space. You should warn Admiral Danforth and the Oathkeepers of the impending threat as soon as possible.|1998|0
units.english: You've located the Kor Sestor fleet, in the Alnilam system. The Republic Navy is probably ill-equipped to fight such powerful alien ships, but they may be the only thing standing in the way of an outright invasion of human space. You should warn Admiral Danforth and the Oathkeepers of the impending threat as soon as possible.
units.italian: Hai localizzato la flotta Kor Sestor nel sistema Alnilam. La Marina della Repubblica è probabilmente poco attrezzata per combattere navi aliene così potenti, ma potrebbe essere l'unica cosa che si frappone a un'invasione vera e propria dello spazio umano. Dovresti avvertire l'ammiraglio Danforth e gli Oathkeepers della minaccia imminente il prima possibile.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Farpoint Attack 1|name|2005|0
units.english: Defend Farpoint
units.italian: Difendi Farpoint

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Farpoint Attack 1|description|2006|0
units.english: Farpoint is under attack by a Kor Sestor fleet. Drive them off, then return to the planet to speak with Admiral Danforth.
units.italian: Farpoint è sotto attacco di una flotta Kor Sestor. Respingili, poi torna sul pianeta per parlare con l'ammiraglio Danforth.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Farpoint Attack 1|log|2011|0
units.english: The Kor Sestor fleet has somehow made its way into northern human space, perhaps using a small number of jump drives to ferry ships back and forth the same way that the Unfettered invaders did. Admiral Danforth says that the system where the Korath ships have gathered is home to a secret Alpha base, so he is concerned that the Kor Sestor drones are under Alpha control.
units.italian: La flotta Kor Sestor è riuscita in qualche modo ad arrivare nello spazio umano settentrionale, forse usando un piccolo numero di motori di salto per traghettare le navi avanti e indietro come hanno fatto gli invasori Slegati. L'ammiraglio Danforth dice che il sistema dove si sono radunate le navi Korath ospita una base segreta degli Alphas, quindi teme che i droni Kor Sestor siano sotto il controllo degli Alphas.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Farpoint Attack 1|As you are coming in for a landing, you contact Admiral Danforth and ask to speak with him as soon as possible. He meets you at the landing pad and invites you back to his office, where you explain about the large Kor Sestor fleet that is now gathering to the north of here. He tells you, "For the past several months, Intelligence has been tracking a hidden Alpha base on Zenith and making plans to trap and exterminate them. And now you tell me that Zenith is being guarded by Korath drones. It seems unlikely to be a coincidence."|2013|0
units.english: As you are coming in for a landing, you contact Admiral Danforth and ask to speak with him as soon as possible. He meets you at the landing pad and invites you back to his office, where you explain about the large Kor Sestor fleet that is now gathering to the north of here. He tells you, "For the past several months, Intelligence has been tracking a hidden Alpha base on Zenith and making plans to trap and exterminate them. And now you tell me that Zenith is being guarded by Korath drones. It seems unlikely to be a coincidence."
units.italian: Mentre ti avvicini per atterrare, contatti l'ammiraglio Danforth e chiedi di parlargli il prima possibile. Ti incontra alla piazzola di atterraggio e ti invita nel suo ufficio, dove gli spieghi della grande flotta Kor Sestor che si sta radunando a nord di qui. Ti dice: "Negli ultimi mesi l'Intelligence ha seguito una base nascosta degli Alphas su Zenith e ha preparato piani per intrappolarli e sterminarli. E ora tu mi dici che Zenith è sorvegliata da droni Korath. Sembra improbabile che sia una coincidenza."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Farpoint Attack 1|	"Could the Kor Sestor have made some sort of deal with the Alphas?"|2015|0
units.english: "Could the Kor Sestor have made some sort of deal with the Alphas?"
units.italian: "I Kor Sestor potrebbero aver fatto un qualche accordo con gli Alphas?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Farpoint Attack 1|	"Maybe the Alphas gained control of the Kor Sestor fleet somehow?"|2016|0
units.english: "Maybe the Alphas gained control of the Kor Sestor fleet somehow?"
units.italian: "Forse gli Alphas hanno preso il controllo della flotta Kor Sestor in qualche modo?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Farpoint Attack 1|	"That would assume that some of the Korath who controlled the Sestor fleet are still alive," he says. "Is there evidence that that is the case?"|2019|0
units.english: "That would assume that some of the Korath who controlled the Sestor fleet are still alive," he says. "Is there evidence that that is the case?"
units.italian: "Ciò presupporrebbe che alcuni dei Korath che controllavano la flotta Sestor siano ancora vivi," dice. "Ci sono prove che sia così?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Farpoint Attack 1|	You tell him about the underground bunker that the Wanderers discovered, and the signs that someone either recently departed from it, or recently infiltrated it from the surface. He says, "We already know that a group of Alphas was active in that region of space. You and I fought them there just recently, and failed to capture them. I bet that after they fled, they somehow gained access to the Kor Sestor bunker and took over control of the drone fleets."|2022|0
units.english: You tell him about the underground bunker that the Wanderers discovered, and the signs that someone either recently departed from it, or recently infiltrated it from the surface. He says, "We already know that a group of Alphas was active in that region of space. You and I fought them there just recently, and failed to capture them. I bet that after they fled, they somehow gained access to the Kor Sestor bunker and took over control of the drone fleets."
units.italian: Gli racconti del bunker sotterraneo che i Wanderers hanno scoperto, e dei segni che qualcuno se ne è allontanato di recente, oppure vi è entrato di recente dalla superficie. Dice: "Sappiamo già che un gruppo di Alphas era attivo in quella regione di spazio. Tu e io li abbiamo combattuti lì proprio di recente, e non siamo riusciti a catturarli. Scommetto che, dopo essere fuggiti, sono riusciti in qualche modo ad accedere al bunker Kor Sestor e a prendere il controllo delle flotte di droni."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Farpoint Attack 1|	It is not particularly surprising when, a few seconds after he says that, an alarm siren begins to sound...|2023|0
units.english: It is not particularly surprising when, a few seconds after he says that, an alarm siren begins to sound...
units.italian: Non è particolarmente sorprendente che, pochi secondi dopo che ha detto questo, cominci a suonare una sirena d'allarme...

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Farpoint Attack 1|dialog|2026|0
units.english: There are still Sestor warships overhead. You should take off again and assist in the fight.
units.italian: Ci sono ancora navi da guerra Sestor là sopra. Dovresti decollare di nuovo e dare una mano nello scontro.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Farpoint Attack 1|dialog|2055|0
units.english: The Kor Sestor fleet has been driven off. Time to land and see what Danforth thinks you should do next.
units.italian: La flotta Kor Sestor è stata respinta. È tempo di atterrare e vedere che cosa pensa Danforth che tu debba fare.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Quarg Help 1|name|2122|0
units.english: Ask the Quarg for help
units.italian: Chiedi aiuto ai Quarg

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Quarg Help 1|description|2123|0
units.english: Admiral Danforth asked you to visit <planet> and ask the Quarg if they can provide any ships to help you fight off the Kor Sestor fleet (now presumably under Alpha control).
units.italian: L'ammiraglio Danforth ti ha chiesto di visitare <planet> e di chiedere ai Quarg se possono fornire navi per aiutarti a respingere la flotta Kor Sestor (ora presumibilmente sotto il controllo degli Alphas).

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Quarg Help 1|Admiral Danforth looks like he is still in shock from the carnage and loss of life in the battle that you just fought. "Please tell me that that was the entire drone fleet," he says.|2132|0
units.english: Admiral Danforth looks like he is still in shock from the carnage and loss of life in the battle that you just fought. "Please tell me that that was the entire drone fleet," he says.
units.italian: L'ammiraglio Danforth sembra ancora sotto shock per il massacro e le perdite della battaglia che avete appena combattuto. "Dimmi che quella era tutta la flotta di droni," dice.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Quarg Help 1|	Sadly, you shake your head. "They have dozens of capital ships," you say. "That was probably just the vanguard of their fleet."|2133|0
units.english: Sadly, you shake your head. "They have dozens of capital ships," you say. "That was probably just the vanguard of their fleet."
units.italian: Purtroppo scuoti la testa. "Hanno decine di navi capitali," dici. "Quella era probabilmente solo l'avanguardia della loro flotta."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Quarg Help 1|	Danforth sighs. "I got a taste of how powerful these Korath ships are during our attack on the previous Alpha base," he says. "I'm not sure I can stand up against a whole fleet of them. Our only hope may be the Quarg. They have a ringworld in Hai space. In fact, isn't that where we left your friend Elias?" You nod. "You should go there immediately," says Danforth. "Hopefully, you will be able to bring back help in time."|2134|0
units.english: Danforth sighs. "I got a taste of how powerful these Korath ships are during our attack on the previous Alpha base," he says. "I'm not sure I can stand up against a whole fleet of them. Our only hope may be the Quarg. They have a ringworld in Hai space. In fact, isn't that where we left your friend Elias?" You nod. "You should go there immediately," says Danforth. "Hopefully, you will be able to bring back help in time."
units.italian: Danforth sospira. "Ho avuto un assaggio di quanto sono potenti queste navi Korath durante il nostro attacco alla precedente base degli Alphas," dice. "Non sono sicuro di poter reggere contro un'intera flotta di navi così. La nostra unica speranza potrebbero essere i Quarg. Hanno un mondo ad anello nello spazio Hai. Anzi, non è lì che abbiamo lasciato il tuo amico Elias?" Annuisci. "Dovresti andarci subito," dice Danforth. "Speriamo che tu riesca a portare aiuto in tempo."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Quarg Help 2|name|2141|0
units.english: Return to <planet>
units.italian: Ritorna su <planet>

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Quarg Help 2|description|2142|0
units.english: Return to <planet> with this small fleet of Quarg ships.
units.italian: Torna su <planet> con questa piccola flotta di navi dei Quarg.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Quarg Help 2|blocked|2146|0
units.english: You will need <capacity> to carry supplies back to Farpoint.
units.italian: Ti serve <capacity> per portare rifornimenti a Farpoint.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Quarg Help 2|As you are coming in for a landing, you contact the Quarg and discover that Elias Hanover is indeed still living here. He meets you the moment you dock with the station, and you describe the situation. "This must be retaliation," he says. "They want to wipe Danforth and the Oathkeepers off the map to get revenge for him driving them out of their base on Avalon."|2151|0
units.english: As you are coming in for a landing, you contact the Quarg and discover that Elias Hanover is indeed still living here. He meets you the moment you dock with the station, and you describe the situation. "This must be retaliation," he says. "They want to wipe Danforth and the Oathkeepers off the map to get revenge for him driving them out of their base on Avalon."
units.italian: Mentre ti avvicini per atterrare, contatti i Quarg e scopri che Elias Hanover vive davvero ancora qui. Ti viene incontro appena attraccate alla stazione, e tu gli descrivi la situazione. "Dev'essere una rappresaglia," dice. "Vogliono cancellare Danforth e gli Oathkeepers dalla mappa per vendicarsi di averli scacciati dalla loro base su Avalon."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Quarg Help 2|	He leaves to try to find help, and returns about fifteen minutes later. "I've got four Quarg ships who volunteered to help," he says. "That may not seem like a lot, but their ships pack quite a punch. And, they've offered some medical supplies as well, which they'll load onto your ship. Good luck, captain."|2152|0
units.english: He leaves to try to find help, and returns about fifteen minutes later. "I've got four Quarg ships who volunteered to help," he says. "That may not seem like a lot, but their ships pack quite a punch. And, they've offered some medical supplies as well, which they'll load onto your ship. Good luck, captain."
units.italian: Se ne va a cercare aiuto e torna dopo circa quindici minuti. "Ho trovato quattro navi dei Quarg che si sono offerte volontarie," dice. "Può non sembrare molto, ma le loro navi fanno parecchio male. E hanno offerto anche alcuni rifornimenti medici, che caricheranno sulla tua nave. Buona fortuna, capitano."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Quarg Help 2|	You thank him for his assistance, and hurry to fire up your ship and return to human space. Hopefully Danforth's base has not already been overrun in your absence.|2153|0
units.english: You thank him for his assistance, and hurry to fire up your ship and return to human space. Hopefully Danforth's base has not already been overrun in your absence.
units.italian: Lo ringrazi per l'aiuto e ti affretti ad avviare la nave e a tornare nello spazio umano. Si spera che la base di Danforth non sia già stata travolta durante la tua assenza.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Quarg Help 2|log|2156|0
units.english: Recruited some Quarg warships to help defend human space from the Kor Sestor drones, which are now presumably under Alpha control.
units.italian: Hai reclutato alcune navi da guerra dei Quarg per aiutare a difendere lo spazio umano dai droni Kor Sestor, ora presumibilmente sotto il controllo degli Alphas.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Quarg Help 2|dialog|2170|0
units.english: You've reached <planet>, but you've either left one of the Quarg warships behind, or your escort carrying the medical supplies from Elias hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it.
units.italian: Hai raggiunto <planet>, ma o hai lasciato indietro una delle navi da guerra dei Quarg, oppure la tua scorta che porta i rifornimenti medici di Elias non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Bomb Zenith 1|name|2198|0
units.english: Deliver device to Zenith
units.italian: Consegna il dispositivo a Zenith

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Bomb Zenith 1|description|2199|0
units.english: Admiral Danforth asked you to drop this device (presumably a bomb) above the Alpha base on <destination>.
units.italian: L'ammiraglio Danforth ti ha chiesto di sganciare questo dispositivo (presumibilmente una bomba) sopra la base degli Alphas su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Bomb Zenith 1|log|2208|0
units.english: Danforth believes that he has located the Alpha base from which the drones are being controlled; if the base is destroyed the drones ought to become aimless and be easily defeated.
units.italian: Danforth ritiene di aver localizzato la base degli Alphas da cui vengono controllati i droni; se la base fosse distrutta, i droni dovrebbero diventare privi di guida e facili da sconfiggere.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Bomb Zenith 1|Danforth is still alive, and still holding out against the Alpha-controlled drones. After directing several recruits to unload the medical supplies, he tells you, "The Alpha base we've been watching on <planet> is buried deep underground. I'm hoping that the Alphas either don't know we're aware of their base's location, or have chosen to remain there anyway because it is so well defended. If the drones are being controlled from there, taking out the base might deactivate the drones."|2210|0
units.english: Danforth is still alive, and still holding out against the Alpha-controlled drones. After directing several recruits to unload the medical supplies, he tells you, "The Alpha base we've been watching on <planet> is buried deep underground. I'm hoping that the Alphas either don't know we're aware of their base's location, or have chosen to remain there anyway because it is so well defended. If the drones are being controlled from there, taking out the base might deactivate the drones."
units.italian: Danforth è ancora vivo, e ancora resiste ai droni controllati dagli Alphas. Dopo aver incaricato alcune reclute di scaricare i rifornimenti medici, ti dice: "La base degli Alphas che abbiamo tenuto sotto osservazione su <planet> è sepolta in profondità. Spero che gli Alphas non sappiano che conosciamo la posizione della loro base, oppure che abbiano scelto di restare lì comunque perché è così ben difesa. Se i droni sono controllati da lì, eliminare la base potrebbe disattivarli."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Bomb Zenith 1|	"Do you think your troops could capture the base?"|2212|0
units.english: "Do you think your troops could capture the base?"
units.italian: "Pensi che le tue truppe potrebbero conquistare la base?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Bomb Zenith 1|	"Do you have a plan for destroying the Alphas?"|2213|0
units.english: "Do you have a plan for destroying the Alphas?"
units.italian: "Hai un piano per distruggere gli Alphas?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Bomb Zenith 1|	Danforth says, "The base is several kilometers underground. Before it was guarded by Sestor drones, we had a chance. We could have landed dozens of troop transports and fought our way inside, albeit with heavy losses. But now, I doubt our troops could even make it to the surface."|2215|0
units.english: Danforth says, "The base is several kilometers underground. Before it was guarded by Sestor drones, we had a chance. We could have landed dozens of troop transports and fought our way inside, albeit with heavy losses. But now, I doubt our troops could even make it to the surface."
units.italian: Danforth dice: "La base è a diversi chilometri di profondità. Prima che fosse sorvegliata dai droni Sestor avevamo una possibilità. Avremmo potuto far atterrare decine di trasporti di truppe e aprirci la strada combattendo, anche se con gravi perdite. Ma ora dubito che le nostre truppe riuscirebbero ad arrivare in superficie."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Bomb Zenith 1|	As he is speaking, two Navy officers approach your ship with a hover-cart carrying something that looks a little bit like a retrofitted Typhoon Torpedo. They salute Danforth, and he tells them, "Put it aboard Captain <last>'s ship." Then he turns to you. "I'm going to give you the coordinates of the Alpha base," he says. "It's on the polar continent, deep under the ice. Fortunately there are no other human settlements nearby."|2216|0
units.english: As he is speaking, two Navy officers approach your ship with a hover-cart carrying something that looks a little bit like a retrofitted Typhoon Torpedo. They salute Danforth, and he tells them, "Put it aboard Captain <last>'s ship." Then he turns to you. "I'm going to give you the coordinates of the Alpha base," he says. "It's on the polar continent, deep under the ice. Fortunately there are no other human settlements nearby."
units.italian: Mentre sta parlando, due ufficiali della Marina si avvicinano alla tua nave con un carrello a levitazione che trasporta qualcosa che somiglia un po' a un siluro Typhoon modificato. Salutano Danforth, e lui dice loro: "Mettetelo sulla nave del Capitano <last>." Poi si volta verso di te. "Ti darò le coordinate della base degli Alphas," dice. "È sul continente polare, in profondità sotto il ghiaccio. Per fortuna non ci sono altri insediamenti umani lì vicino."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Bomb Zenith 1|	He pauses, as if to resign himself to what he is about to command you to do, and then says, "Land on the planet, drop this device at the coordinates, and then get the hell out of there. You'll have fifteen seconds after you deploy the device to get at least a thousand kilometers away."|2217|0
units.english: He pauses, as if to resign himself to what he is about to command you to do, and then says, "Land on the planet, drop this device at the coordinates, and then get the hell out of there.
