You'll have fifteen seconds after you deploy the device to get at least a thousand kilometers away."
units.italian: Si ferma, come per rassegnarsi a ciò che sta per ordinarti, e poi dice: "Atterra sul pianeta, sgancia questo dispositivo alle coordinate, e poi taglia la corda. Avrai quindici secondi dopo averlo sganciato per essere ad almeno mille chilometri di distanza."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Bomb Zenith 1|	"Wait, is this a nuke? I thought the Navy was too principled to use them."|2219|0
units.english: "Wait, is this a nuke? I thought the Navy was too principled to use them."
units.italian: "Aspetta, è una bomba nucleare? Pensavo che la Marina fosse troppo integerrima per usarle."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Bomb Zenith 1|	"Okay, I'll do what you say."|2220|0
units.english: "Okay, I'll do what you say."
units.italian: "Va bene, farò come dici."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Bomb Zenith 1|	"Just drop the damn thing and get out of there, fast," he says. Clearly he doesn't want to tell you anything more about the weapon's origin.|2223|0
units.english: "Just drop the damn thing and get out of there, fast," he says. Clearly he doesn't want to tell you anything more about the weapon's origin.
units.italian: "Sgancia quella dannata cosa e vattene, in fretta," dice. Chiaramente non vuole dirti altro sull'origine dell'arma.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Bomb Zenith 1|	Alarm sirens begin to sound. "Don't wait here to defend us," says Danforth. "Go straight to <planet> and deploy the device. It may be the only way you can save us."|2226|0
units.english: Alarm sirens begin to sound. "Don't wait here to defend us," says Danforth. "Go straight to <planet> and deploy the device. It may be the only way you can save us."
units.italian: Cominciano a suonare le sirene d'allarme. "Non restare qui a difenderci," dice Danforth. "Va' dritto su <planet> e sgancia il dispositivo. Potrebbe essere l'unico modo per salvarci."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Bomb Zenith 1|Danforth wasn't joking when he said that the device may be your only chance. There are almost a dozen Sestor capital ships in the system, and countless smaller craft tearing the Navy to shreds.|2230|0
units.english: Danforth wasn't joking when he said that the device may be your only chance. There are almost a dozen Sestor capital ships in the system, and countless smaller craft tearing the Navy to shreds.
units.italian: Danforth non scherzava quando ha detto che il dispositivo potrebbe essere la tua unica possibilità. Ci sono quasi una dozzina di navi capitali Sestor nel sistema, e innumerevoli vascelli più piccoli che stanno facendo a pezzi la Marina.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Bomb Zenith 1|Even the Quarg warships are having trouble with an opposing fleet this size. Perhaps a more powerful fleet could defeat the automata, but it would be a difficult battle.|2231|0
units.english: Even the Quarg warships are having trouble with an opposing fleet this size. Perhaps a more powerful fleet could defeat the automata, but it would be a difficult battle.
units.italian: Anche le navi da guerra dei Quarg hanno problemi con una flotta avversaria di queste dimensioni. Forse una flotta più potente potrebbe sconfiggere gli automi, ma sarebbe una battaglia difficile.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Bomb Zenith 1|dialog|2233|0
units.english: You go to push the device out of the airlock, but realize that you left it on one of your escorts. Better depart and wait for it to enter the system.
units.italian: Ti accingi a spingere il dispositivo fuori dal portello, ma ti rendi conto di averlo lasciato su una delle tue scorte. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che entri nel sistema.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Farpoint Attack 2|dialog|2249|0
units.english: Danforth notices your ship land as the sky lights up with the explosions of Navy ships. "Did you use the bomb?" he asks. The stress in his voice is palpable. You shake your head. "Then what the hell are you doing here? Get up there and drop the bomb already!"
units.italian: Danforth nota la tua nave atterrare mentre il cielo si illumina delle esplosioni delle navi della Marina. "Hai usato la bomba?" chiede. Lo stress nella sua voce è palpabile. Scuoti la testa. "E allora che diavolo ci fai qui? Vai là sopra e sgancia quella bomba!"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Farpoint Attack 2|dialog|2428|0
units.english: Against all odds, all the Kor Sestor ships attacking the Oathkeepers have been destroyed. Maybe you won't have to use Danforth's bomb after all.
units.italian: Contro ogni previsione, tutte le navi Kor Sestor che attaccavano gli Oathkeepers sono state distrutte. Forse non dovrai usare la bomba di Danforth dopo tutto.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Scattered Remnant|dialog|2452|0

units.id: event:bombed zenith|description|2646|0
units.english: Zenith is a cold and unpleasant world, where the fog seldom lifts and the sun is rarely seen, where much of the lowlands are flooded each day by the tide, and storms are unpredictable and fierce. It has, however, one major advantage as a place to settle: it is far enough away that the Republic makes no attempt to control it.
units.italian: Zenith è un mondo freddo e sgradevole, dove la nebbia si alza di rado e il sole si vede raramente, dove gran parte delle terre basse viene allagata ogni giorno dalla marea, e le tempeste sono imprevedibili e violente. Ha però un grande vantaggio come luogo in cui stabilirsi: è abbastanza lontano perché la Repubblica non tenti di controllarlo.

units.id: event:bombed zenith|description|2647|0
units.english: The settlements here were never more than tenuous villages operating on the brink of starvation as they sought to make a living in this icy wilderness. Now, many of them have collapsed due to massive earthquakes that came after the Oathkeepers had the planet bombed to destroy an Alpha base.
units.italian: Gli insediamenti qui non sono mai stati più che villaggi precari che sopravvivono sull'orlo della fame, cercando di guadagnarsi da vivere in questa landa ghiacciata. Ora molti sono crollati a causa dei terremoti enormi che sono seguiti al bombardamento del pianeta da parte degli Oathkeepers per distruggere una base degli Alphas.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Bomb Zenith 2|name|2675|0
units.english: Return to <planet>
units.italian: Ritorna su <planet>

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Bomb Zenith 2|description|2676|0
units.english: You have destroyed the Alpha base on Zenith. Return to Farpoint and find out if your intervention allowed Danforth to gain the upper hand against the Kor Sestor fleet.
units.italian: Hai distrutto la base degli Alphas su Zenith. Torna a Farpoint e scopri se il tuo intervento ha permesso a Danforth di prendere il sopravvento sulla flotta Kor Sestor.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Bomb Zenith 2|log|2682|0
units.english: Dropped some sort of incredibly destructive bomb on the Alpha base on the anarchist world of Zenith. The explosion tore open a hole straight through the planet's crust.
units.italian: Hai sganciato una specie di bomba incredibilmente distruttiva sulla base degli Alphas sul mondo anarchico di Zenith. L'esplosione ha aperto un buco che attraversa da parte a parte la crosta del pianeta.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Bomb Zenith 2|You shove Danforth's device out the airlock at the coordinates he gave you, and immediately fire your ship's repulsors full blast to take you back up into orbit...|2686|0
units.english: You shove Danforth's device out the airlock at the coordinates he gave you, and immediately fire your ship's repulsors full blast to take you back up into orbit...
units.italian: Spingi il dispositivo di Danforth fuori dal portello alle coordinate che ti ha dato, e immediatamente azioni al massimo i repulsori della nave per risalire in orbita...

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Bomb Zenith 2|The way Danforth talked about the device he gave you made you assume that it was a nuclear bomb, but the explosion that rocks <origin> a few seconds after you depart is far too powerful for that. The light of the explosion is many times brighter than this system's sun. And unless your sensors are lying to you, there is now a crater near <origin>'s south pole that goes all the way down to the mantle. Lava is filling the hole, and the entire planet's crust is shifting and shivering in response.|2690|0
units.english: The way Danforth talked about the device he gave you made you assume that it was a nuclear bomb, but the explosion that rocks <origin> a few seconds after you depart is far too powerful for that. The light of the explosion is many times brighter than this system's sun. And unless your sensors are lying to you, there is now a crater near <origin>'s south pole that goes all the way down to the mantle. Lava is filling the hole, and the entire planet's crust is shifting and shivering in response.
units.italian: Il modo in cui Danforth ha parlato del dispositivo che ti ha dato ti aveva fatto supporre che fosse una bomba nucleare, ma l'esplosione che scuote <origin> pochi secondi dopo la tua partenza è troppo potente per esserlo. La luce dell'esplosione è molte volte più brillante del sole di questo sistema. E, a meno che i tuoi sensori non ti stiano mentendo, ora c'è un cratere vicino al polo sud di <origin> che arriva fino al mantello. La lava sta riempiendo il buco, e l'intera crosta del pianeta si sposta e trema in risposta.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Bomb Zenith 2|	You are glad that no human settlements were near the explosion, but your sensors are picking up compression waves traveling along the whole planet's surface, bouncing across it again and again as the planet rings like a bell. Anyone who lived anywhere on <origin> just got hit by an earthquake of deadly proportions.|2691|0
units.english: You are glad that no human settlements were near the explosion, but your sensors are picking up compression waves traveling along the whole planet's surface, bouncing across it again and again as the planet rings like a bell. Anyone who lived anywhere on <origin> just got hit by an earthquake of deadly proportions.
units.italian: Sei contento che non ci fossero insediamenti umani vicino all'esplosione, ma i tuoi sensori rilevano onde di compressione che viaggiano lungo tutta la superficie del pianeta, rimbalzando di nuovo e di nuovo mentre il pianeta risuona come una campana. Chiunque vivesse in qualunque punto di <origin> è appena stato colpito da un terremoto di proporzioni letali.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Bomb Zenith 2|	You can only hope that it was worth it, and that the control station has indeed been destroyed.|2692|0
units.english: You can only hope that it was worth it, and that the control station has indeed been destroyed.
units.italian: Puoi solo sperare che ne sia valsa la pena e che la stazione di controllo sia davvero stata distrutta.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Kill Southern Remnant|The base on <planet> appears to have survived the attack, despite the Kor Sestor drones that were overhead. You meet with Danforth and tell him that you destroyed the Alpha base using the weapon he gave you.|2774|0
units.english: The base on <planet> appears to have survived the attack, despite the Kor Sestor drones that were overhead. You meet with Danforth and tell him that you destroyed the Alpha base using the weapon he gave you.
units.italian: La base su <planet> sembra essere sopravvissuta all'attacco, nonostante i droni Kor Sestor che c'erano sopra. Incontri Danforth e gli dici che hai distrutto la base degli Alphas con l'arma che ti ha dato.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Kill Southern Remnant|	He says, "When you destroyed the base, the Sestor drones suddenly stopped acting as a unified fleet. A few stayed here, but most of them have spread throughout this sector of space, and we are receiving reports that they are attacking Navy and civilian ships indiscriminately. My own fleet is too damaged to do anything to stop them, but other Navy bases are sending in reinforcements. Can you join them to help eliminate the drones?"|2775|0
units.english: He says, "When you destroyed the base, the Sestor drones suddenly stopped acting as a unified fleet. A few stayed here, but most of them have spread throughout this sector of space, and we are receiving reports that they are attacking Navy and civilian ships indiscriminately. My own fleet is too damaged to do anything to stop them, but other Navy bases are sending in reinforcements. Can you join them to help eliminate the drones?"
units.italian: Dice: "Quando hai distrutto la base, i droni Sestor hanno smesso improvvisamente di agire come una flotta unita. Alcuni sono rimasti qui, ma la maggior parte si è sparsa per questo settore di spazio, e riceviamo rapporti che stanno attaccando navi della Marina e civili indiscriminatamente. La mia flotta è troppo danneggiata per fare qualcosa per fermarli, ma altre basi della Marina stanno inviando rinforzi. Puoi unirti a loro per aiutare a eliminare i droni?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Kill Southern Remnant|	"Of course, I would be glad to."|2777|0
units.english: "Of course, I would be glad to."
units.italian: "Naturalmente, ne sarò felice."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Kill Southern Remnant|	"Of course. But first, what the hell was that bomb you had me drop on Zenith? It cracked the whole planet open."|2779|0
units.english: "Of course. But first, what the hell was that bomb you had me drop on Zenith? It cracked the whole planet open."
units.italian: "Certo. Ma prima: che diavolo era quella bomba che mi hai fatto sganciare su Zenith? Ha spaccato in due il pianeta intero."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Kill Southern Remnant|	Danforth sighs. "Unfortunately," he says, "I am not permitted to tell you what that weapon was or how we acquired it. And already news agencies throughout the Republic are questioning our use of such a terrible weapon. I wish we had been able to defeat the Kor Sestor fleet without resorting to such extreme measures, but we had no choice."|2781|0
units.english: Danforth sighs. "Unfortunately," he says, "I am not permitted to tell you what that weapon was or how we acquired it. And already news agencies throughout the Republic are questioning our use of such a terrible weapon. I wish we had been able to defeat the Kor Sestor fleet without resorting to such extreme measures, but we had no choice."
units.italian: Danforth sospira. "Purtroppo," dice, "non mi è permesso dirti che cos'era quell'arma né come l'abbiamo ottenuta. E già le agenzie di stampa di tutta la Repubblica mettono in dubbio il nostro uso di un'arma così terribile. Vorrei che fossimo riusciti a sconfiggere la flotta Kor Sestor senza ricorrere a misure così estreme, ma non avevamo scelta."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Kill Southern Remnant|	Danforth gives you a map of the systems where there have been reports of Kor Sestor drones attacking civilian ships. "These, plus any that were left alive in the Alnilam system, are all the automata that we have been able to track," he says. "Report back here once you have succeeded in completely destroying them. We can't risk letting some local warlord capture them. The Navy will hopefully send some ships to help you."|2784|0
units.english: Danforth gives you a map of the systems where there have been reports of Kor Sestor drones attacking civilian ships. "These, plus any that were left alive in the Alnilam system, are all the automata that we have been able to track," he says. "Report back here once you have succeeded in completely destroying them. We can't risk letting some local warlord capture them. The Navy will hopefully send some ships to help you."
units.italian: Danforth ti dà una mappa dei sistemi in cui ci sono state segnalazioni di droni Kor Sestor che attaccano navi civili. "Questi, più quelli rimasti vivi nel sistema Alnilam, sono tutti gli automi che siamo riusciti a rintracciare," dice. "Riferisci qui quando sarai riuscito a distruggerli del tutto. Non possiamo rischiare che qualche signore della guerra locale se ne impadronisca. La Marina speriamo che invierà qualche nave ad aiutarti."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Remnant Visit|You check in with Danforth, but he tells you that there are still reports of Kor Sestor drones in human space. "You'll have to be sure to destroy them completely," he says. "We can't risk letting some local warlord capture them."|2797|0
units.english: You check in with Danforth, but he tells you that there are still reports of Kor Sestor drones in human space. "You'll have to be sure to destroy them completely," he says. "We can't risk letting some local warlord capture them."
units.italian: Ti metti in contatto con Danforth, ma lui ti dice che ci sono ancora rapporti su droni Kor Sestor nello spazio umano. "Dovrai assicurarti di distruggerli completamente," dice. "Non possiamo rischiare che qualche signore della guerra locale se ne impadronisca."

units.english: Drones in Alnilam
units.italian: Droni ad Alnilam

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Drones in Alnilam Waypoint|description|2806|0
units.context: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Drones in Alnilam Waypoint
units.english: Eliminate the remaining Kor Sestor fleet in the Alnilam system.
units.italian: Elimina la flotta Kor Sestor rimasta nel sistema Alnilam.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Drones in Alnilam|When you return to <planet>, Danforth tells you, "It seems that you have dealt with the last of the Kor Sestor drones that were terrorizing Republic space, but we still need to deal with the fleet in the Alnilam system. Do you think you can destroy that fleet on your own?"|2834|0
units.english: When you return to <planet>, Danforth tells you, "It seems that you have dealt with the last of the Kor Sestor drones that were terrorizing Republic space, but we still need to deal with the fleet in the Alnilam system. Do you think you can destroy that fleet on your own?"
units.italian: Quando torni su <planet>, Danforth ti dice: "Sembra che tu abbia sistemato gli ultimi droni Kor Sestor che terrorizzavano lo spazio della Repubblica, ma dobbiamo ancora occuparci della flotta nel sistema Alnilam. Pensi di poter distruggere quella flotta da solo?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Drones in Alnilam|	"Yes, I think I can manage it."|2836|0
units.english: "Yes, I think I can manage it."
units.italian: "Sì, credo di potercela fare."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Drones in Alnilam|	"Are any of your ships repaired yet? I could use some assistance."|2838|0
units.english: "Are any of your ships repaired yet? I could use some assistance."
units.italian: "Qualcuna delle tue navi è già riparata? Mi servirebbe un po' di aiuto."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Drones in Alnilam|	He agrees to send some Oathkeeper ships with you to destroy the remaining drones, but it is clear that it pains him to risk the last few ships he has that are still spaceworthy.|2839|0
units.english: He agrees to send some Oathkeeper ships with you to destroy the remaining drones, but it is clear that it pains him to risk the last few ships he has that are still spaceworthy.
units.italian: Accetta di mandarti alcune navi degli Oathkeepers per distruggere i droni rimasti, ma è chiaro che gli costa rischiare le ultime navi ancora in grado di volare che gli restano.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Drones in Alnilam|dialog|2842|0
units.english: You've returned to <planet>, but not all of the Sestor ships in Alnilam have been defeated yet. Return to the system and make sure they are all destroyed.
units.italian: Sei tornato su <planet>, ma non tutte le navi Sestor ad Alnilam sono ancora state sconfitte. Torna nel sistema e assicurati che siano tutte distrutte.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Return to Wanderers|name|2883|0
units.english: Return to <planet>
units.italian: Ritorna su <planet>

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Return to Wanderers|description|2884|0
units.english: The Kor Sestor drones in human space have been eliminated. Return to <planet> in Wanderer space to find out what is happening there.
units.italian: I droni Kor Sestor nello spazio umano sono stati eliminati. Torna su <planet>, nello spazio dei Wanderers, per scoprire che cosa sta succedendo là.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Return to Wanderers|log|2894|0
units.english: Succeeded in destroying the last of the Kor Sestor drones that the Alphas brought into human space. Danforth and his Navy base also survived, but he is worried about the political fallout of having to use such a destructive weapon on a populated planet in order to eliminate the Alphas.
units.italian: Sei riuscito a distruggere gli ultimi droni Kor Sestor che gli Alphas avevano portato nello spazio umano. Anche Danforth e la sua base della Marina sono sopravvissuti, ma lui è preoccupato per le conseguenze politiche dell'aver dovuto usare un'arma così distruttiva su un pianeta abitato per eliminare gli Alphas.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Return to Wanderers|Danforth breathes a sigh of relief when you tell him that the last of the Kor Sestor drones have been destroyed. "I am grateful for your help, Captain <last>," he says. "And now that we have finished with that battle, the public relations nightmare over what we did to Zenith begins. We don't need you to get involved in that, though; perhaps you should return to Wanderer space until things cool down a bit around here."|2896|0
units.english: Danforth breathes a sigh of relief when you tell him that the last of the Kor Sestor drones have been destroyed. "I am grateful for your help, Captain <last>," he says. "And now that we have finished with that battle, the public relations nightmare over what we did to Zenith begins. We don't need you to get involved in that, though; perhaps you should return to Wanderer space until things cool down a bit around here."
units.italian: Danforth tira un sospiro di sollievo quando gli dici che gli ultimi droni Kor Sestor sono stati distrutti. "Ti sono grato per l'aiuto, Capitano <last>," dice. "E ora che abbiamo chiuso con quella battaglia, comincia l'incubo di pubbliche relazioni per quello che abbiamo fatto a Zenith. Non serve che tu ti ci immischi, però; forse dovresti tornare nello spazio dei Wanderers finché le cose qui non si calmano un po'."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Alt: Alnilam 1|name|2903|0
units.english: Destroy remaining drones
units.italian: Distruggi i droni rimasti

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Alt: Alnilam 1|description|2904|0
units.english: Rather than bombing Zenith, destroy any Kor Sestor drones that are left over in the Alnilam system, then report back to Admiral Danforth on Farpoint.
units.italian: Invece di bombardare Zenith, distruggi tutti i droni Kor Sestor rimasti nel sistema Alnilam, poi riferisci all'ammiraglio Danforth su Farpoint.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Alt: Alnilam 1|Danforth is impressed that you were able to eliminate the attacking Kor Sestor fleet. "The weapon I gave you was a last resort, and one that I would be ashamed to use," he says. "I have no ships to give you until we have had time to make repairs, but if you are able to destroy whatever Kor Sestor ships remain in the Alnilam system on your own, return here and I will send my troop transports with you to destroy the Alpha base the old-fashioned way."|2916|0
units.english: Danforth is impressed that you were able to eliminate the attacking Kor Sestor fleet. "The weapon I gave you was a last resort, and one that I would be ashamed to use," he says. "I have no ships to give you until we have had time to make repairs, but if you are able to destroy whatever Kor Sestor ships remain in the Alnilam system on your own, return here and I will send my troop transports with you to destroy the Alpha base the old-fashioned way."
units.italian: Danforth è colpito dal fatto che tu sia riuscito a eliminare la flotta Kor Sestor attaccante. "L'arma che ti ho dato era un ultimo ricorso, e uno di cui mi vergognerei di servirmi," dice. "Non ho navi da darti finché non avremo avuto il tempo di ripararle, ma se riesci a distruggere da solo le navi Kor Sestor rimaste nel sistema Alnilam, torna qui e manderò i miei trasporti di truppe con te a distruggere la base degli Alphas alla vecchia maniera."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Alt: Alnilam 2|name|2926|0
units.english: Attack Alpha base
units.italian: Attacca la base Alpha

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Alt: Alnilam 2|description|2927|0
units.english: Travel to the <system> system with these Oathkeeper Cruisers to eliminate the Alpha base on <planet>.
units.italian: Recati nel sistema <system> con questi incrociatori degli Oathkeepers per eliminare la base degli Alphas su <planet>.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Alt: Alnilam 2|You tell Danforth that you have destroyed the entire Kor Sestor fleet, without needing to bomb <planet>. He is impressed, and grateful. "I'll send some troop transports with you to take out the Alpha base," he says. "It is riskier destroying it this way, but at least the civilians on <planet> will not be harmed."|2938|0
units.english: You tell Danforth that you have destroyed the entire Kor Sestor fleet, without needing to bomb <planet>. He is impressed, and grateful. "I'll send some troop transports with you to take out the Alpha base," he says. "It is riskier destroying it this way, but at least the civilians on <planet> will not be harmed."
units.italian: Dici a Danforth che hai distrutto l'intera flotta Kor Sestor, senza bisogno di bombardare <planet>. È colpito, e grato. "Manderò alcuni trasporti di truppe con te per eliminare la base degli Alphas," dice. "Distruggerla in questo modo è più rischioso, ma almeno i civili su <planet> non saranno colpiti."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Alt: Alnilam 2|	"Understood. We'll go directly to <planet>."|2940|0
units.english: "Understood. We'll go directly to <planet>."
units.italian: "Capito. Andremo dritti su <planet>."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Alt: Alnilam 2|	"The anarchist settlers, you mean? You're willing to lose your own troops just to avoid harming the anarchists and pirates by bombing their planet?"|2942|0
units.english: "The anarchist settlers, you mean? You're willing to lose your own troops just to avoid harming the anarchists and pirates by bombing their planet?"
units.italian: "I coloni anarchici, vuoi dire? Sei disposto a perdere le tue truppe solo per evitare di colpire gli anarchici e i pirati bombardando il loro pianeta?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Alt: Alnilam 2|	Danforth says, "If we had used such a terrible weapon on an inhabited planet, even an anarchist one, it would have sullied the good name of the Navy. Compared to that, the loss of a few Navy lives is acceptable, and the troops who volunteered for this mission are willing to risk their lives for that cause."|2944|0
units.english: Danforth says, "If we had used such a terrible weapon on an inhabited planet, even an anarchist one, it would have sullied the good name of the Navy. Compared to that, the loss of a few Navy lives is acceptable, and the troops who volunteered for this mission are willing to risk their lives for that cause."
units.italian: Danforth dice: "Se avessimo usato un'arma così terribile su un pianeta abitato, anche anarchico, avrebbe macchiato il buon nome della Marina. In confronto, la perdita di qualche vita della Marina è accettabile, e le truppe che si sono offerte volontarie per questa missione sono disposte a rischiare la vita per questa causa."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Alt: Alnilam 2|	You return to your ship and prepare to escort the troop transports to <planet>.|2947|0
units.english: You return to your ship and prepare to escort the troop transports to <planet>.
units.italian: Torni alla tua nave e ti prepari a scortare i trasporti di truppe fino a <planet>.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Alt: Alnilam 2|dialog|2956|0
units.english: You've reached <planet>, but not all of the Navy Cruisers have entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for them to arrive, because there's no way you're going to assault the Alpha base without them.
units.italian: Hai raggiunto <planet>, ma non tutti gli incrociatori della Marina sono ancora entrati nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivino, perché non hai alcuna intenzione di assaltare la base degli Alphas senza di loro.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Alt: Alnilam 3|name|2962|0
units.english: Return to <planet>
units.italian: Ritorna su <planet>

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Alt: Alnilam 3|description|2963|0
units.english: Escort the Oathkeeper Cruisers back to <destination>.
units.italian: Scorta gli incrociatori degli Oathkeepers di ritorno su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Alt: Alnilam 3|Danforth's troops set up a defensive circle around the entrance to the Alpha base. It appears that they have achieved the element of surprise: the Alphas did not know that the Navy had already located their base, and were probably counting on having a longer time to evacuate. The troop transports were carrying concrete mixers and mining drills; apparently their plan is to seal the Alphas underground and then drill down through the ice and bedrock to bomb and collapse the bunker.|2970|0
units.english: Danforth's troops set up a defensive circle around the entrance to the Alpha base. It appears that they have achieved the element of surprise: the Alphas did not know that the Navy had already located their base, and were probably counting on having a longer time to evacuate. The troop transports were carrying concrete mixers and mining drills; apparently their plan is to seal the Alphas underground and then drill down through the ice and bedrock to bomb and collapse the bunker.
units.italian: Le truppe di Danforth creano un cerchio difensivo intorno all'ingresso della base degli Alphas. Sembra che abbiano ottenuto l'effetto sorpresa: gli Alphas non sapevano che la Marina aveva già localizzato la loro base, e probabilmente contavano di avere più tempo per evacuare. I trasporti di truppe portavano betoniere e trivelle minerarie; a quanto pare il piano è sigillare gli Alphas sottoterra e poi perforare il ghiaccio e la roccia per bombardare e far crollare il bunker.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Alt: Alnilam 3|	As the Navy troops begin pouring the concrete, the massive gate to the tunnel bursts open and more Alphas than you have ever seen in one place come flooding out, several dozen of them. But even these superhuman soldiers cannot survive the concentrated firepower of hundreds of Navy troops. The air fills with explosions and smoke and powdered snow, but as far as you can tell not one of the Alphas escapes alive.|2971|0
units.english: As the Navy troops begin pouring the concrete, the massive gate to the tunnel bursts open and more Alphas than you have ever seen in one place come flooding out, several dozen of them. But even these superhuman soldiers cannot survive the concentrated firepower of hundreds of Navy troops. The air fills with explosions and smoke and powdered snow, but as far as you can tell not one of the Alphas escapes alive.
units.italian: Mentre le truppe della Marina cominciano a versare il cemento, il grande cancello del tunnel si spalanca e ne escono più Alphas di quanti tu ne abbia mai visti in un solo posto, diverse decine. Ma anche questi soldati superumani non possono sopravvivere al fuoco concentrato di centinaia di soldati della Marina. L'aria si riempie di esplosioni, fumo e neve polverizzata, ma per quanto puoi vedere nemmeno uno degli Alphas riesce a fuggire vivo.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Alt: Alnilam 3|	When the battle is over, the Navy troops explore the bunker, hoping to find prisoners, but they find no one alive. They seal up the entrance and collapse the bunker, and prepare to travel back with you to <planet>.|2972|0
units.english: When the battle is over, the Navy troops explore the bunker, hoping to find prisoners, but they find no one alive. They seal up the entrance and collapse the bunker, and prepare to travel back with you to <planet>.
units.italian: Quando la battaglia è finita, le truppe della Marina esplorano il bunker sperando di trovare prigionieri, ma non trovano nessuno vivo. Sigillano l'ingresso e fanno crollare il bunker, poi si preparano a tornare con te su <planet>.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Alt: Alnilam 3|dialog|2981|0
units.english: You've reached <planet>, but not all of the Navy Cruisers have entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for them to arrive.
units.italian: Hai raggiunto <planet>, ma non tutti gli incrociatori della Marina sono ancora entrati nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivino.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Alt: Return to Wanderers|name|3002|0
units.context: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Alt: Return to Wanderers
units.english: Return to <planet>
units.italian: Ritorna su <planet>

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Alt: Return to Wanderers|description|3003|0
units.context: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Alt: Return to Wanderers
units.english: The Kor Sestor drones in human space have been eliminated. Return to <planet> in Wanderer space to find out what is happening there.
units.italian: I droni Kor Sestor nello spazio umano sono stati eliminati. Torna su <planet>, nello spazio dei Wanderers, per scoprire che cosa sta succedendo là.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Alt: Return to Wanderers|log|3010|0
units.context: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Alt: Return to Wanderers
units.english: Succeeded in destroying the Kor Sestor fleet and eliminating the Alpha base on the anarchist world of Zenith. He is very grateful that the bomb or super-weapon, whatever it was, did not need to be used.
units.italian: Sei riuscito a distruggere la flotta Kor Sestor e a eliminare la base degli Alphas sul mondo anarchico di Zenith. Danforth è molto grato che la bomba, o super-arma, qualunque cosa fosse, non sia servita.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Alt: Return to Wanderers|The Navy officers report the results of the battle on Zenith's surface to Danforth. "So it's over," he says. "Captain <last>, thank you for your assistance. This battle would have gone very differently if you were not here."|3012|0
units.context: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Alt: Return to Wanderers
units.english: The Navy officers report the results of the battle on Zenith's surface to Danforth. "So it's over," he says. "Captain <last>, thank you for your assistance. This battle would have gone very differently if you were not here."
units.italian: Gli ufficiali della Marina riferiscono a Danforth i risultati della battaglia sulla superficie di Zenith. "Quindi è finita," dice. "Capitano <last>, grazie per il tuo aiuto. Questa battaglia sarebbe andata molto diversamente se tu non fossi stato qui."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Alt: Return to Wanderers|	Now that the Kor Sestor fleet has been dealt with, you should probably return and see how things are going for the Wanderers in Korath space.|3013|0
units.context: mission:Wanderers: Sestor Alt: Return to Wanderers
units.english: Now that the Kor Sestor fleet has been dealt with, you should probably return and see how things are going for the Wanderers in Korath space.
units.italian: Ora che la flotta Kor Sestor è stata sistemata, probabilmente dovresti tornare a vedere come stanno andando le cose per i Wanderers nello spazio Korath.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Scan Drones|name|3020|0
units.english: Scan remaining drones
units.italian: Scansiona i droni rimasti

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Scan Drones|description|3021|0
units.english: Scan the remaining Kor Sestor drones in a few of their systems, to collect data for the Wanderers to use to determine how quickly they are still being produced.
units.italian: Scansiona i droni Kor Sestor rimasti in alcuni dei loro sistemi, per raccogliere dati che i Wanderers possano usare per determinare con che rapidità vengono ancora prodotti.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Scan Drones|dialog|3030|0
units.english: You fire up your ship's sensors and log the identification numbers and markings of the Kor Sestor ships in this system.
units.italian: Accendi i sensori della nave e registri i numeri di identificazione e i contrassegni delle navi Kor Sestor in questo sistema.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Scan Drones|dialog|3033|0
units.english: You fire up your ship's sensors and log the identification numbers and markings of the Kor Sestor ships in this system.
units.italian: Accendi i sensori della nave e registri i numeri di identificazione e i contrassegni delle navi Kor Sestor in questo sistema.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Scan Drones|You are pleased to discover that the Wanderer colony here has grown into a small city; about a hundred thousand Wanderers have already come through the Eye to settle here. Sobari Tele'ek meets you in the spaceport. He has lost half of his feathers - his whole face is bare and scaly - but rather than wasting away like Rek he has gained considerable weight, and now towers over you.|3036|0
units.english: You are pleased to discover that the Wanderer colony here has grown into a small city; about a hundred thousand Wanderers have already come through the Eye to settle here. Sobari Tele'ek meets you in the spaceport. He has lost half of his feathers - his whole face is bare and scaly - but rather than wasting away like Rek he has gained considerable weight, and now towers over you.
units.italian: Scopri con piacere che la colonia dei Wanderers qui è cresciuta fino a diventare una piccola città; circa centomila Wanderers sono già passati attraverso l'Occhio per stabilirsi qui. Sobari Tele'ek ti incontra allo spazioporto. Ha perso metà delle piume - tutta la faccia è nuda e squamosa - ma invece di consumarsi come Rek ha preso parecchio peso, e ora ti sovrasta.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Scan Drones|	He tells you, "Our Mereti [friends, kinsfolk] tell us that the Kor Sestor have become less [aggressive, warlike] of late. The factories on their worlds are still [producing, churning out] drones, but they no longer act with a [unified will? purpose?]."|3037|0
units.english: He tells you, "Our Mereti [friends, kinsfolk] tell us that the Kor Sestor have become less [aggressive, warlike] of late. The factories on their worlds are still [producing, churning out] drones, but they no longer act with a [unified will? purpose?]."
units.italian: Ti dice: "I nostri [amici, consanguinei] Mereti ci dicono che i Kor Sestor sono diventati meno [aggressivi, bellicosi] di recente. Le fabbriche sui loro mondi [producono, sfornano] ancora droni, ma non agiscono più con una [volontà unita? uno scopo comune?]."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Scan Drones|	"Do you think they are weakened enough that we can destroy them?"|3039|0
units.english: "Do you think they are weakened enough that we can destroy them?"
units.italian: "Pensi che siano abbastanza indeboliti perché possiamo distruggerli?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Scan Drones|	"Do you think there is any way we could regain control of them?"|3040|0
units.english: "Do you think there is any way we could regain control of them?"
units.italian: "Pensi che ci sia un modo per riprenderne il controllo?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Scan Drones|	"Probably," he says, "but we would prefer a more [elegant, peaceful] solution if possible. Would you be willing to [visit, observe] their star systems again, and collect [data, measurements] that might help us to learn to control them or shut them down?"|3042|0
units.english: "Probably," he says, "but we would prefer a more [elegant, peaceful] solution if possible. Would you be willing to [visit, observe] their star systems again, and collect [data, measurements] that might help us to learn to control them or shut them down?"
units.italian: "Probabilmente," dice, "ma preferiremmo una soluzione più [elegante, pacifica] se possibile. Saresti disposto a [visitare, osservare] di nuovo i loro sistemi stellari e a raccogliere [dati, misurazioni] che ci aiutino a imparare a controllarli o a spegnerli?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Scan Drones|	"That is our [hope, desire]," he says. "Or, barring that, at least we may [disable, shut down] the factories. Would you be willing to [visit, observe] their star systems again, and collect [data, measurements] on the drones?"|3045|0
units.english: "That is our [hope, desire]," he says. "Or, barring that, at least we may [disable, shut down] the factories. Would you be willing to [visit, observe] their star systems again, and collect [data, measurements] on the drones?"
units.italian: "Questo è il nostro [desiderio, auspicio]," dice. "Oppure, se non è possibile, almeno potremmo [disabilitare, spegnere] le fabbriche. Saresti disposto a [visitare, osservare] di nuovo i loro sistemi stellari e a raccogliere [dati, misurazioni] sui droni?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Scan Drones|	"I'd be glad to."|3048|0
units.english: "I'd be glad to."
units.italian: "Ne sarò felice."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Scan Drones|	"What about the Kor Mereti drones? Have they remained peaceful?"|3050|0
units.english: "What about the Kor Mereti drones? Have they remained peaceful?"
units.italian: "E i droni Kor Mereti? Sono rimasti pacifici?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Scan Drones|	"Indeed," he says. "And, they have brought much [entertainment? novelty?] to us. You should [visit, call on] them when you have time; they are very fond of you."|3051|0
units.english: "Indeed," he says. "And, they have brought much [entertainment? novelty?] to us. You should [visit, call on] them when you have time; they are very fond of you."
units.italian: "Certo," dice. "E ci hanno portato molto [divertimento? novità?]. Dovresti [far loro visita, passare da loro] quando hai tempo; ti vogliono molto bene."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Scan Drones|	Tele'ek introduces you to the team of scientists who will tackle the problem of shutting down the Kor Sestor factories. They explain to you that they are looking for any identifying information on the drones, including the alloy composition of their hulls and prevalence of blast marks or other signs of age. That will allow them to estimate how quickly the drones are being produced.|3053|0
units.english: Tele'ek introduces you to the team of scientists who will tackle the problem of shutting down the Kor Sestor factories. They explain to you that they are looking for any identifying information on the drones, including the alloy composition of their hulls and prevalence of blast marks or other signs of age. That will allow them to estimate how quickly the drones are being produced.
units.italian: Tele'ek ti presenta la squadra di scienziati che affronterà il problema di spegnere le fabbriche Kor Sestor. Ti spiegano che cercano qualsiasi informazione identificativa sui droni, compresa la composizione della lega degli scafi e la prevalenza di segni di bruciatura o altri indizi di usura. Questo permetterà loro di stimare con che rapidità i droni vengono prodotti.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Exiles 1|name|3080|0
units.english: Pick up Rek
units.italian: Recupera Rek

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Exiles 1|description|3081|0
units.english: Pick up Rek on <planet>. She will be helping you to attempt to open diplomatic negotiations with the Korath exiles.
units.italian: Recupera Rek su <planet>. Ti aiuterà a tentare di avviare negoziati diplomatici con i Korath esiliati.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Exiles 1|log|3088|0
units.english: The Kor Sestor drones are still being produced by an automated factory, even though no one is controlling them and they seem to be acting on some sort of mindless autopilot. The Wanderers hope that the Korath exiles will help them to disable the factory.
units.italian: I droni Kor Sestor vengono ancora prodotti da una fabbrica automatizzata, anche se nessuno li controlla e sembrano agire secondo una specie di pilota automatico senza mente. I Wanderers sperano che i Korath esiliati li aiutino a neutralizzare la fabbrica.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Exiles 1|You give your scanner logs to the Wanderer scientists. A few hours later, you are called in to a meeting of the leaders. Sobari Tele'ek tells you, "Our scientists noted that the most recently constructed drones all have very similar [alloy composition?] and identification numbers. We suspect that means that they are all being produced on a single world, perhaps even a single [factory, facility]."|3090|0
units.english: You give your scanner logs to the Wanderer scientists. A few hours later, you are called in to a meeting of the leaders. Sobari Tele'ek tells you, "Our scientists noted that the most recently constructed drones all have very similar [alloy composition?] and identification numbers. We suspect that means that they are all being produced on a single world, perhaps even a single [factory, facility]."
units.italian: Consegni i registri dei tuoi scanner agli scienziati Wanderer. Poche ore dopo vieni convocato a una riunione dei capi. Sobari Tele'ek ti dice: "I nostri scienziati hanno notato che i droni costruiti più di recente hanno tutti una [composizione di lega?] e numeri di identificazione molto simili. Sospettiamo che questo significhi che vengono tutti prodotti su un unico mondo, forse persino in un'unica [fabbrica, struttura]."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Exiles 1|	He pulls up a star map and says, "Based on your previous geological scans, we [believe, deduce] that the factory is on this world, Sestor Ikfar. It would be easy enough to [destroy, eliminate] the facility, but Tema'a Iriket has a different proposal."|3091|0
units.english: He pulls up a star map and says, "Based on your previous geological scans, we [believe, deduce] that the factory is on this world, Sestor Ikfar. It would be easy enough to [destroy, eliminate] the facility, but Tema'a Iriket has a different proposal."
units.italian: Richiama una mappa stellare e dice: "In base alle tue precedenti scansioni geologiche, [crediamo, deduciamo] che la fabbrica sia su questo mondo, Sestor Ikfar. Sarebbe abbastanza facile [distruggere, eliminare] la struttura, ma Tema'a Iriket ha una proposta diversa."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Exiles 1|	Iriket stands up and says, "I propose that we use this as an [excuse, justification] for a visit to the Korath [exiles, outcasts]. We offer them the chance to [help, assist] us in ending the [scourge, plague] that they started. By [allying with, fighting alongside] us, they will come to view us as [friends, coworkers]."|3092|0
units.english: Iriket stands up and says, "I propose that we use this as an [excuse, justification] for a visit to the Korath [exiles, outcasts]. We offer them the chance to [help, assist] us in ending the [scourge, plague] that they started. By [allying with, fighting alongside] us, they will come to view us as [friends, coworkers]."
units.italian: Iriket si alza e dice: "Propongo di usare questo come [pretesto, giustificazione] per una visita ai Korath [esiliati, reietti]. Offriamo loro la possibilità di [aiutarci, assisterci] a porre fine al [flagello, morbo] che hanno cominciato loro. [Alleandosi con, combattendo al fianco di] noi, finiranno per vederci come [amici, compagni di lavoro]."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Exiles 1|	"Why get them involved if you think you can handle this on your own?"|3094|0
units.english: "Why get them involved if you think you can handle this on your own?"
units.italian: "Perché coinvolgerli se pensi di poter gestire la cosa da solo?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Exiles 1|	"Wait, you want to ask them for help just so they can feel good about themselves?"|3095|0
units.english: "Wait, you want to ask them for help just so they can feel good about themselves?"
units.italian: "Aspetta, vuoi chiedere il loro aiuto solo perché si sentano meglio con se stessi?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Exiles 1|	"That does sound like a good way to solve two problems at the same time."|3097|0
units.english: "That does sound like a good way to solve two problems at the same time."
units.italian: "Sembra davvero un buon modo per risolvere due problemi in una volta."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Exiles 1|	Tele'ek says, "The exiles must [feel, be aware of] their loss of [agency? significance?] in the galaxy. If we [plant, instill] a sense of purpose and [worth, importance] in them, they may become [peaceful, wise] just as the Kor Mereti collective did."|3099|0
units.english: Tele'ek says, "The exiles must [feel, be aware of] their loss of [agency? significance?] in the galaxy. If we [plant, instill] a sense of purpose and [worth, importance] in them, they may become [peaceful, wise] just as the Kor Mereti collective did."
units.italian: Tele'ek dice: "Gli esiliati devono [sentire, rendersi conto della] loro perdita di [ruolo? rilevanza?] nella galassia. Se [piantiamo, instilliamo] in loro un senso di scopo e di [valore, importanza], potrebbero diventare [pacifici, saggi] come è successo al collettivo Kor Mereti."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Exiles 1|	Tele'ek says, "Nothing [forges, solidifies] a friendship as quickly as fighting a [common foe?]. And, we [feel, perceive, project] that the reason the exiles engage in [raiding, piracy] is that their society has no greater [purpose, goal] than mere survival. By involving them in the [restoration, healing] of their lands, we will give them [agency? significance?] and they will be free to be [peaceful, wise]."|3102|0
units.english: Tele'ek says, "Nothing [forges, solidifies] a friendship as quickly as fighting a [common foe?]. And, we [feel, perceive, project] that the reason the exiles engage in [raiding, piracy] is that their society has no greater [purpose, goal] than mere survival. By involving them in the [restoration, healing] of their lands, we will give them [agency? significance?] and they will be free to be [peaceful, wise]."
units.italian: Tele'ek dice: "Nulla [crea, solidifica] un'amicizia più in fretta del combattere un [nemico comune?]. E [sentiamo, percepiamo, proiettiamo] che il motivo per cui gli esiliati si dedicano a [incursioni, pirateria] è che la loro società non ha uno [scopo, obiettivo] più grande della mera sopravvivenza. Coinvolgendoli nella [restaurazione, guarigione] delle loro terre, daremo loro [un ruolo? un peso?] e saranno liberi di essere [pacifici, saggi]."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Exiles 1|	After more discussion the Wanderer leaders reach a consensus that they would like you to travel with Rek to the territory of the Korath exiles and seek to make contact with them. It seems like a very optimistic plan, but then again, the Wanderer approach of seeking friendship worked quite well with the Mereti drones.|3104|0
units.english: After more discussion the Wanderer leaders reach a consensus that they would like you to travel with Rek to the territory of the Korath exiles and seek to make contact with them. It seems like a very optimistic plan, but then again, the Wanderer approach of seeking friendship worked quite well with the Mereti drones.
units.italian: Dopo altre discussioni i capi dei Wanderers raggiungono un consenso: vorrebbero che tu viaggiassi con Rek nel territorio dei Korath esiliati e cercassi di entrare in contatto con loro. Sembra un piano molto ottimistico, ma d'altronde l'approccio dei Wanderers, che cerca l'amicizia, ha funzionato piuttosto bene con i droni Mereti.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Exiles 2|name|3111|0
units.english: Contact the exiles
units.italian: Contatta gli esiliati

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Exiles 2|description|3112|0
units.english: Enter the territory of the Korath exiles. Do not fire on them. Instead, with Rek's help, try to find a way to speak with them or a place where they will meet with you.
units.italian: Entra nel territorio dei Korath esiliati. Non sparare su di loro. Cerca invece, con l'aiuto di Rek, un modo per parlare con loro o un luogo dove siano disposti a incontrarti.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Exiles 2|Surprisingly, Rek is less enthusiastic about the diplomatic plan than the other Wanderer leaders were. "Of course I greatly desire to make contact with the exiles," she says, "but it is not safe to assume that the minds of an alien species works the same as our own. These Korath were exiled due to their endless, fruitless war-making. I'm not sure an offer of friendship and a small ego boost is all they need to make them become peaceful."|3122|0
units.english: Surprisingly, Rek is less enthusiastic about the diplomatic plan than the other Wanderer leaders were. "Of course I greatly desire to make contact with the exiles," she says, "but it is not safe to assume that the minds of an alien species works the same as our own. These Korath were exiled due to their endless, fruitless war-making. I'm not sure an offer of friendship and a small ego boost is all they need to make them become peaceful."
units.italian: Sorprendentemente, Rek è meno entusiasta del piano diplomatico di quanto lo fossero gli altri capi dei Wanderers. "Certo che desidero molto entrare in contatto con gli esiliati," dice, "ma non è prudente dare per scontato che la mente di una specie aliena funzioni come la nostra. Questi Korath sono stati esiliati per la loro guerra senza fine e senza frutti. Non sono sicura che un'offerta di amicizia e una piccola spinta all'autostima siano tutto ciò che serve per renderli pacifici."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Exiles 2|	"Do you think we should cancel the mission and just deal with the Sestor ourselves?"|3124|0
units.english: "Do you think we should cancel the mission and just deal with the Sestor ourselves?"
units.italian: "Pensi che dovremmo annullare la missione e occuparci dei Sestor da soli?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Exiles 2|	"Perhaps not, but isn't it better to try for peace while we have the chance?"|3125|0
units.english: "Perhaps not, but isn't it better to try for peace while we have the chance?"
units.italian: "Forse no, ma non è meglio tentare la pace finché ne abbiamo la possibilità?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Exiles 2|	"No," says Rek, "the leaders are right, we must offer them our trust until they prove utterly unworthy of it. But you should not be surprised if they are more interested in destroying you than in listening to me."|3127|0
units.english: "No," says Rek, "the leaders are right, we must offer them our trust until they prove utterly unworthy of it. But you should not be surprised if they are more interested in destroying you than in listening to me."
units.italian: "No," dice Rek, "i capi hanno ragione, dobbiamo offrire loro la nostra fiducia finché non dimostrano di esserne del tutto indegni. Ma non dovresti sorprenderti se fossero più interessati a distruggerti che ad ascoltarmi."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Exiles 2|	"It is not only better," says Rek, "it is a moral imperative. Our first interaction with the exiles must be an offer of trust, not an act of war. But you should not be surprised if they are more interested in destroying you than in listening to me."|3130|0
units.english: "It is not only better," says Rek, "it is a moral imperative. Our first interaction with the exiles must be an offer of trust, not an act of war. But you should not be surprised if they are more interested in destroying you than in listening to me."
units.italian: "Non è solo meglio," dice Rek, "è un imperativo morale. Il nostro primo contatto con gli esiliati deve essere un'offerta di fiducia, non un atto di guerra. Ma non dovresti sorprenderti se fossero più interessati a distruggerti che ad ascoltarmi."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Exiles 2|	Rek makes herself comfortable in one of your bunk rooms, and you prepare for a visit to the territory of the Korath exiles. "We must somehow earn their trust," she says, "so do not fire on any of their ships. Instead we must find a way to communicate with them or a place where they will meet with us peacefully."|3132|0
units.english: Rek makes herself comfortable in one of your bunk rooms, and you prepare for a visit to the territory of the Korath exiles. "We must somehow earn their trust," she says, "so do not fire on any of their ships. Instead we must find a way to communicate with them or a place where they will meet with us peacefully."
units.italian: Rek si mette comoda in una delle cabine della tua nave, e tu ti prepari a una visita nel territorio dei Korath esiliati. "Dobbiamo in qualche modo guadagnarci la loro fiducia," dice, "quindi non sparare su nessuna delle loro navi. Dobbiamo invece trovare un modo per comunicare con loro, o un luogo dove siano disposti a incontrarci pacificamente."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Exiles 2|dialog|3135|0
units.english: You've returned to <planet>, but you haven't yet made contact with the Korath exiles. Travel to the core of the galaxy and look for a way to make contact with them.
units.italian: Sei tornato su <planet>, ma non sei ancora entrato in contatto con i Korath esiliati. Viaggia verso il nucleo della galassia e cerca un modo per entrare in contatto con loro.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Exiles 3|name|3181|0
units.english: Diplomacy with the exiles
units.italian: Diplomazia con gli esiliati

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Exiles 3|description|3182|0
units.english: Escort these three Korath exile world-ships to <planet> for a diplomatic meeting with the Wanderers.
units.italian: Scorta queste tre navi-mondo dei Korath esiliati fino a <planet> per un incontro diplomatico con i Wanderers.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Exiles 3|The Korath ships tail you to the planet's surface, but they do not fire on you. Instead, they hover above your ship for a long, indecisive moment. You hold your fire, and they eventually land in the sand next to you. Their airlocks open, and a few of them step out and approach your ship. They do not appear to be armed. Perhaps they have a cultural taboo against using weapons on this world.|3190|0
units.english: The Korath ships tail you to the planet's surface, but they do not fire on you. Instead, they hover above your ship for a long, indecisive moment. You hold your fire, and they eventually land in the sand next to you. Their airlocks open, and a few of them step out and approach your ship. They do not appear to be armed. Perhaps they have a cultural taboo against using weapons on this world.
units.italian: Le navi Korath ti seguono fino alla superficie del pianeta, ma non ti sparano. Restano invece sospese sopra la tua nave per un lungo momento di indecisione. Tu trattieni il fuoco, e alla fine atterrano nella sabbia accanto a te. I loro portelli si aprono, e alcuni escono e si avvicinano alla tua nave. Non sembrano armati. Forse hanno un tabù culturale contro l'uso di armi su questo mondo.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Exiles 3|	(Go outside to meet them.)|3192|0
units.english: (Go outside to meet them.)
units.italian: (Esci per incontrarli.)

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Exiles 3|	(Leave the planet while I still can.)|3193|0
units.english: (Leave the planet while I still can.)
units.italian: (Lascia il pianeta finché posso.)

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Exiles 3|	The Korath seem surprised when you and Rek, two members of obviously different species, step off your ship side by side. They mutter quietly amongst themselves as you approach, then nearly jump in surprise when Rek addresses them in their own language.|3195|0
units.english: The Korath seem surprised when you and Rek, two members of obviously different species, step off your ship side by side. They mutter quietly amongst themselves as you approach, then nearly jump in surprise when Rek addresses them in their own language.
units.italian: I Korath sembrano sorpresi quando tu e Rek, due membri di specie evidentemente diverse, scendete dalla nave fianco a fianco. Mormorano fra loro a bassa voce mentre vi avvicinate, poi quasi saltano per la sorpresa quando Rek si rivolge a loro nella loro lingua.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Exiles 3|	They converse with Rek for a while, and then Rek explains, "I told them that we hope to eliminate the infection of self-replicating war machines that they left behind, and make their territory safe for habitation once more. They say they are glad we have not destroyed the drones, because they are proud of their handiwork. They say they have command codes for the Sestor factories, to shut them down. But, they will not give the codes to us; they must go and enter them in person."|3196|0
units.english: They converse with Rek for a while, and then Rek explains, "I told them that we hope to eliminate the infection of self-replicating war machines that they left behind, and make their territory safe for habitation once more. They say they are glad we have not destroyed the drones, because they are proud of their handiwork. They say they have command codes for the Sestor factories, to shut them down. But, they will not give the codes to us; they must go and enter them in person."
units.italian: Conversano con Rek per un po', e poi Rek spiega: "Ho detto loro che speriamo di eliminare l'infezione di macchine da guerra autoriproducenti che hanno lasciato dietro di sé, e di rendere di nuovo abitabile il loro territorio. Dicono che sono contenti che non abbiamo distrutto i droni, perché sono orgogliosi del loro lavoro. Dicono di avere i codici di comando delle fabbriche Sestor, per spegnerle. Ma non ce li daranno; devono andare a inserirli di persona."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Exiles 3|	"That sounds reasonable."|3198|0
units.english: "That sounds reasonable."
units.italian: "Mi sembra ragionevole."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Exiles 3|	"What are they asking for in return?"|3200|0
units.english: "What are they asking for in return?"
units.italian: "Che cosa chiedono in cambio?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Exiles 3|	Rek says, "They request a meeting with our leaders, to work out terms of trade for our mutual benefit. It is something we would certainly agree to with no difficulty."|3201|0
units.english: Rek says, "They request a meeting with our leaders, to work out terms of trade for our mutual benefit. It is something we would certainly agree to with no difficulty."
units.italian: Rek dice: "Chiedono un incontro con i nostri capi, per definire accordi commerciali a beneficio reciproco. È qualcosa che accetteremmo senz'altro senza difficoltà."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Exiles 3|	Rek speaks with the Korath again, and then tells you, "They say that three of their 'world-ships' will travel with us to meet with the Wanderer leaders. If they are able to work out favorable terms, and are convinced that the Wanderers have peaceful intentions, they will go with us to the Sestor factory world and shut it down."|3203|0
units.english: Rek speaks with the Korath again, and then tells you, "They say that three of their 'world-ships' will travel with us to meet with the Wanderer leaders. If they are able to work out favorable terms, and are convinced that the Wanderers have peaceful intentions, they will go with us to the Sestor factory world and shut it down."
units.italian: Rek parla di nuovo con i Korath, poi ti dice: "Dicono che tre delle loro 'navi-mondo' viaggeranno con noi per incontrare i capi dei Wanderers. Se riusciranno a definire accordi favorevoli e si convinceranno che i Wanderers hanno intenzioni pacifiche, verranno con noi sul mondo della fabbrica Sestor e la spegneranno."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Exiles 3|log|3206|0
units.english: Succeeded in communicating with the Korath exiles, by landing on the one habitable planet in their territory. (It seems like the exiles might have a taboo against using weapons on that world.) The exiles agreed to send some ships to help disable the remaining Kor Sestor factory.
units.italian: Sei riuscito a comunicare con i Korath esiliati, atterrando sull'unico pianeta abitabile del loro territorio. (Sembra che gli esiliati abbiano un tabù contro l'uso di armi su quel mondo.) Gli esiliati hanno accettato di inviare alcune navi per aiutare a disabilitare la fabbrica Kor Sestor rimasta.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Exiles 3|dialog|3216|0
units.english: You have reached <planet>, but you're missing something! Either you've left one of the Korath ships behind, or your escort carrying Rek hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it to arrive.
units.italian: Hai raggiunto <planet>, ma ti manca qualcosa! O hai lasciato indietro una delle navi Korath, oppure la tua scorta che porta Rek non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Factory 1|name|3222|0
units.english: Shut down the factory
units.italian: Spegni la fabbrica

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Factory 1|description|3223|0
units.english: Escort these Korath ships to <planet>, where they will shut down the remaining Kor Sestor factories.
units.italian: Scorta queste navi Korath fino a <planet>, dove spegneranno le fabbriche Kor Sestor rimaste.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Factory 1|Rek brings the Korath to meet with the Wanderer leaders. After the meeting ends, she and Tele'ek meet up with you. "That was a strange meeting," says Rek. "It did not feel like a peace summit, but like a child's play at a peace summit, as if negotiating for peace is a skill they are only just beginning to learn. And the terms they asked for were minimal; I would have preferred to offer them far more. But they are taking steps toward becoming a peaceful society, and for that we can be grateful."|3233|0
units.english: Rek brings the Korath to meet with the Wanderer leaders. After the meeting ends, she and Tele'ek meet up with you. "That was a strange meeting," says Rek. "It did not feel like a peace summit, but like a child's play at a peace summit, as if negotiating for peace is a skill they are only just beginning to learn. And the terms they asked for were minimal; I would have preferred to offer them far more. But they are taking steps toward becoming a peaceful society, and for that we can be grateful."
units.italian: Rek porta i Korath a incontrare i capi dei Wanderers. Quando l'incontro finisce, lei e Tele'ek ti raggiungono. "È stato un incontro strano," dice Rek. "Non sembrava un vertice di pace, ma una recita infantile su un vertice di pace, come se negoziare la pace fosse un'abilità che stanno appena cominciando a imparare. E le condizioni che hanno chiesto erano minime; avrei preferito offrire loro molto di più. Ma stanno muovendo passi verso una società pacifica, e di questo possiamo essere grati."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Factory 1|	"So, what do we do now?"|3235|0
units.english: "So, what do we do now?"
units.italian: "Allora, che cosa facciamo adesso?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Factory 1|	"Are you sure that they really want peace? They aren't trying to trick you?"|3237|0
units.english: "Are you sure that they really want peace? They aren't trying to trick you?"
units.italian: "Sei sicura che vogliano davvero la pace? Non stanno cercando di ingannarti?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Factory 1|	Rek says, "It is hard to be sure. Their culture is very different from the Kor Efret; even some of their language and gestures are new to me. But they have behaved peacefully toward us so far; we must hope that their peacefulness continues."|3238|0
units.english: Rek says, "It is hard to be sure. Their culture is very different from the Kor Efret; even some of their language and gestures are new to me. But they have behaved peacefully toward us so far; we must hope that their peacefulness continues."
units.italian: Rek dice: "È difficile esserne certi. La loro cultura è molto diversa da quella dei Kor Efret; persino parte della loro lingua e dei loro gesti è nuova per me. Ma finora si sono comportati pacificamente con noi; dobbiamo sperare che la loro pacatezza duri."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Factory 1|	Tele'ek says, "You must bring the [exile, outcast] ships to <planet> and keep them from being destroyed by the drones [along the way?]. There, they will [attempt, accomplish] what they have promised, and shut down the factories. Your only role will be to [shield, protect] them, and we will give you some of our warships to [assist, accompany] you." He gestures with a straggly, slightly misshapen wing towards a number of Wanderer vessels being loaded with supplies and prepared for battle. You notice a type of weapon you don't recognize mounted on some of them.|3240|0
units.english: Tele'ek says, "You must bring the [exile, outcast] ships to <planet> and keep them from being destroyed by the drones [along the way?]. There, they will [attempt, accomplish] what they have promised, and shut down the factories. Your only role will be to [shield, protect] them, and we will give you some of our warships to [assist, accompany] you." He gestures with a straggly, slightly misshapen wing towards a number of Wanderer vessels being loaded with supplies and prepared for battle. You notice a type of weapon you don't recognize mounted on some of them.
units.italian: Tele'ek dice: "Devi portare le navi degli [esiliati, reietti] su <planet> e impedire che vengano distrutte dai droni [lungo la strada?]. Là [tenteranno, porteranno a termine] ciò che hanno promesso, e spegneranno le fabbriche. Il tuo unico compito sarà [fare loro da scudo, proteggerli], e ti daremo alcune delle nostre navi da guerra per [assisterti, accompagnarti]." Fa un gesto con un'ala stentata e un po' deforme verso alcune navi dei Wanderers che vengono caricate di rifornimenti e preparate alla battaglia. Noti che su alcune è montato un tipo di arma che non riconosci.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Factory 1|	"Are those ships carrying a new type of weapon?"|3242|0
units.english: "Are those ships carrying a new type of weapon?"
units.italian: "Quelle navi portano un nuovo tipo di arma?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Factory 1|	"Sounds like a good plan. Let's get going!"|3243|0
units.english: "Sounds like a good plan. Let's get going!"
units.italian: "Sembra un buon piano. Andiamo!"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Factory 1|	Tele'ek seems pleased that you noticed. "Indeed. They are more [useful, effective] against hull armor than shields, [perfect, appropriate] for use against the Kor Sestor vessels alongside our [existing, previous] armaments." He pauses before continuing. "[Hopefully, If this goes well], they will not get much use, but will see you [safely, successfully] through this [mission, task] to finally end this [blight, menace]. However, we will have them [ready, prepared] if the need does [arise, return]."|3245|0
units.english: Tele'ek seems pleased that you noticed. "Indeed. They are more [useful, effective] against hull armor than shields, [perfect, appropriate] for use against the Kor Sestor vessels alongside our [existing, previous] armaments." He pauses before continuing. "[Hopefully, If this goes well], they will not get much use, but will see you [safely, successfully] through this [mission, task] to finally end this [blight, menace]. However, we will have them [ready, prepared] if the need does [arise, return]."
units.italian: Tele'ek sembra compiaciuto che tu l'abbia notato. "Esatto. Sono più [utili, efficaci] contro le corazze degli scafi che contro gli scudi, [perfette, adatte] per l'uso contro le navi Kor Sestor insieme ai nostri [armamenti esistenti, precedenti]." Si ferma prima di continuare. "[Speriamo che, Se tutto va bene], non serviranno molto, ma ti porteranno [al sicuro, a destinazione] attraverso questa [missione, impresa] per porre finalmente fine a questo [flagello, pericolo]. Comunque le avremo [pronte, preparate] se dovesse [servire, ripresentarsi] la necessità."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Factory 1|	"Can I get some for my own ship?"|3247|0
units.english: "Can I get some for my own ship?"
units.italian: "Posso averne alcune per la mia nave?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Factory 1|	"Is it a good idea to show off these new weapons to the Korath Exiles when making overtures of friendship?"|3249|0
units.english: "Is it a good idea to show off these new weapons to the Korath Exiles when making overtures of friendship?"
units.italian: "È una buona idea mostrare queste nuove armi ai Korath esiliati mentre si fanno offerte di amicizia?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Factory 1|	"I look forward to seeing them in action. I should get my ship ready for to go."|3250|0
units.english: "I look forward to seeing them in action. I should get my ship ready for to go."
units.italian: "Non vedo l'ora di vederle in azione. Dovrei preparare la nave per partire."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Factory 1|	Tele'ek gestures towards Rek who says, "I raised a similar concern, but in this case, I [recognize, accept] that the benefit outweighs possible risks."|3252|0
units.english: Tele'ek gestures towards Rek who says, "I raised a similar concern, but in this case, I [recognize, accept] that the benefit outweighs possible risks."
units.italian: Tele'ek fa un gesto verso Rek, che dice: "Ho sollevato una preoccupazione simile, ma in questo caso [riconosco, accetto] che il beneficio superi i possibili rischi."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Factory 1|	Tele'ek explains, "If they view these weapons as signs of [aggression?] against themselves, there is little I can do for them. Their ships are not as [durable, well-armored] as the Kor Sestor automata, so our other technologies would already be [effective, damaging] enough if used against them. If they are [rational, intelligent], they will value the added protection on this [journey, endeavor]."|3253|0
units.english: Tele'ek explains, "If they view these weapons as signs of [aggression?] against themselves, there is little I can do for them. Their ships are not as [durable, well-armored] as the Kor Sestor automata, so our other technologies would already be [effective, damaging] enough if used against them. If they are [rational, intelligent], they will value the added protection on this [journey, endeavor]."
units.italian: Tele'ek spiega: "Se vedono queste armi come segni di [aggressione?] contro di loro, c'è poco che io possa fare per loro. Le loro navi non sono così [robuste, ben corazzate] come gli automi Kor Sestor, quindi le nostre altre tecnologie sarebbero già [efficaci, dannose] abbastanza se usate contro di loro. Se sono [razionali, intelligenti], apprezzeranno la protezione in più in questo [viaggio, tentativo]."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Factory 1|	"We have not yet produced many, but they will be [available, present] in our outfitters soon."|3256|0
units.english: "We have not yet produced many, but they will be [available, present] in our outfitters soon."
units.italian: "Non ne abbiamo ancora prodotte molte, ma saranno [disponibili, presenti] nei nostri negozi di equipaggiamento presto."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Factory 1|	You and Rek say goodbye to Tele'ek before returning to your ship, and preparing it for the trip to <planet>.|3258|0
units.english: You and Rek say goodbye to Tele'ek before returning to your ship, and preparing it for the trip to <planet>.
units.italian: Tu e Rek salutate Tele'ek prima di tornare alla tua nave e prepararla per il viaggio verso <planet>.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Factory 1|dialog|3267|0
units.english: You have reached <planet>, but you're missing something! Either you've left one of the Korath ships behind, or your escort carrying Rek hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it to arrive.
units.italian: Hai raggiunto <planet>, ma ti manca qualcosa! O hai lasciato indietro una delle navi Korath, oppure la tua scorta che porta Rek non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Factory 2|name|3301|0
units.english: Defend <planet>
units.italian: Difendi <planet>

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Factory 2|description|3302|0
units.english: Drive off the Kor Sestor drones and keep them from interfering with the Korath exiles who are shutting down their factories.
units.italian: Respingi i droni Kor Sestor e impedisci che interferiscano con i Korath esiliati che stanno spegnendo le loro fabbriche.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Factory 2|dialog|3310|0
units.english: There are still Kor Sestor drones overhead. You should go fight them off so the Korath exiles are not attacked while trying to disable the factories.
units.italian: Ci sono ancora droni Kor Sestor là sopra. Dovresti andare a respingerli, così che i Korath esiliati non vengano attaccati mentre cercano di neutralizzare le fabbriche.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Factory 2|The drones stop firing on the Korath ships the moment they enter the atmosphere, which is a good sign - it probably means that their command codes worked. While they begin scouting out the manufacturing center, the exiles tell you (through Rek) that they need you to return to orbit and keep the remaining drones from attacking them until they can be sure the factory is shut down for good; it might take them a while to accomplish that.|3314|0
units.english: The drones stop firing on the Korath ships the moment they enter the atmosphere, which is a good sign - it probably means that their command codes worked. While they begin scouting out the manufacturing center, the exiles tell you (through Rek) that they need you to return to orbit and keep the remaining drones from attacking them until they can be sure the factory is shut down for good; it might take them a while to accomplish that.
units.italian: I droni smettono di sparare alle navi Korath nel momento in cui entrano nell'atmosfera, il che è un buon segno: probabilmente significa che i loro codici di comando hanno funzionato. Mentre cominciano a perlustrare il centro di produzione, gli esiliati ti dicono (tramite Rek) che hanno bisogno che tu torni in orbita e impedisca ai droni rimasti di attaccarli finché non potranno essere certi che la fabbrica sia spenta per sempre; potrebbero volerci un po' di tempo.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Factory 2|	You fire up your engines and blast off for one last battle against the Kor Sestor...|3315|0
units.english: You fire up your engines and blast off for one last battle against the Kor Sestor...
units.italian: Accendi i motori e decolli per un'ultima battaglia contro i Kor Sestor...

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Factory 3|name|3383|0
units.english: Return to <planet>
units.italian: Ritorna su <planet>

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Factory 3|description|3384|0
units.english: Return to <planet> and report to the Wanderers that the exiles have shut down the Kor Sestor factory (and possibly stolen the equipment in the process).
units.italian: Torna su <planet> e riferisci ai Wanderers che gli esiliati hanno spento la fabbrica Kor Sestor (e che probabilmente ne hanno rubato l'equipaggiamento).

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Sestor: Factory 3|log|3391|0
units.english: The Korath exiles have kept their bargain with the Wanderers and shut down the final Kor Sestor drone factory, although it may be some time before the last of the existing drones are eliminated.
